Unlock these with Subscription A recent NITI Aayog report said some 94,000 government schools were closed over the past decade, an average of 25 a day, contributing to a 2.26 crore decline in government school enrolment. The government schools’ share of total enrolment has fallen from 71% in 2005 to 49.24% in 2024-25. School closures are happening across States on the grounds of rationalisation. The National Education Policy 2020 advocates such rationalisation but without endangering the concept of neighbourhood schools. School closure numbers cannot be explained away as gradual demographic drift, urban migration and so on. Rather, it is a coordinated administrative decision taken in states where the poorest and most rural children have the least capacity to compensate for a school that has vanished. Number of government schools falls, but those with fewer than 10 students see a steady rise Niti Aayog flags poor student retention, learning outcomes in report Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Jammu and Kashmir lead in this. In December 2025, Madhya Pradesh’s School Education Department found that 7.37 lakh children in the state have no school records. They are not enrolled in any school — private or government. In Jhabua and Shivpuri, for instance, 29,000 children fall into the “Drop Box” category — the department’s term for those at imminent risk of dropping out. Across the State’s 55 districts, more than 3,500 government schools recorded zero new admissions this academic session. Another 6,500 schools saw fewer than 10 admissions. The department’s response was to instruct every district education officer to paste lists of unmapped children on school noticeboards, contact them directly, and upload their details to the State portal. Statewide, 11.38 lakh children fall under the “Drop Box” category. Another 1.23 lakh are already recorded as dropouts. A further 1.55 lakh have left school because their families were displaced or migrated for work. The department’s flagship outreach programmes, School Chalen Hum and the Home Contact Campaign, were built to prevent exactly this. The State’s own audit of its own scheme found three-quarters of a million children whom neither programme had reached. Government data tabled in the Lok Sabha in February confirms the scale. UDISE+ figures show the national count of government schools falling from 11.07 lakh in 2014-15 to 10.17 lakh in 2023-24, a decline of roughly 89,000 that lines up almost exactly with NITI Aayog’s own count. Private schools nationally grew from 2.88 lakh to 3.31 lakh over the same decade. Madhya Pradesh’s government schools fell from 1.22 lakh in 2018-19 to 99,411 the very next year — a drop of roughly 22,600 in twelve months. Uttar Pradesh’s government schools fell from 1.63 lakh to 1.38 lakh in that identical year, a drop of over 25,000. Reports on J&K’s rationalisation programme documented children now travelling 4 to 6 km daily to reach a functioning school, violating neighbourhood school mandates of Right to Education Act (RTE). More than 4,300 schools were closed or merged under a rationalisation scheme, with the Lok Sabha’s own UDISE+ figures showing the state’s school count falling from 23,167 in 2020-21 to 18,785 by 2022-23, alongside nearly 13,000 vacant teaching posts reported separately in the state assembly. Government schools in India are not a neutral public utility used evenly across classes. They are, disproportionately, the schools of the poor — of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and the poorer strata of backward-class communities. India is home to a significant proportion of the world’s below-poverty-line population, and it is their children who fill government classrooms. A 2019 National Sample Survey analysis found access to free education declining unevenly, with Muslim and Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe households disproportionately marginalised from the schools nearest to them. The burden falls disproportionately on girls who are the first to be withdrawn when the nearest school stops being nearby. What consolidation looks like on the ground is often a single teacher covering five classes at once — unable to know an individual child’s background or tailor instruction, technically in breach of the Right to Education Act’s staffing and quality norms. In Lok Sabha, the concerned minister said education is on the concurrent list, and the responsibility for this trend lies entirely with States. But the RTE is a Central Act and the mandates on neighbourhood schools are the Centre’s responsibility. Further, the Centre seeks to intervene in State school education by making Central fund allocation for schools conditional on NEP implementation and also imposes a language policy. There are avenues for the Centre to step in against this trend. The RTE Act, in force since 2010, guarantees free and compulsory education from age six to 14. RTE says nothing binding about the quality of what is delivered once a child is inside the classroom. It creates entitlements that children, by definition, cannot assert on their own — and parents, particularly poor and rural parents, often lack the legal and institutional capacity to enforce either. RTE assumes a symmetry of power between the state, the school, and the family that does not exist on the ground. RTE is not justiciable, in practice. School Management Committees, the one mechanism written into the RTE to give parents and communities a formal voice, largely go unconvened. 订阅可享有多项权益，包括《Premium Stories》《Editorials》《Opinions》等内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。NITI Aayog最新报告称，过去十年间，约94,000所公立学校被关闭，平均每天关闭25所，导致公立学校在校生人数减少了2.26 crore。公立学校占全部在校生人数的比例已从2005年的71%降至2024-25年的49.24%。多个邦以合理化为由关闭学校。《2020年国家教育政策》主张进行这种合理化调整，但前提是不危及社区学校的理念。学校关闭的数量不能归因于人口自然变化、城市迁移等因素。事实上，这是各邦协调一致作出的行政决定，而贫困程度最高、农村儿童最集中的地区，最无力弥补学校消失带来的影响。

公立学校数量下降，但学生少于10人的学校数量持续上升

Niti Aayog在报告中指出学生留校率低和学习成效不佳的问题，北方邦、中央邦和查谟和克什米尔邦在这一问题上居首。2025年12月，中央邦学校教育部发现，该邦有7.37 lakh名儿童没有学校登记记录。他们没有在任何学校就读，无论私立还是公立。例如，在贾布亚和希沃普里，29,000名儿童属于“Drop Box”类别，这是该部门对面临辍学危险儿童的称呼。全邦55个地区中，逾3,500所公立学校在本学年没有招收任何新生，另有6,500所学校招收的新生少于10人。该部门采取的措施是，要求各地区教育官员把未完成信息匹配的儿童名单张贴在学校公告板上，直接联系他们，并将相关资料上传至邦级门户。全邦共有11.38 lakh名儿童属于“Drop Box”类别，另有1.23 lakh名儿童已被登记为辍学生，还有1.55 lakh名儿童因家庭流离失所或外出务工而离校。

该部门的重点外展项目“School Chalen Hum”和“Home Contact Campaign”正是为防止这种情况而设立的。该邦对自身项目的审计发现，这两个项目均未覆盖的名童达75万。2026年2月提交人民院的政府数据证实了这一规模。UDISE+数据显示，全国公立学校数量从2014-15年的11.07 lakh所降至2023-24年的10.17 lakh所，减少约89,000所，几乎与NITI Aayog自己的统计数字完全一致。同期，全国私立学校从2.88 lakh所增至3.31 lakh所。中央邦公立学校从2018-19年的1.22 lakh所降至次年的99,411所，12个月内减少约22,600所。北方邦公立学校在同一年从1.63 lakh所降至1.38 lakh所，减少逾25,000所。

关于查谟和克什米尔邦合理化项目的报告显示，如今儿童每天需步行4至6公里才能到达仍在办学的学校，违反了《受教育权法》（RTE）关于社区学校的要求。超过4,300所学校根据合理化计划被关闭或合并。人民院自身的UDISE+数据显示，该邦学校数量从2020-21年的23,167所降至2022-23年的18,785所；该邦议会另报近13,000个教师职位空缺。

印度的公立学校并非各阶层均衡使用的公共设施。它们在更大程度上是贫困儿童就读的学校，包括列入种姓、列入部落以及落后种姓社群中较贫困阶层的儿童。印度拥有全球相当高比例的贫困人口，而公立教室里坐着的正是这些家庭的孩子。2019年一项全国抽样调查分析发现，免费教育的可及性在不同地区下降程度不一，穆斯林家庭以及列入种姓和列入部落家庭在更大程度上被排斥在离家最近的学校之外。

负担尤其不成比例地落在女孩身上；最近的学校不再近在咫尺时，她们往往最先被要求退学。整合调整在基层的常见表现是，一名教师同时负责五个班级，既无法了解每个孩子的具体背景，也无法因材施教，在技术层面上违反了《受教育权法》关于师资配置和教育质量的标准。

人民院内，相关部长表示教育属于共同事项，这一趋势的责任完全在各邦。但《受教育权法》是中央法律，社区学校相关要求由中央政府负责。此外，中央政府正通过将学校中央资金分配与落实国家教育政策挂钩来介入各邦学校教育，还推行语言政策。中央政府有多种途径介入，扭转这一趋势。

《受教育权法》自2010年实施以来，保障6至14岁儿童享有免费和义务教育。RTE并未对儿童进入教室后所获得教育的质量作出具有约束力的规定。该法创设了各项权利，而儿童按定义无法自行主张这些权利，父母尤其是贫困和农村父母，往往也缺乏执行这些权利所需的法律和制度能力。RTE假定国家、学校和家庭之间的权力关系是对称的，但现实并非如此。

RTE在实践中不可诉。RTE中唯一赋予家长和社区正式发声渠道的机制是学校管理委员会，但这些委员会大多从未召开。The Hindu Explains / Text and Context / school / right to education / education

Annamalai on Sunday urged the State government to get back the Periyathathampalayam lake from the Forest Department. Speaking at an awareness programme at Periyathathampalayam on retrieving the lake, he said the lake had been a groundwater source for many villages for long. However, the State government handed over the waterbody to the Forest Department in 2001 without valid reasons. It did not carry out any activity in the lake for several years. The lake had been neglected for more than 20 years. However, the department planted tree saplings of various varieties two years ago. Had it been with the State government, several works, including desilting, could have been undertaken. Hence, the State government should lake the under its control. Mr. Annamalai said a mechanism could be put in place for 13 km for carrying surplus water to the Periyathathampalayam lake, spread over 54 hectares, from the Amaravathi river. It could be carried out only if the lake was brought under the control of the State government from the Forest Department. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/k.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription A 55-year-old man was killed after a luxury car, allegedly driven by a 17-year-old boy, rammed the scooter he was riding in the early hours of Sunday (October 25, 2026). The deceased has been identified as Jayabalakrishnan of Chittur, Cheranalloor. This is the second road accident allegedly involving teenaged drivers in Kochi within a fortnight. The Cheranalloor police on Sunday recorded the arrest of the minor driver, reportedly the son of a judicial officer. The boy was released on bail from the police station later in the day under Section 8 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015, according to the police. The accident occurred around 2.20 a.m. near a car showroom at Maraparambu on Container Road in Cheranalloor. The boy was travelling alone in the car from Vallarpadam towards Kalamassery when it hit the scooter, which was moving in the same direction, as per the FIR. Cheranalloor Circle Inspector told the media that the boy was not under the influence of alcohol as per preliminary medical examination. Mr. Jayabalakrishnan, who was returning after shutting his eatery at Chittur, reportedly succumbed to his injuries on the spot. The police have registered a case against the minor driver on charges of rash driving and rash or negligent act that does not amount to culpable homicide under Sections 281 and 106(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Later in the day, the police added Section 105 of BNS which prescribes the punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder in the FIR. The Section was added amid protests and criticism against the police for releasing the accused on station bail. “Further action based on the fresh charge will be taken against the accused,” a senior police officer said. Relatives of the victim, supported by various political parties, staged protests in front of the Cheranalloor police station after the accused was let out on bail. The body of the victim was shifted to the Ernakulam Government Medical College Hospital. Mr. Jayabalakrishnan is survived by his wife Manju and three children, including two Plus Two students. The accident comes days after three youths were killed after an allegedly speeding luxury car driven by a 19-year-old youth rammed the two-wheeler they were riding near Nedumbassery. Ernakulam MLA T.J. Vinod, meanwhile, requested Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala to examine if the police’s act of granting station bail to the minor accused was legally correct. He said the responsibility of the car owner who permitted the minor to drive the vehicle should also come under the purview of the investigation. “There shouldn’t be any compromise in the probe on account of the family background and influence of the accused,” he said. https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription At the ninth World AI Conference in Shanghai this month, Chinese President Xi Jinping addressed the gathering for the first time in nine years. It is indicative of the priority that AI occupies for the leadership. At the conference, Mr. Xi pitched Chinese AI models as a global public good. The contrast was clear as day. America is selling closed-source, proprietary models while China is offering open-weight models to the world. This distinction is not merely technical, but equally political. Unlike Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google, which host their frontier models on their respective servers and offer services via an application programming interface (API), Chinese labs such as DeepSeek, Qwen, and Moonshot also release their weights for anyone to download. Unlike American models, these can be customised, modified, and even further trained. There is no subscription to cancel or terms of service. The maker cannot revoke or restrict access. So long as one can manage the requisite compute to host the model, even Papua New Guinea or Senegal can run it locally on their servers. And most importantly, the data never leaves the border. However, one may wonder what explains China’s benevolence. Well, to begin with, the objective is to project China as a responsible AI player in the comity of nations. Unlike the Americans, who he alleged to have overstretched the concept of national security to AI, and thereby adopted an exclusionary approach, China is committed to sharing the benefits and fruits of AI. Mr. Xi’s framing was indicative in this regard. He described AI as “humanity’s collective wisdom,” a “historic opportunity” to “bridge the AI and digital divides,” and something that “should not be a solo performance by a single country but a symphony of international cooperation.” The underlying message, aimed at Washington, projected Beijing as the open and cooperative alternative to the U.S.’s AI models. But there is a limiting factor at play too that explains Beijing’s benevolence — its compute constraint, both for training and inference. Since 2022, the U.S. administration, in concert with its allies, has imposed a series of export restrictions on China, limiting its ability to both mass-import and mass-manufacture high-end chips. To understand this constraint, one must separate two very different tasks — training a model and serving it. Training is a one-time cost. A lab assembles a cluster of chips, runs it for a few months and comes up with a finished model. The fleet required is numerically small. For instance, GPT-4 was trained on an estimated 25,000 Nvidia chips, and Meta trained its Llama 3.1 on ~16,400 chips. DeepSeek, on the other hand, trained its acclaimed V3 model on ~2,000 export-compliant H800s. A frontier model, in other words, needs chips in the thousands, and it needs them only once. Serving that model to the public, however, is an altogether different proposition. Inference scales with the user base and requires continuous expansion as it must answer hundreds of millions of user queries. OpenAI crossed a million GPUs in 2025, and Meta targeted the equivalent of 1.3 million by the end of 2025. Thus, for any model with a mass consumer base, the serving fleet dwarfs the training fleet, often by ten to a hundred times. In other words, the distinction is that of a stockpile and a flow. To train a model, a lab can accumulate ten or twenty thousand chips through smuggling, stockpiling, and modest domestic production. This is precisely why the export controls could not prevent China from reaching parity at the model level. Inference, however, cannot be solved this way. The export controls mean that the most advanced chips remain out of bounds for Chinese firms. Additionally, the concessions the U.S. has offered exist largely on paper. Around 10 Chinese firms were cleared in principle to buy up to 75,000 H200 chips each, but not a single unit had been delivered by mid-2026, as sales remained stalled and Beijing itself directed firms towards domestic alternatives. China can attempt to bridge the shortfall through domestic production, but even here, restrictions on export of EUVs continue to prove a handicap. SMIC’s 5nm line in China runs at roughly 20% yield without EUV tools, far short of commercial viability. This severely restricts the ability of Chinese labs to offer services via API alone. DeepSeek’s decision to freeze new registrations in January 2025 was influenced by a surge in traffic it could not serve, alongside a reported ‘large-scale malicious attack’. Furthermore, given that Chinese models are nearly as good as the U.S.’s frontier models, their popularity is increasing. Data show that the Chinese models’ share of U.S. firms’ AI usage has hit a record 60% on OpenRouter — a marketplace for routing queries to various models based on requests. American firms are preferring Chinese models as they provide comparable services at a fraction of the cost. But this success comes with a rider — the need for enormous compute. The solution thus is to simply outsource compute via open-weight models. Hence, China’s open-weight offering to the world is largely a product of its structural constraint. It can build models that rival the U.S. but cannot serve them at scale. But Beijing cannot ignore the urge to securitise and restrain access for too long. Sooner or later, it will face that choice. Indeed, Beijing is already reported to be weighing restrictions on overseas access to its most capable models. One can expect China’s frontier models to move towards proprietary models, while trailing models remaining open-weight. But so long as China cannot overcome the larger constraint, it is likely to continue fielding open-weight models. And China’s constraint is the world’s gain. (Amit Kumar is a Staff Research Analyst at Takshashila Institution) Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. They cannot be abusive or personal. https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.title_zh: 中国人工智能馈赠背后的限制
https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.body_zh: 账户订阅福利包括Premium Stories、社论、观点文章等。订阅即可解锁这些内容。在本月于上海举行的第九届世界人工智能大会上，中国国家主席习近平九年来首次在会上发表讲话。这表明人工智能在领导层议程中占据优先地位。在大会上，习先生将中国人工智能模型定位为全球公共产品。对比显而易见。美国在销售闭源专有模型，而中国则向世界提供开放权重模型。这种区别不仅是技术性的，也同样具有政治性。与Anthropic、OpenAI和Google不同，这些公司将其前沿模型托管在各自服务器上并通过应用程序编程接口（API）提供服务，中国实验室如DeepSeek、Qwen和Moonshot也会发布其权重供任何人下载。与美国模型不同，这些模型可以被定制、修改甚至进一步训练。没有需要取消的订阅或服务条款。制造商无法撤销或限制访问。只要能够管理托管模型所需算力，即使是巴布亚新几内亚或塞内加尔也能在本地服务器上运行它。最重要的是，数据永远不会离开国境。然而，有人可能会好奇是什么解释了中国这种善意。首先，其目标是在国际大家庭中将中国塑造成负责任的人工智能参与者。与美国人不同，习先生指责他们将国家安全概念过度延伸至人工智能，从而采取排他性做法，中国致力于分享人工智能的惠益和成果。习先生的表述在这方面具有指示性。他将人工智能描述为“人类的集体智慧”、“弥合人工智能和数字鸿沟的历史机遇”，以及“不应由单一国家独奏而应是国际合作的交响乐”。这一针对华盛顿的潜在信息，将北京塑造成美国人工智能模型的开放与合作替代方案。但也有一个限制因素在起作用，这解释了北京的善意——其在训练和推理方面的算力限制。自2022年以来，美国政府与其盟友一道对中国实施了一系列出口限制，限制其大规模进口和大规模制造高端芯片的能力。要理解这一限制，必须区分两个截然不同的任务——训练模型和提供服务。训练是一次性成本。实验室组建一个芯片集群，运行几个月后得出一个完成的模型。所需的集群数量相对较少。例如，GPT-4据估计在约25000块英伟达芯片上训练，Meta在其Llama 3.1上使用了约16400块芯片。另一方面，DeepSeek在其备受赞誉的V3模型上使用了约2000块符合出口规定的H800芯片。换言之，一个前沿模型需要数千块芯片，而且只需要一次。然而，向公众提供该模型服务则完全是另一回事。推理随用户基数扩展，需要持续扩张，因为它必须回答数亿用户的查询。OpenAI在2025年GPU数量超过百万，Meta的目标是到2025年底达到相当于130万块。因此，对于任何拥有大规模消费者基础的模型，提供服务的集群远远超过训练集群，通常是十到一百倍。换言之，区别在于库存与流量。要训练一个模型，实验室可以通过走私、囤积和适度国内生产积累一两万块芯片。这正是出口管制未能阻止中国在模型层面达到同等水平的原因。然而，推理无法通过这种方式解决。出口管制意味着最先进的芯片对中国企业仍遥不可及。此外，美国提供的让步大多停留在纸面上。大约10家中国企业原则上获准每家购买最多75000块H200芯片，但到2026年中期没有交付任何一台，因为销售仍处于停滞状态，且北京自身引导企业转向国内替代方案。中国可以尝试通过国内生产弥补短缺，但即使在这里，对极紫外光刻机出口的限制继续构成障碍。中国SMIC的5纳米产线在没有极紫外工具的情况下良率约为20%，远未达到商业可行性。这严重限制了中国实验室仅通过API提供服务的能力。DeepSeek在2025年1月决定冻结新注册，受到其无法应对的流量激增以及据报的“大规模恶意攻击”影响。此外，由于中国模型几乎与美国前沿模型一样优秀，其受欢迎程度正在上升。数据显示，在OpenRouter上，中国模型在美国企业人工智能使用中的份额已达到创纪录的60%——OpenRouter是一个根据请求将查询路由到各种模型的市场。美国企业更喜欢中国模型，因为它们以一小部分成本提供可比服务。但这种成功伴随着一个附加条件——需要巨大的算力。因此，解决方案就是通过开放权重模型简单地外包算力。因此，中国向世界提供的开放权重产品在很大程度上是其结构性限制的产物。它能够构建与美国匹敌的模型，但无法大规模提供服务。但北京不能长期忽视将安全化和限制访问的冲动。迟早，它将面临这一选择。事实上，据报北京已在考虑对其最强大模型的海外访问施加限制。可以预期中国的前沿模型将转向专有模型，而落后模型仍保持开放权重。但只要中国无法克服更大的限制，它很可能继续推出开放权重模型。而中国的限制正是世界的收获。（Amit Unlock these with Subscription A war of words has erupted after veteran actor Naseeruddin Shah attacked the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) as he backed students of the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute (SRFTI) staging an indefinite sit-in over violent incidents on the campus. Mr. Shah alleged that the BJP was taking “revenge” on anyone not subscribing to its beliefs and policies. The BJP leadership in West Bengal questioned the motives of the actor and said the actor wanted to weaken democracy in the country. BJP Rajya Sabha member Rahul Sinha called for a full investigation into the veteran actor’s criticism of the party over the ongoing agitation at the SRFTI, alleging his remarks could be linked to an international conspiracy. Mr. Sinha alleged that Mr. Shah had suddenly emerged from a long period of inactivity to make political statements against the BJP. Another BJP leader and MLA Ritesh Tewari said Mr. Shah was an opponent of the BJP and the Sangh. “I also know his elder brother. His daughter is married in Kolkata; she is the daughter-in-law of a CPI(M) leader and has even contested elections. When ministers from West Bengal and the Mayor of Kolkata were raising the slogan of Dawat-e-Islam, why was Naseeruddin silent?” the Kashipur Beleghata MLA said. In a video message, Mr. Shah had urged all right-minded citizens to support the demands of the SRFTI. “The latest victims of this vendetta are the students, the aspiring filmmakers of the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute. In return for their demand for accountability from the administration, they have been served show-cause notices, put under surveillance, threatened and now have even been asked to vacate the hostels,” the actor said in the video message. On Sunday (October 25, 2026), a section of SRFTI students claimed power supply to the only classroom they had been accessing for Internet connectivity and workstation facilities was cut off, accusing the administration of intensifying measures to pressure them into calling off their agitation. Earlier on October 15, 2026 six students of the SRFTI were rusticated for allegedly vandalising the Vice-Chancellor’s office and manhandling him. The students and administration of the film school are at loggerheads after a clash broke out inside the campus between a right wing organisation and a section of students on October 4. SRFTI registrar Deepak Kumar in a statement on Sunday clarified that disciplinary action against certain students was initiated over alleged misconduct, vandalism, defacement and physical assault, and not for exercising their right to protest. “The institute categorically clarifies that the disciplinary action initiated against certain students are related to specific acts of misconduct, vandalism, defacement and physical assault ... Any attempt to link these actions to students’ legitimate exercise of their right to protest misrepresents both the facts and the specific grounds on which proceedings were started,” the statement added. https://leadership.ng/300m-fund-launched.body: The launch was highlighted as a key outcome of the inaugural ASIS Global Action Forum held in New York on the sidelines of the 81st United Nations General Assembly (UNGA81). The Forum was convened by Sterling One Foundation in partnership with NSIA, the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA), RALLY and other partners, building on the outcomes of the fifth Africa Social Impact Summit (ASIS) held in Lagos in July. Co-managed by NSIA and Africa50, with SEforALL providing energy-access leadership, the DRE Fund is designed to mobilise investment for distributed renewable energy solutions including mini-grids and standalone solar systems. The solutions will target communities and businesses currently without reliable power, helping to close energy access gaps, strengthen economic opportunities and support Nigeria’s broader development ambitions. Speaking on the significance of the initiative, the managing director and chief executive officer of Renewables Investment Platform for Limitless Energy (RIPLE), Yusuf Umar launched by NSIA, said financing remains critical to solving energy poverty. “Closing Nigeria’s energy access gap requires more than recognising the scale of the challenge; it requires financing structures that can bring viable solutions to the communities and businesses that need them most. The $300 million Nigeria Distributed Renewable Energy Fund represents an important step towards mobilising capital for distributed energy solutions at scale,” he said. “Through collaboration, disciplined investment and effective implementation, we can help expand electricity access, support businesses and create opportunities for more Nigerians to participate in economic growth,” Umar added. The chief executive officer of Sterling One Foundation, Mrs. Olapeju Ibekwe said the Fund exemplifies the kind of action Africa needs. “At the Africa Social Impact Summit, we believe that the true value of development conversations lies in what they make possible beyond the room. Reliable energy can unlock opportunities for businesses, improve essential services and strengthen livelihoods,” she said. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/hamzat-to-unveil-l.body: The Lagos State chapter of the All Progressives Congress (APC) will unveil the manifesto of its governorship candidate for the 2027 election, Dr. Kadri Obafemi Hamzat, on Friday, October 30, 2026. Director General of the PBAT-KOH Campaign Council, Senator Musiliu Obanikoro, announced this on Sunday at a press conference held at the campaign office on Sobo Arobiodu Street, GRA, Ikeja. Obanikoro said the launch will hold at the Wole Soyinka Centre for Culture and Creative Arts, formerly the National Arts Theatre, Iganmu, Lagos, from 3pm to 5pm, with arrivals from 11am. He said the event will provide the platform for Hamzat, popularly known as KOH, to present his vision, priorities and plans for the continued development of Lagos. “The future of Lagos is too important to be left to chance because the decisions we make today will determine the opportunities available to our children, the strength of our economy, and the quality of life of millions of people who call this state home,” Obanikoro said. He said the campaign is anchored on two principles: continued shared progress and inclusivity. “Continued shared progress means working together to build a stronger Lagos on the foundation and master plan, creating more opportunities, and improving the lives of our people without break in continuity. Inclusivity means that nobody should be left behind because of religion, tribe, gender, social status, or place of origin,” he said. Obanikoro said Lagos, with an estimated population of about 25 million people, faces serious demands in transportation, human capital development, housing, infrastructure, security, healthcare and environmental management, which require experienced leadership and careful planning. He traced the development of the state from President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s tenure as governor through the administrations of Babatunde Fashola, Akinwunmi Ambode and incumbent Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu, saying Hamzat will build on those foundations. “Continuity is not about doing things the same way simply because they have been done before. It is about protecting what works, correcting what needs improvement and building on existing progress,” he said. Obanikoro highlighted Hamzat’s credentials, noting that he earned a PhD in Systems Process Engineering from Cranfield University, England, at 28, worked with Merrill Lynch, Morgan Stanley and Citibank in the United States, and served as a three-time commissioner and deputy governor of Lagos State. He also pointed to the achievements of the Sanwo-Olu administration, including the Blue and Red rail lines, hundreds of completed roads and bridges, improvements in schools and hospitals, housing projects and support for businesses and young people. The campaign DG said the candidate and the campaign organisation have embarked on wide consultations with religious leaders, traditional rulers, market women, traders, young people, professionals, artisans and community leaders. “Leadership must listen before it acts. We want the concerns of ordinary Lagosians to inform our priorities,” he said. He said although the launch is strictly by invitation due to limited seats, proceedings will be broadcast live from 3pm to 5pm on Channels TV, ARISE TV, TVC, LTV, News Central, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram. He added that after the presentation, the manifesto will be made available for download for members of the public to study and provide feedback through party channels. “The message of this campaign is clear: Lagos, let us move forward together,” Obanikoro said. https://leadership.ng/hamzat-to-unveil-l.title_zh: 哈姆扎特将于10月30日公布拉各斯宣言，全职大会党承诺共同发展与包容
https://leadership.ng/hamzat-to-unveil-l.body_zh: 拉各斯州进步大会（APC）分部将于2026年10月30日星期五公布其2027年选举州长候选人卡德里·奥巴费米·哈姆扎特博士的竞选宣言。PBAT-KOH竞选委员会总干事、参议员穆西柳·奥巴尼科罗于星期日在GRA伊凯JA的Sobo Arobiodu街竞选办公室举行的新闻发布会上宣布了这一消息。奥巴尼科罗说，宣言发布活动将于下午3时至5时在拉各斯伊甘穆的沃莱·索因卡文化与创意艺术中心举行，该中心原为国家艺术剧院；宾客可从上午11时起入场。他说，活动将为广为人知的KOH哈姆扎特提供平台，展示其推动拉各斯持续发展的愿景、重点和计划。奥巴尼科罗说：“拉各斯的未来极其重要，不能听天由命，因为我们今天作出的决定将决定孩子能够获得的机会、经济实力，以及数百万以该州为家园的人的生活质量。”他说，此次竞选以两项原则为基础：持续共同进步和包容。“持续共同进步意味着在现有基础和总体规划之上携手建设更强大的拉各斯，创造更多机会，在不中断连续性的情况下改善人民生活。包容意味着不能有人因宗教、部落、性别、社会地位或出身地而被落下。”奥巴尼科罗说，拉各斯估计人口约2500万，在交通、人力资源开发、住房、基础设施、安全、医疗保健和环境管理等方面面临严峻需求，需要经验丰富的领导和周密规划。他回顾了该州从博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统担任州长时期，到巴巴通德·法什拉、阿金温米·阿姆博德以及现任州长巴巴吉德·桑沃-奥卢各届政府的发展历程，并表示哈姆扎特将在这些基础上继续建设。他说：“延续并不是因为过去采用过某种做法，就照搬同样的方式。延续意味着保护行之有效的成果，纠正需要改进之处，并在既有进展基础上继续建设。”奥巴尼科罗介绍了哈姆扎特的资历，指出他28岁时便从英国克兰菲尔德大学取得系统过程工程博士学位，曾任职于美国的美林、摩根士丹利和花旗银行，并三度担任拉各斯州委员和副州长。他还列举了桑沃-奥卢政府的成就，包括蓝线和红线铁路、数百座完工的道路和桥梁、学校和医院改善、住房项目，以及对企业和青年的支持。竞选总干事说，候选人与竞选组织已广泛征求宗教领袖、传统统治者、市场女性、商人、青年、专业人士、工匠和社区领袖的意见。他说：“领导层必须先倾听，再行动。我们希望普通拉各斯居民的关切能够影响我们的优先事项。”他说，尽管由于席位有限，活动严格实行邀请制，但活动将于下午3时至5时在Channels TV、ARISE TV、TVC、LTV、News Central、YouTube、Facebook和Instagram直播。宣言展示结束后，公众可下载宣言进行研读，并通过党内渠道提供反馈。奥巴尼科罗说：“本次竞选的信息很明确：拉各斯，让我们携手向前。”掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家内幕和深度视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS WhatsApp频道，全天候获取最新消息 →

Unlock these with Subscription Eminent painter Jogen Chowdhury died at a private hospital in Kolkata on Sunday morning (October 25, 2026) following a prolonged battle with a rare blood cancer. He was 87. Watch | Peek into Jogen Chowdhury’s lifetime through his art exhibition in Mumbai Mr. Chowdhury, a former TMC MP, had been suffering from a myeloproliferative neoplasm, a rare type of blood cancer, for the past 14 months and was undergoing chemotherapy, Ruby General Hospital said in a statement. He was admitted to the hospital in southeast Kolkata on October 16 and breathed his last at 10.15 a.m., it said. Also read | In Jogen Chowdhury’s 80th year, an exhibition that celebrates the leading modern artist "It is with profound sadness that we announce the demise of Shri. Jogen Chowdhury, the renowned Indian painter," the hospital said. During the course of his illness, Mr. Chowdhury had also required hospitalisation for urinary tract infections, it added. Condoling his death, Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said Chowdhury's works would remain "immortal through the ages". Describing him as an artist of great stature, Mr. Adhikari said the body of work he had left behind was a treasure for the state and the nation. "Chowdhury's rich contributions are evident in numerous government buildings, including Rashtrapati Bhavan. The works he left behind will remain for centuries," he said. Former CM Mamata Banerjee said Mr. Chowdhury was the pride of Bengal and India. "A great inspiration to artists worldwide, and me personally. My condolences to his family, friends, and admirers all over the world," she said in a social media post. Ms. Banerjee recalled that he was elected to the Rajya Sabha on a Trinamool Congress ticket and served from 2014 to 2020, and that her government conferred the Banga Bibhushan, one of the State's highest civilian honours, on him in 2012. "His passing away will create an irreparable void in the world of art and culture," she said. Painter Samir Aich also mourned Mr. Chowdhury's death, describing it as a "personal loss". His passing marked the death of an art form in the country, including the Bengal School of Art, Aich said. Bengali writer Sirshendu Mukhopadhyay also mourned the painter's death, describing him as a longtime friend and associate. "Jogen was a long-term friend and associate, and I have memories of 'adda' with him. His death is a great loss," he said. Mr. Chowdhury also had a house in Santiniketan, where the region's red earth and distinctive landscape served as inspiration for his artworks. Born on February 16, 1939, in Daharpara village in Faridpur, then part of undivided Bengal, Mr. Chowdhury developed an early interest in art under the influence of his mother, who was skilled in 'alpana', a traditional form of floor art. During Partition, his family moved to Kolkata, where he received formal training in art. Mr. Chowdhury began his career as an art teacher at Howrah Zilla School before joining the Handloom Board in Kolkata as a designer in 1962. In the late 1960s, he went to Paris for higher studies at the Ecole Nationale Superieure des Beaux-Arts. He developed his distinctive artistic style after returning to India. Known for his unique visual language, Mr. Chowdhury drew inspiration from political and social themes as well as Indian and European art movements. 著名画家乔根·乔杜里在与一种罕见血癌长期抗争后，于2026年10月25日星期日上午在加尔各答一家私立医院去世，享年87岁。

观看｜通过在孟买举办的乔根·乔杜里艺术展，回顾他的一生

Ruby General Hospital在一份声明中表示，曾担任TMC国会议员的乔杜里先生过去14个月一直患有骨髓增殖性肿瘤，这是一种罕见的血癌，并接受了化疗。他于10月16日入住加尔各答东南部这家医院，于上午10时15分去世。

另请阅读｜在乔根·乔杜里80岁之际，一场展览向这位杰出的现代艺术家致敬

医院表示：“我们怀着深切的悲痛宣布，著名印度画家乔根·乔杜里先生逝世。”医院补充称，乔杜里先生在患病期间还曾因尿路感染住院。

首席部长苏文杜·阿迪卡里对乔杜里去世表示哀悼，称他的作品将“世代不朽”。阿迪卡里先生称乔杜里是一位成就卓著的艺术家，他留下的作品宝库是邦和国家的财富。他说：“乔杜里丰富的艺术贡献体现在众多政府建筑中，包括Rashtrapati Bhavan。他留下的作品将流传数百年。”

前首席部长马马塔·班纳吉表示，乔杜里先生是孟加拉邦和印度的骄傲。她在社交媒体帖子中写道：“他是世界各地艺术家以及我个人的一位伟大榜样。我向他的家人、朋友和全世界所有仰慕者致以慰问。”班纳吉女士回顾说，他曾以印度人民党候选人的身份当选联邦院议员，任职时间为2014年至2020年；她的政府于2012年授予他该邦最高荣誉之一“Banga Bibhushan”。她说：“他的离世将在艺术和文化领域留下无法弥补的空缺。”

画家萨米尔·艾奇也悼念乔杜里先生，称他的去世对个人而言是“一项损失”。艾奇说，他的离世意味着这个国家的一种艺术形式，包括孟加拉艺术流派，也随之消逝。孟加拉作家西尔申杜·穆克帕德亚也悼念这位画家的离世，称他是自己多年的朋友和伙伴。他说：“乔根是位长期交往的朋友和伙伴，我与他一起‘闲聊’的回忆至今仍历历在目。他的离世是一大损失。”

乔杜里先生在桑蒂尼凯坦也有一处住所，该地区的红土和独特风景曾为他的艺术作品带来灵感。他于1939年2月16日出生在当时仍属 undivided Bengal的法里德普尔县Daharpara村。在母亲的影响下，他 early 对艺术产生了兴趣；他的母亲精通“alpana”，这是一种传统的地面绘画艺术。印巴分治期间，他的家人迁居加尔各答，他在那里接受了正规的艺术训练。

乔杜里先生最初在Howrah Zilla School担任美术教师，1962年加入加尔各答手工艺委员会，担任设计师。20世纪60年代末，他赴巴黎，在Ecole Nationale Superieure des Beaux-Arts深造。回到印度后，他形成了独特的艺术风格。乔杜里先生以独特的视觉语言闻名，从政治和社会主题以及印度和欧洲艺术运动中汲取灵感。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: [COVER STORY] Kim Jong-un's China trip reaffirms 'blood ties' as Beijing watches Moscow
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un’s trip to the Chinese border city of Dandong, made days before the anniversary of Chinese troops entering the 1950-53 Korean War, was aimed at reaffirming the historic blood ties between the two countries at a moment when Pyongyang’s alignment with Moscow has drawn Beijing’s attention, experts said.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: experts: 朝鲜领导人金正恩访问中国边境城市丹东的行程安排在1950年至1953年朝鲜战争中国军队参战周年纪念日的前几天。专家表示，此举旨在两国重新确认历史上的血缘联系；此时，平壤与莫斯科的结盟已引起北京的关注。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un’s trip to the Chinese border city of Dandong, made days before the anniversary of Chinese troops entering the 1950-53 Korean War, was aimed at reaffirming the historic blood ties between the two countries at a moment when Pyongyang’s alignment with Moscow has drawn Beijing’s attention, experts said. North's state-run Rodong Sinmun on Sunday reported Kim's visit to the Memorial Hall of the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea in Dandong the previous day. The state media repeatedly emphasized Kim's paying tribute to fallen Chinese troops, remembering their shared history of fighting alongside North Korean forces and preserving ties forged in blood. Kang Dong-wan, a professor of North Korean studies at Dong-A University, said the focus on China’s role in the war was deliberate, coming after a period in which the Beijing relationship had weakened relative to Pyongyang’s deepening partnership with Moscow, including the North’s troop deployment to Russia. "Kim's decision to visit the Memorial Hall among other possible destinations appears to intend to highlight the historic blood ties between North Korea and China," Kang said. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, read the visit as carrying a message beyond the bilateral relationship. "North Korea and China reaffirmed their shared history of fighting against the U.S. and their blood-forged alliance," he said, underlining North Korean media's repeated emphasis on their blood ties. Kim did not meet Chinese President Xi Jinping during the trip. He instead held talks with Wang Huning, China’s fourth-ranking official, who chairs the National Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference and sits on the Standing Committee of the Communist Party’s Political Bureau, along with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi. Kang said the absence of a Xi meeting was unremarkable given the trip’s purpose. "As Kim sought to express gratitude to China and reaffirm bilateral friendship, a meeting with Xi was not the main purpose of the visit in the first place," he explained, pointing to scheduling issues. "Chinese Communist Party's fifth plenum is reportedly scheduled for next week. This could have contributed to the absence of not only Xi but also Chinese Premier Li Qiang, who had originally been reported to welcome Kim," Hong said. Kim’s day trip drew attention for the route he took — the New Amnok River Bridge, which opened on Oct. 15 after more than a decade of delay. The two countries agreed to build it in 2010, and China completed construction in 2014, but the crossing sat unused for years because the North Korean side lacked connecting roads and customs facilities. "This demonstrates that Kim can now visit China for strategic consultations within a single day, allowing for more frequent high-level exchanges between the two countries," Hong said. The route also carries an economic message, signaling Pyongyang's willingness to strengthen trade ties with Beijing. "By personally endorsing the full operation of the New Amnok River Bridge, Kim demonstrated his commitment to expanding cross-border trade and economic cooperation," said Yang Moo-jin, a distinguished professor at the University of North Korean Studies in Seoul. While some experts say the possibility of talks between Kim and U.S. President Donald Trump cannot be ruled out, particularly ahead of the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in November, others remain skeptical. With renewed dialogue between Washington and Pyongyang being discussed and given Kim's multiple visits to China during his talks with Trump between 2018 and 2019, it is difficult to rule out a possible link between his latest visit and potential Trump-Kim talks. "Given Wang Huning's close ties to Xi Jinping, indirect communication between Kim and Xi may have taken place through Wang," said Yang. He also did not rule out the possibility of Wang visiting Pyongyang as Xi's special envoy or Kim being invited to China around the APEC summit. However, others evaluated the likelihood of a Trump-Kim meeting low. "It is highly unlikely that Kim discussed a potential meeting with Trump during his visit to China," said Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Kyungnam University's Institute for Far Eastern Studies. "There is little circumstantial evidence suggesting that Kim is acting with a potential U.S.-North Korea summit or his negotiating leverage in mind." Hong also said there was no clear indication linking Kim's latest visit to the possibility of renewed talks with Washington
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 【封面故事】金正恩访华重申“血缘纽带”，北京观望莫斯科
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 专家表示，朝鲜领导人金正恩在中国边境城市丹东的行程安排在中国军队进入1950年至1953年朝鲜战争纪念日前夕，旨在两国与莫斯科的靠拢引发北京关注之际，重新确认两国之间的历史血缘纽带。朝鲜国家经营的《劳动新闻》周日报道称，金正恩前一天参观了丹东的抗美援朝纪念馆。朝鲜官方媒体反复强调，金正恩向阵亡的中国烈士致敬，缅怀双方并肩抗击朝鲜军队的共同历史，维系以鲜血铸就的纽带。东亚大学朝鲜研究所教授姜东万表示，聚焦中国在战争中的作用是经过深思熟虑的。此前，在朝鲜深化与莫斯科伙伴关系（包括向俄罗斯部署朝鲜军队）之际，北京与朝鲜的关系相对减弱。姜东万说：“在众多可选目的地中，金正恩决定参观纪念馆，显然意在突出朝鲜与中国的历史血缘纽带。”韩国统一研究院高级研究员洪民认为，此访除传递双边关系信息外，还含有更深层含义。他说：“朝鲜和中国重申了共同抗击美国的历史以及以鲜血铸成的联盟。”他强调，朝鲜媒体反复突出双方的血缘纽带。此次行程中，金正恩没有会见中国国家主席习近平，而是与中国排名第四的王沪宁以及中国外交部长王毅进行了会谈。王沪宁担任中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会主席，并任中国共产党政治局常务委员会委员。姜东万说，鉴于此访目的，未安排金正恩与习近平会面并不令人意外。他解释道：“金正恩寻求向中国表达感谢并重申双边友好，因此从一开始，与习近平会面就不是此访的主要目的。”他指出，日程安排也是影响因素。洪民说：“据报道，中国共产党第五次全体会议计划于下周举行。这或许不仅导致习近平未能出席，也导致原定欢迎金正恩的中国国务院总理李强未能现身。”金正恩的当日行程因其所经路线而引人关注，即新鸭绿江大桥。该桥于10月15日开放，经历了十多年延误。两国于2010年同意修建该桥，中国于2014年完成建设，但由于朝鲜一侧缺乏连接道路和海关设施，这座跨境大桥多年未能投入使用。洪民说：“这表明金正恩如今可以在一天之内赴中国进行战略磋商，从而为两国之间更频繁的高层交流创造条件。”这条路线还传递出经济层面的信息，显示平壤愿意加强与北京的贸易关系。首尔大学朝鲜研究院特聘教授杨穆镇说：“金正恩亲自支持新鸭绿江大桥全面运营，表明他致力于扩大跨境贸易和经济合作。”一些专家认为，尤其考虑到11月即将举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会，金正恩与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普会谈的可能性无法排除；另一些人则持怀疑态度。随着华盛顿与平壤重新展开对话的讨论不断深入，加上金正恩曾在2018年至2019年与特朗普会谈期间多次访问中国，因此很难排除此次最新访问与潜在特朗普—金正恩会谈之间存在联系。杨穆镇说：“鉴于王沪宁与习近平关系密切，金正恩与习近平之间可能通过王沪宁进行了间接沟通。”他也没有排除王沪宁作为习近平特使访问平壤，或金正恩在亚太经济合作组织峰会前后获邀访华的可能性。不过 Others 对特朗普与金正恩会面的可能性评估较低。庆南大学远东研究所教授林日哲说：“金正恩在访华期间讨论与特朗普潜在会面的可能性极低。”“几乎没有间接证据表明，金正恩此次行动考虑了潜在的美朝峰会或他的谈判筹码。”洪民还表示，没有明确迹象将金正恩此次最新访问与恢复同华盛顿对话的可能性联系起来

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title: Nearly half of new Korean AI services based on Chinese foundation models
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: According to a recent report by think tank Rockbridge Network Korea, Sunday, 49.3 percent of the 1,845 models published by Korea-based accounts on Hugging Face between January and August were based on Chinese models, compared with 35.9 percent based on U.S. models and 14.9 percent on domestic models. The share of new models built on Chinese foundations has been rapidly growing in past years, surging from 1.2 percent in 2023 to 22 percent in 2025, before nearly doubling this year.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 韩国智库Rockbridge Network Korea最近发布的一份报告显示，在韩国机构今年1月至8月于Hugging Face发布的1,845个模型中，49.3%以中国模型为基础，35.9%以美国模型为基础，14.9%基于韩国国内模型。近年来，以中国模型为基础构建的新模型占比迅速增长，从2023年的1.2%跃升至2025年的22%，今年又几乎翻了一番。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: According to a recent report by think tank Rockbridge Network Korea, Sunday, 49.3 percent of the 1,845 models published by Korea-based accounts on Hugging Face between January and August were based on Chinese models, compared with 35.9 percent based on U.S. models and 14.9 percent on domestic models. The share of new models built on Chinese foundations has been rapidly growing in past years, surging from 1.2 percent in 2023 to 22 percent in 2025, before nearly doubling this year. Qwen was the most widely used foundation model, accounting for 46.8 percent of the total, or 864 models. Google's Gemma ranked second with 14.7 percent, followed by Meta's Llama with 13.8 percent. LG AI Research's EXAONE ranked fourth at 9.3 percent, while Kakao's Kanana accounted for 2.7 percent. Popular AI foundation models, such as OpenAI's GPT, Anthropic's Claude and Google's Gemini, are closed models whose underlying weights are not publicly available. In contrast, Alibaba's Qwen and Google's Gemma allow developers to download and modify the models for their own purposes. Such models, known as open-weight models, are easier to adapt for specific applications thanks to their publicly available weights, including through fine-tuning with Korean-language data, without relying on cloud-based AI services. The report noted that low costs and a wide range of available models have made Chinese models attractive to Korean developers. Alibaba's Qwen offers models ranging from small versions to large-scale systems and supports 119 languages. Its extensive ecosystem of derivative models, tools and applications also gives developers greater flexibility in adapting the technology. The report found that Chinese models' output costs were about one-34th those of comparable top-tier models, although the cost advantage narrowed to about fourfold when measured across a full benchmark run. “The rapid adoption of Chinese open-weight models, including Qwen, reflects their growing use in lightweight experiments and day-to-day development work,” an industry official said. The growing use of Chinese models nevertheless raises concerns about technological dependence. Alibaba offers both AI models and cloud infrastructure, potentially making it harder for developers to move away from its ecosystem as Qwen adoption grows. “The biggest concern (in the rapid adoption) is not simply just information leaks, but the risk of technological dependence and supply-chain vulnerabilities,” the official said. Security is another concern. In the report's survey on 102 small and medium-sized companies, 80.2 percent cited potential data leaks as a concern about Chinese AI models, while 67.7 percent pointed to a lack of transparency in personal data handling. Industry officials cautioned that the opaque origins of training data in open-weight models could make it difficult for companies to meet strict requirements for AI safety, reliability and compliance. “Rather than deepening reliance on external models in pursuit of short-term cost efficiency, Korea needs a two-track strategy that builds its own secure and reliable foundation models to safeguard technological sovereignty,” the official said. “Building good models is important, but building a strong ecosystem together is even more important.”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title: Kim's China visit must lead to restraint
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un’s surprise visit to China is a reminder that the Korean Peninsula’s future cannot be understood through inter-Korean relations alone. For South Korea, the appropriate response is neither alarmism nor wishful thinking, but rather a clear-eyed assessment of what closer ties between China and North Korea could mean for regional security, sanctions enforcement and diplomacy. The visit carried both historical symbolism and practical economic significance.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary_zh: 朝鲜领导人金正恩突然访问中国，提醒人们仅凭韩朝关系无法理解朝鲜半岛的未来。对韩国而言，适当的回应既不是危言耸听，也不是一厢情愿，而是清醒评估中朝关系加深将如何影响地区安全、制裁执行和外交。此次访问兼具历史象征意义和实际经济意义。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un’s surprise visit to China is a reminder that the Korean Peninsula’s future cannot be understood through inter-Korean relations alone. Kim's crossing into Dandong via the newly opened New Amnok River Bridge and his meetings with senior Chinese official Wang Huning underscore the strategic importance Pyongyang attaches to Beijing. For South Korea, the appropriate response is neither alarmism nor wishful thinking, but rather a clear-eyed assessment of what closer ties between China and North Korea could mean for regional security, sanctions enforcement and diplomacy. The visit carried both historical symbolism and practical economic significance. Kim paid tribute to China’s participation in the Korean War and toured an automobile factory with Wang, who conveyed greetings from Chinese President Xi Jinping. The itinerary highlighted a relationship grounded in shared history but increasingly shaped by material interests. Notably, however, Kim did not meet Xi. The visit should therefore be judged on what it demonstrably achieved, not inflated into evidence of a diplomatic breakthrough that has yet to materialize. The new bridge merits particular scrutiny. Better transport links can facilitate legitimate trade, sustain livelihoods and ease North Korea’s isolation. Economic engagement is not inherently inimical to peace. Its implications, however, depend on what crosses the border and whether transactions are properly monitored. Beijing must ensure that deeper economic cooperation remains consistent with its international obligations and does not create new channels for prohibited transfers that could advance Pyongyang’s weapons programs. China cannot credibly champion regional stability while treating North Korea’s military provocations as a problem for others to manage. Its renewed access to Kim’s leadership presents an opportunity to discourage escalation, encourage communication and reinforce the costs of confrontation. Beijing need not sever ties with Pyongyang to exercise such influence. On the contrary, it should recognize that an increasingly volatile peninsula threatens the economic and strategic interests that closer bilateral relations are meant to serve. Kim, too, should recognize the limits of a foreign policy built around powerful patrons. Stronger relations with China and Russia may expand his diplomatic options and provide economic or strategic support, but they cannot deliver lasting security or broad-based prosperity on their own. A strategy that seeks external assistance while excluding South Korea from meaningful dialogue would only entrench the peninsula’s division. Sustainable economic development requires predictability, and predictability is impossible when the risk of military conflict remains high. Seoul must respond with equal resolve and strategic discipline. Robust deterrence and close coordination with Washington remain indispensable. But deterrence should create space for diplomacy, not become a substitute for it. South Korea should maintain active channels with Beijing, pursue practical cooperation on crisis prevention and assess closer China-North Korea ties by their actual consequences. A measurable reduction in military threats would be welcome. Any use of enhanced cooperation to embolden coercion would require a firm and coordinated response. Nor should Seoul define diplomatic progress solely by whether Kim meets U.S. President Donald Trump again. Speculation about another summit should not be mistaken for a confirmed diplomatic process. A hastily arranged encounter could produce striking images and short-lived optimism without yielding durable commitments. Any renewed negotiations must include close consultation with Seoul and focus on concrete, verifiable measures to reduce nuclear dangers and prevent miscalculation. The immediate priority should be to restore military communication, prevent incidents along the border and preserve avenues for humanitarian engagement. Such steps would not resolve the nuclear question, but they could address one of the peninsula’s most dangerous vulnerabilities: the absence of reliable mechanisms for managing confrontation. Seoul should advance these proposals without assuming that Pyongyang will accept them readily. An offer of dialogue is a strategic choice, not a guarantee of reciprocity. Kim’s journey across the Amnok River demonstrates that North Korea will open doors when its leadership sees an advantage. The challenge is to turn selective engagement into a broader contribution to regional security. Beijing should use its influence responsibly, Pyongyang should reconsider the costs of sustained hostility and Seoul should pair credible deterrence with sustained diplomatic initiative. A bridge can connect two banks; only prudent policy can make it a passage toward peace
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title_zh: 金正恩访华必须带来克制
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 朝鲜领导人金正恩突然访问中国，再次表明，仅凭韩朝关系无法理解朝鲜半岛的未来。金正恩经新通车的鸭绿江大桥进入丹东，并会见中国高级官员王沪宁，凸显平壤赋予北京的重要战略意义。对韩国而言，适当的回应既不是危言耸听，也不是一厢情愿，而是清醒评估中朝关系走近可能给地区安全、制裁执行和外交带来何种影响。此次访问既具有历史象征意义，也具有实际经济意义。金正恩向中国参加朝鲜战争一事致敬，并与王沪宁一同参观汽车工厂；王沪宁转达了中国国家主席习近平的问候。访问日程凸显了两国关系建立在共同历史之上，但正日益受到现实利益影响。然而，金正恩此次并未与习近平会面。因此，应根据此次访问切实取得的成果来评价它，而不应将其夸大为迄今尚未实现的外交突破。新桥尤其值得审视。更便利的交通连接能够促进合法贸易、维持民生并缓解朝鲜的孤立。经济接触本身并不必然与和平相悖。然而，其影响取决于跨境流通的是什么，以及相关交易是否得到妥善监督。北京必须确保，更深入的经济合作符合其国际义务，不会为被禁止的转让行为开辟新渠道，从而推动平壤的武器计划。中国不能一面标榜维护地区稳定，一面把朝鲜的军事挑衅当成应由他人处理的问题。重新接触金正恩领导层，为中国创造了劝阻局势升级、鼓励沟通并强化对抗代价的机会。北京无须切断与平壤的关系，便能发挥这种影响。相反，中国应当认识到，日益动荡的朝鲜半岛会威胁更密切的双边关系本应服务的经济和战略利益。金正恩也应认识到，围绕强大靠山构建外交政策的局限。改善与中国和俄罗斯的关系或许能扩大他的外交选择，并提供经济或战略支持，但这些关系本身无法带来持久安全或广泛繁荣。寻求外部援助、却将韩国排除在实质性对话之外的战略，只会进一步固化半岛分裂。可持续经济发展需要可预测性，而军事冲突风险依然高企时，可预测性便无从谈起。首尔必须以同等决心和战略纪律作出回应。有效的威慑以及与华盛顿密切协调仍不可或缺。但威慑应当为外交创造空间，而不是取代外交。韩国应保持与北京的活跃沟通渠道，就危机预防开展务实合作，并根据中朝关系走近的实际后果加以评估。若军事威胁得到可量化减少，将是值得欢迎的成果。任何利用加强后的合作来助长胁迫的行为，都将需要坚决且协调一致的回应。首尔也不应仅以金正恩是否再次会见美国总统唐纳德·特朗普来界定外交进展。关于再次举行峰会的猜测，不应被误认为已确认的外交进程。仓促安排会晤可能制造醒目的画面和短暂的乐观情绪，却不会产生持久承诺。任何重启的谈判都必须包括与首尔的密切磋商，并聚焦于降低核危险和防止误判的具体、可核查措施。眼下的优先事项应是恢复军事沟通、防止边境发生意外事件，以及为人道主义接触保留渠道。这些举措无法解决核问题，但可以处理半岛上最危险的脆弱性之一：缺乏管理对抗局势的可靠机制。首尔应推动这些提议，同时不假定平壤会欣然接受。提出对话是一项战略选择，并不保证对方会予以回应。金正恩跨越鸭绿江的行程表明，当朝鲜领导层看到有利条件时，朝鲜愿意打开大门。挑战在于把有选择的接触转化为对地区安全的更广泛贡献。北京应负责任地运用影响力，平壤应重新审视持续敌对的代价，首尔则应把可信的威慑与持续的外交倡议结合起来。桥梁能够连接两岸；只有审慎的政策才能使其成为通往和平的通道

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Hyundai Motor and Kia's combined retail sales in China fell below 10,000 vehicles for the first time this year in September amid sluggish demand, industry data showed Sunday. Hyundai Motor's sales plunged 47 percent on-year to around 4,000 units last month, while Kia's dropped 31 percent to 5,000, according to a Hana Securities report based on China Passenger Car Association (CPCA) data.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 行业数据显示，本周四，现代汽车和起亚在中国的合计零售量9月首次跌破1万辆，原因是需求疲软。据韩亚证券根据中国乘用车协会（CPCA）数据出具的报告，现代汽车上月销量同比下降47%，降至约4,000辆；起亚销量下降31%，降至5,000辆。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Hyundai Motor and Kia's combined retail sales in China fell below 10,000 vehicles for the first time this year in September amid sluggish demand, industry data showed Sunday. Hyundai Motor's sales plunged 47 percent on-year to around 4,000 units last month, while Kia's dropped 31 percent to 5,000, according to a Hana Securities report based on China Passenger Car Association (CPCA) data. Their combined sales fell 39 percent to approximately 9,000 units, with their market share slipping to just 0.6 percent from more than 10 percent in the mid-2010s. The automakers have struggled to revive sales despite introducing electric vehicles (EVs) tailored to the Chinese market. Hyundai's China-specific electric SUV Elexio sold just 251 units in the first nine months of this year, compared with 1,216 in the final three months of last year. The Ioniq V, Hyundai's first China-specific model under its Ioniq brand, sold 558 units in September

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title: Korea's temporary jobs fall to 31-year Q3 low
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: The number of temporary and daily workers in Korea fell to its lowest third-quarter level in 31 years amid a prolonged construction slump, government data showed Sunday. The combined figure dropped by 95,000 from a year earlier to 5.73 million in the July-September period, the lowest third-quarter level since 1995, according to an analysis of microdata from the Ministry of Data and Statistics.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 政府数据周日显示，受建筑业长期低迷影响，韩国临时工和日工的就业人数降至31年来第三季度最低水平。根据对数据与统计部微观数据的分析，两类工人的合计人数同比减少9.5万，在7月至9月期间降至573万，为1995年以来第三季度最低水平。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: The number of temporary and daily workers in Korea fell to its lowest third-quarter level in 31 years amid a prolonged construction slump, government data showed Sunday. The combined figure dropped by 95,000 from a year earlier to 5.73 million in the July-September period, the lowest third-quarter level since 1995, according to an analysis of microdata from the Ministry of Data and Statistics. Of the total, the number of daily workers fell by 38,000 to a record third-quarter low of 833,000, largely due to weak employment in the construction sector. Daily construction workers declined by 28,000 to 381,000, accounting for 74.6 percent of the overall drop. Those in their 50s saw the sharpest decline, down 21,000. The number of temporary workers, whose contracts last at least one month but less than a year, fell by 57,000 to 4.89 million in the three-month period. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: At the first Korea Book Festival in Vancouver, Canada, which runs through Oct. 31, a very meaningful book was exhibited: "Jessie’s Diary," reborn as a graphic novel. On Oct. 8, a session was held where readers read the original work and shared their impressions, receiving a great response. The graphic novel has been introduced in French, Chinese and Japanese, and preparations are underway to publish an English edition of the original work as well. "Jessie’s Diary" is a child-rearing journal kept for eight years, beginning in 1938 with the birth of the couple’s eldest daughter, Jessie, by Yang Woo-jo (1897-1964) and Choe Seon-hwa (1911-2003), a husband and wife who participated in the Korean Provisional Government. Alongside their deep love for their family, the diary chronicles the provisional government’s life in exile, the daily lives of independence activists and anecdotes about prominent figures in the independence movement, including Kim Gu and Ahn Chang-ho. It has been recognized for its historical value. The diary came to public attention in 1999 when Kim Hyun-ju, 54, the couple’s granddaughter and the daughter of Jessie Yang, the diary’s namesake, published it as a book. Kim currently lives in the United States and serves on the board of the Fremont Union High School District in California. In a recent telephone interview, she recalled her first encounter with the journal: “When I first saw the diary, written so carefully, one character at a time, it felt as though my maternal grandfather, whom I had never met, had come back to life.” Kim learned of the diary in 1998, when she was pregnant with her first child. Her maternal grandmother, Choe Seon-hwa, entrusted her with an old brown journal she had carefully preserved. The lives and convictions of her grandparents, preserved in its pages, deeply moved her. Having worked as a broadcast writer, Kim modernized archaic expressions and Chinese-derived words and added vivid recollections she had heard directly from her grandmother before compiling the material into a book. The publication celebration was especially meaningful, bringing together four generations of women: Choe, Jessie Yang, Kim and Kim’s first daughter, who was about 100 days old at the time. The diary also changed the course of Kim’s life. After moving to San Francisco in 2000 to accompany her husband for his job, she became involved in Korean history and cultural education. At the time, even finding books about Korea in American libraries was difficult. She approached the Korean school her children attended and began teaching discussion-based history classes for middle school students in 2007, staying up through the night to prepare teaching materials. She eventually became a vice principal and then a principal. Another experience also sparked her interest in history education. She discovered that "So Far from the Bamboo Grove," a book centered on a Japanese girl near the end of World War II that portrays Japanese people as victims and Koreans as aggressors, was being used as instructional material in some California schools. “I was deeply shocked when I heard that a Korean American student who had read the book felt ashamed of being Korean,” Kim said. Working with fellow Korean school teachers and other members of the Korean American community, Kim urged education authorities to remove "So Far from the Bamboo Grove" from the list of instructional materials. In 2008, at the publisher’s request, the school district board finally voted to remove the book. “I sobbed in the bathroom all by myself because I thought of my grandparents. I felt that this was why I had come to America.” Since 2009, Kim has organized seminars on Korean history and culture for American teachers. Around 2012, she and Korean school teachers established the educational organization Echo Korea. She also runs the Young Korean American Academy, a summer camp for young people. “I want to help Korean American students take pride in their roots while growing into members of American society,” she said. Kim was first elected to the school district board in 2018 and won reelection in 2022. She is seeking a third term in the election on Nov. 3. Her dream is to one day meet her maternal grandparents and mother in heaven and proudly tell them about the path she has taken. “My life’s mission is to carry on the spirit of the Korean independence movement. I will continue moving forward, using my grandparents’ lives as my compass.” This article from the Hankook Ilbo, the sister publication of The Korea Times, is translated by a generative AI system and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国独立运动人士的孙女将韩国历史带入美国学校
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 在加拿大温哥华举行的首届韩国书展将持续至10月31日，展出了一本意义非凡的书：以图像小说形式重新问世的《Jessie的日记》。10月8日，活动现场举办了一场读书会，读者朗读原作并分享感想反响热烈。这本图像小说已推出法语、中文和日语版本，英文版原作也正在筹备出版。《Jessie的日记》是一本育儿日记，记录了8年的家庭生活，从1938年夫妇二人的长女Jessie出生写起。这对夫妇是杨宇柱（1897-1964）和崔孙花（1911-2003），他们曾参加韩国临时政府。除了对家人的深厚感情，日记还记录了临时政府流亡期间的生活、独立活动人士的日常生活，以及金九、安昌浩等独立运动杰出人物的故事，其历史价值已获认可。1999年，这本日记为公众所知，当时夫妇二人的外孙女、日记主人公Jessie Yang之女、54岁的金贤珠将其出版成书。金目前居住在美国，担任加利福尼亚州弗里蒙特联合高中学区董事会成员。最近接受电话采访时，她回忆第一次看到这本日记的情景：“当我第一次看到这本日记时，里面的一字一句都写得那么工整细致，我仿佛觉得从未见过的外祖父又回到了人间。”金是在1998年怀第一个孩子时得知这本日记的。外祖母崔孙花将一本珍藏多年的旧棕色日记交给她。祖辈的人生与信念在日记篇章中得以保存，深深打动了她。金曾从事广播撰稿工作，并为编纂成书 modernize了陈旧表达和源自汉语的词语，还补入了从外祖母本人那里听来的生动回忆。出版庆祝活动尤其意义非凡，因为它让一家四代女性相聚在一起：崔孙花、Jessie Yang、金贤珠，以及当时年仅约100天大的金的第一个女儿。这本日记也改变了金的人生轨迹。2000年，她随丈夫赴旧金山照顾其工作，随后开始参与韩国历史与文化教育。当时，即便是在美国的图书馆里也很难找到有关韩国的书籍。她找到孩子们就读的韩国学校，自2007年起为初中生开设以讨论为主的历史课程，并熬夜准备教学资料。她后来先后担任副校长和校长。另一次经历也激起了她对历史教育的兴趣。她发现，一部以第二次世界大战末期一名日本女孩为中心、把日本人描绘为受害者而把韩国人描绘为侵略者的作品《远方的竹丛》竟被一些加利福尼亚州学校用作教材。“听说一名读过这本书的韩裔美国学生为自己是韩国人感到羞耻时，我深受震撼。”金说。她与韩国学校的其他教师及韩裔美国社群成员共同敦促教育主管部门将《远方的竹丛》从教学材料清单中删除。2008年，应出版方要求，学区董事会终于表决决定移除该书。“我想起祖父母，独自在浴室里放声大哭。我觉得，这正是我来美国的意义。”自2009年起，金一直为美国教师组织韩国历史与文化研讨会。约在2012年，她与韩国学校教师共同成立了教育组织Echo Korea。她还运营青年韩裔美国学院，这是一个面向青少年的夏令营。她说：“我希望帮助韩裔美国学生为自己的根源感到自豪，同时成长为美国社会的一员。”金于2018年首次当选学区董事会成员，并在2022年成功连任。她正在争取11月3日选举中的第三个任期。她的梦想是有一天能在天堂与外祖父母和母亲相见，并自豪地告诉他们自己走过的人生道路。“我的人生使命是延续韩国独立运动的精神。我会以祖辈的人生为指南针，继续向前。”本文来自《韩国时报》的姊妹报《韩国先驱报》，由生成式人工智能系统翻译，并经《韩国时报》编辑。

The State government has released ₹306 crore for drinking water supply and other drought-relief works. Speaking to reporters during his visit to Shivamogga on Sunday (October 25, 2026), Mr. Khandre said that, in addition to this amount, the Deputy Commissioners also had sufficient funds at their disposal. “The State government is well prepared to handle the drought. Officers have been instructed to ensure drinking water supply either through tankers or by hiring private borewells. “There is no need to worry. Unlock these with Subscription Former Minister and BJP State vice-president Harathalu Halappa has urged the State government to supply electricity to agricultural pump sets for at least seven to eight hours during the day, as farmers are struggling to save their crops amid severe drought. He warned that the party would intensify its agitation if the demand was not met. In a press conference in Shivamogga on Saturday (October 24, 2026) Mr. Halappa said farmers in Hosanagara, Sagar, Sorab, Shivamogga Rural and Ripponpet, among other places in the district, were facing disruptions in power supply. Owing to the weak monsoon, standing crops such as paddy and maize are drying up, and areca plantations also faced the threat of damage due to water shortage. “Earlier, farmers received seven hours of power a day. Officers now say they have received instructions from senior officials to supply six hours. In reality, however, even this is not supplied continuously, as power is cut for 30 to 45 minutes at a time, so farmers do not get the full supply.” Officers have not responded to requests to provide the lost hours later, he alleged. Since pump sets receive power only at night, farmers around Ripponpet in Hosanagara taluk have to go to their farms after dark to irrigate their plantations, despite the threat from wild elephants in the area. There have been fatalities in elephant attacks in the past, he said. Farmers in the area had staged protests demanding daytime power for their safety. Mr. Halappa also pointed out that vacancies in the Mangalore Electricity Supply Company (MESCOM) were contributing to the problem. The shortage of officers and linemen was affecting the maintenance and repair of power lines. He called for steps to ensure adequate power supply before the situation worsens in the coming summer, and warned that the party would intensify its protests across the district if the government did not respond. WASHINGTON, USA – Nonpartisan analysts say Democrats stand a good chance of winning the US House of Representatives and possibly the Senate in the November 3 midterm elections , which would give them a slice of power in Washington after two years of Republican control. Democrats argue that Republicans have allowed President Donald Trump ‘s administration to declare war and control spending, even though the US Constitution reserves those powers for lawmakers. Here are some ways a Democratic Congress could hem in Trump’s foreign policy. Trump did not secure approval from Congress before he launched the war with Iran on February 28 , and Democrats have voted repeatedly to end the fighting unless he does so. One of these resolutions passed with support from a handful of Republicans, but Trump’s administration ignored it. With control of the House or the Senate, Democrats could cut defense spending to pressure Trump to obtain permission from Congress to continue the war. They could also require administration officials to testify publicly about their plans. Trump has largely halted direct US financial and military aid to Ukraine, despite broad support from Democratic and Republican lawmakers as it fights a Russian invasion . Most recently, he has angered members of Congress, including many Republicans, by lifting sanctions on Russian diesel and waiving sanctions on Russian energy only weeks after signing them into law. With a victory in both chambers in November, Democrats would be able to decide what gets voted on and when. That could allow them to approve new aid to Ukraine, which likely would pass with the two-thirds majorities needed to overcome a Trump veto. They could also target other Trump activities. For example, Representative Gregory Meeks of New York, who could head the House Foreign Affairs Committee if Democrats win control, has introduced bipartisan legislation to block Trump’s plan to bring Russian diesel back into the global market. Support for Israel has plummeted among Democrats over its conduct in the Gaza war, which has killed tens of thousands of Palestinian civilians. The ongoing violence in the Israeli-occupied West Bank and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s close alliance with Republicans have also been factors. Democrats could limit or end military aid to Israel, which amounted to $3.8 billion in the most recent fiscal year. That is more than was provided to any other country. Nearly half of House Democrats voted this summer to cut off aid to Israel. Some of those who voted against that effort, such as Meeks, have backed limits on providing weapons like heavy bombs to Israel. Democrats are far more likely than Trump’s Republicans to limit military spending. Trump asked for an unprecedented 67% increase in the military budget this year, to $1.5 trillion, but Democrats blocked it in the Senate, citing his refusal to consult Congress about the Iran war and his steep cuts to social programs. Trump has also withheld or canceled billions of dollars in foreign aid approved by Congress. Many Democrats have been angered by the cuts and say they will try to restore funding. https://www.rappler.com/world/us-canada/.body_zh: 已经订阅Rappler+？登录即可收听开创性的新闻报道。2026年10月17日，在美国佛罗里达州“The Villages”举行的一场民主党集会上，一名男子坐在高尔夫球车里，手持“投民主党一票”的标牌。美国华盛顿——无党派分析人士表示，在11月3日的中期选举中，民主党很有可能赢得美国众议院，甚至可能赢得参议院。共和党掌控华盛顿两年后，这将使民主党获得部分权力。民主党称，共和党纵容唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府宣战并控制开支，尽管美国宪法将这些权力留给立法者。以下是民主党国会可能限制特朗普外交政策的几种方式。2月28日，特朗普在对伊朗发动战争前未获得国会批准，而民主党已多次投票要求结束战斗，除非他取得批准。其中一项决议在少数共和党人支持下获得通过，但特朗普政府置之不理。若掌控众议院或参议院，民主党便可削减国防开支，迫使特朗普取得国会许可才能继续战争。他们还可以要求政府官员公开就其计划作证。尽管民主党和共和党议员普遍支持乌克兰抵御俄罗斯入侵，特朗普仍基本停止了美国对乌克兰的直接财政和军事援助。最近，他解除对俄罗斯柴油的制裁，并豁免对俄罗斯能源的制裁，从而激怒了包括许多共和党人在内的国会议员；就在几周前，他才刚将这些制裁签署成法。若民主党11月赢得两院控制权，就能决定哪些事项付诸表决以及何时表决。这可能使他们批准新的对乌援助，而该援助很可能以克服特朗普否决权所需的三分之二多数获得通过。他们还可以针对特朗普的其他行动。例如，如果民主党赢得控制权，纽约州众议员格雷戈里·米克斯可能出任众议院外交事务委员会主席；他已提出两党立法，阻止特朗普让俄罗斯柴油重新进入全球市场的计划。以色列在加沙战争中的行为造成数以万计的巴勒斯坦平民死亡，民主党人对支持以色列的态度已大幅降温。以色列占领的约旦河西岸持续发生暴力事件，加上以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡与共和党人的紧密联盟，也都是促成这一变化的因素。民主党可能限制或终止对以色列的军事援助。最近一个财年，对以军援总额为38亿美元，高于向任何其他国家提供的金额。今年夏天，近一半众议院民主党人投票赞成切断对以色列的援助。其中一些反对该举动的人，如米克斯，也支持限制向以色列提供重型炸弹等武器。与特朗普旗下的共和党人相比，民主党更有可能限制军事开支。特朗普今年要求将军费预算前所未有地提高67%，增至1.5万亿美元，但民主党以他拒绝就伊朗战争与国会协商，以及大幅削减社会项目开支为由，在参议院阻止了该预算。特朗普还扣留或取消了国会批准的数十亿美元对外援助。许多民主党人因这些削减而愤怒，并表示将设法恢复资金。升级至Rappler+，即可享受独家内容和无限访问权限
