https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/25/e.body: The Lagos State Government has intensified preparedness against Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) following the confirmation of an index case in Abuja, upgrading its isolation centre and targeting laboratory test results within 24 hours. The state Commissioner for Health, Prof. Akin Abayomi, disclosed this in a statement, saying Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu had directed relevant agencies to maintain a high level of alertness and preparedness. Abayomi said Lagos was treating the situation as a priority because of the constant movement of people between Lagos and Abuja. He said the state’s Emergency Operations Centre had been working ahead of the confirmed case, with teams conducting simulation exercises to ensure responders understood their roles. According to him, the state’s isolation centre has been upgraded, while additional capacity is being developed. Training for health workers in public and private facilities is also ongoing, with emphasis on infection prevention and control. The commissioner said the state was establishing a clear pathway for laboratory testing, targeting results within 24 hours. “Our isolation centre has been upgraded, and additional capacity is ongoing,” Abayomi said. “We are defining a clear pathway from sample to result, targeting results within 24 hours.” He added that a dedicated Ebola Research Committee was reviewing the latest evidence on treatments and vaccines to guide decisions. Abayomi said the state was also refining screening at airports and other points of entry in collaboration with federal partners. He noted that disease surveillance was being digitally enhanced on SHIP to improve the detection, tracing and real-time response to suspected cases. The commissioner urged residents to wash their hands regularly with soap and water and avoid contact with the blood and body fluids of anyone who was ill. He advised anyone experiencing fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhoea or unexplained bleeding, or who suspected exposure to the virus, not to self-medicate but to call health authorities before visiting a health facility. Abayomi also urged health workers to maintain a high index of suspicion, ask patients about their travel history and use personal protective equipment. Residents were advised to report suspected cases or exposure through the Lagos State emergency numbers, 112 and 767, or the Directorate of Epidemiology, Biosecurity and Global Health on 0802 316 9485. He urged residents to remain calm, stay alert and rely on official information from the Lagos State Ministry of Health. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/25/e.body_zh: 拉各斯州政府在阿布贾确认首例病例后，加强了应对埃博拉病毒病（EVD）的准备工作，升级隔离中心，并力争在24小时内出具实验室检测结果。该州卫生专员Akin Abayomi教授在一份声明中透露了这一情况，并表示州长Babajide Sanwo-Olu已指示相关机构保持高度警觉和充分准备。Abayomi说，由于人员经常在拉各斯和阿布贾之间往来，拉各斯将应对局势列为优先事项。他说，该州应急行动中心在确诊病例得到确认前就已展开工作，各团队开展模拟演练，确保应急人员的职责得到明确。据他介绍，该州隔离中心已经升级，同时正在扩大收治能力。公立和私立医疗机构卫生人员的培训也仍在进行，重点是感染预防与控制。专员表示，该州正在建立明确的实验室检测流程，力争在24小时内得出结果。Abayomi说：“我们的隔离中心已经升级，额外capacity仍在建设中。我们正在明确从样本采集到结果出具的清晰流程，力争在24小时内得出结果。”他补充说，专设的埃博拉研究委员会正在审查有关治疗方法和疫苗的最新证据，以指导决策。Abayomi表示，该州还在与联邦层面合作伙伴协作，进一步完善机场和其他入境口岸的筛查工作。他指出，该州正在利用SHIP加强疾病监测的数字化能力，以改进对疑似病例的发现、追踪和实时响应。专员敦促居民经常使用肥皂和水洗手，并避免接触任何患病者的血液和体液。他建议，出现发热、乏力、呕吐、腹泻或原因不明的出血，或怀疑自己接触过病毒的人，不要自行用药，而应在前往医疗机构前致电卫生部门。Abayomi还敦促卫生人员保持高度警惕，询问患者的旅行史，并使用个人防护装备。居民如发现疑似病例或存在暴露情况，应通过拉各斯州紧急号码112和767，或拨打流行病学、生物安全和全球安全局电话0802 316 9485进行报告。他敦促居民保持冷静、提高警觉，并依赖拉各斯州卫生部发布的官方信息。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都领地以及世界各地设有办公室。它是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，通过各类平台面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级报道新闻，同时充当抱负者、千禧一代接触新思想、文化和技术的交汇点。该报秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真相和理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区等议题，直至探索人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

Unlock these with Subscription Manipur Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh on Saturday (October 24, 2026) said the government would form a committee representing all 36 communities to promote peace, harmony and inclusive development in the strife-hit region. The Chief Minister said the proposal follows a query from Prime Minister Narendra Modi on whether such a committee existed to bring all communities together. Mr. Khemchand Singh was speaking at an event held to felicitate hill chiefs of different tribes at the Chief Minister's Secretariat in Imphal. The event followed the inauguration of the Hill (Tribal) Chiefs' Guest House at Palace Compound as part of the Mera Hou Chongba Festival 2026. Mr. Khemchand Singh said all communities have contributed to defending and safeguarding Manipur throughout, as he recalled the Anglo-Manipur War and the Seven Years' Devastation to pay tribute to the sacrifices made to protect the state's land, identity and heritage. The Chief Minister expressed hope that the festival would usher in peace and prosperity and strengthen the spirit of brotherhood. Mr. Khemchand Singh expressed happiness that people from the hill areas, including some who were earlier reluctant to visit Imphal, joined the festival this year. He said the guest house is not merely a physical structure but a symbol of brotherhood between the hills and the valley. The Mera Hou Chongba festival celebrates peace and brotherhood among different tribes and communities of the state. https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: Sajjan Singh Yadav, a 1995-batch IAS officer of the AGMUT cadre who is currently chief executive officer of the Delhi Jal Board, will take over as chief secretary of Jammu and Kashmir from November 1, succeeding Atal Dulloo, according to an order issued by the Union ministry of home affairs (MHA). “With the approval of the competent authority, Dr Sajjan Singh Yadav is hereby transferred from Delhi to Jammu and Kashmir as chief secretary, Jammu and Kashmir, w.e.f. from 01.11.2026 or from the date of joining, whichever is later,” the MHA order issued on Saturday said. Yadav has held several key roles in the national capital and has been given additional charge of additional chief secretary (industries) and chairperson of DSIIDC, relieving senior officer Santosh D Vaidya of these responsibilities. Yadav has authored Scaling Mount UPSC: Inspiring Stories of Young IAS Officers and India’s Vaccine Growth Story: From Cowpox to Vaccine Maitri. He holds a doctorate in public health from the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (LSHTM), a master’s in public policy from the University of Minnesota in the US, and an MBA from the Faculty of Management Studies, Delhi University. He has been special secretary in the department of expenditure since April 1, 2026, and has served at additional secretary and joint secretary levels in the central government. Besides the finance ministry, he has worked in the ministries of health and family welfare, women and child development, heavy industry, public enterprises, and corporate affairs

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/25/t.summary: Over the past month, the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory, Nyesom Wike, has intensified several meetings with Rivers State Governor Siminalayi Fubara and his supporters to consolidate reconciliation between their political camps ahead of the 2027 general election. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/25/t.summary_zh: 过去一个月，联邦首都 territories 部长 Nyesom Wike 加强了与 Rivers 州州长 Siminalayi Fubara 及其支持者的多次会晤，以在2027年大选前巩固两个政治阵营之间的和解。这次会晤在 Port Harcourt 的 Fubara 私人住所举行，距离忠于两人的政治领袖在同一地点会面仅有两周左右。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/25/t.body: Over the past month, the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory, Nyesom Wike, has intensified several meetings with Rivers State Governor Siminalayi Fubara and his supporters to consolidate reconciliation between their political camps ahead of the 2027 general election. But will the rapprochement work? Davidson Iriekpen asks I t won’t be wrong to describe the current situation between the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, and the Governor of Rivers State, Siminalayi Fubara, as a case of the rejected stone emerging as the cornerstone. With Wike’s recent meetings with the governor, one can only deduce that the powerful minister is eating the humbling pie by his moves to get Fubara to play a crucial role in the Rainbow Coalition he set up to reelect President Bola Tinubu and install Kingsley Chinda as governor in 2027. The latest sign of Wike’s desperation was seen in the past week when the minister again led members of the State House of Assembly and the 23 local government chairmen in the state to a fresh meeting with the governor in continuation of the efforts to consolidate reconciliation between both political camps. The Speaker of the Rivers State House of Assembly, Martin Amaewhule, and the All Progressives Congress (APC) governorship candidate in the state, Chinda, were among those who accompanied Wike to the meeting. The meeting, held at Fubara’s private residence in Port Harcourt, came barely two weeks after political leaders loyal to both men met at the same venue. At the meeting, Wike urged supporters of Fubara to mobilise voters and ensure the state ranks among the top three states with the highest votes for President Tinubu in the 2027 elections. He said a strong electoral performance for Tinubu would position the South-south state for more federal appointments, infrastructure development and greater political influence at the national level. “All I want to hear in this state is Tinubu and nothing but Tinubu. If we play the role we are playing now, and we are one of the first three states that get the highest number of votes, we will get more of the appointments,” he said. The 2027 presidential election particularly, means a lot to Wike. Recall that recently, he public declared why Tinubu must win the poll because, according him, if Atiku Abubakar or Peter Obi wins the election, they would come after him. To understand why the minister’s latest move has caught critics’ attention one has to trace the origin of the political feud between him and Fubara. They once had a godfather and godson relationship until Fubara decided to be a man in control of his government and not another stooge. What he however didn’t anticipate was the power that Wike wields. Wike, who is no ordinary godfather, went to great lengths to humiliate the governor. Their disagreement, which began shortly after Fubara assumed office in 2023, triggered a protracted political crisis that divided the Rivers State House of Assembly. Tensions escalated in October 2023, when a fire incident damaged part of the assembly complex amid the dispute between both camps. Lawmakers loyal to Wike subsequently initiated impeachment proceedings against Fubara, deepening the confrontation between the executive and legislative arms of government. The crisis eventually led President Tinubu to declare a six-month emergency in Rivers State in March 2025, resulting in the suspension of the governor, his deputy and members of the state assembly. Wike had recently announced an end to the feud, saying Fubara had agreed to return to the political family that supported his emergence as governor. This was the same governor he made sure that the APC screened out of the ruling party’s primary election, forcing him to withdraw from the race. Chinda subsequently emerged as the APC’s sole candidate for the governorship election. Therefore, it is so ironic that the same FCT minister is desperately in need of Fubara, whom he had repeatedly denigrated and attempted to remove from office on many occasions. Last Monday, the intense troubleshooting efforts by Wike with Fubara continued, with the state assembly reversing its earlier decision to declare the seats of three lawmakers who supported the state governor vacant. At the assembly’s sitting, the 27 lawmakers led by Amaewhule resolved not only to rescind its threat against the Fubara-backed lawmakers, but to readmit them within their fold. This is a decision seen as critical to the peace process, which has since begun between the two camps. The pro-Fubara lawmakers, whose seats were earlier marked to be declared vacant, included Victor Oko-Jumbo, representing Bonny Constituency; Sokari Goodboy Sokari, Ahoada West; and Orubienimigha Timothy, Opobo/Nkoro Constituency. The assembly’s decision followed letters dated October 16, 2026 from the three lawmakers, which were read on the floor of the assembly during plenary. In the letter, the lawmakers requested that they be called back into the assembly to continue their legislative duties. It would be recalled that the assembly had, on October 30, 2023, in the heat of the political crisis, suspended the three lawmakers alongside Hon. Edison Ehie for alleged misconduct. Ehie, who later became the Chief of Staff to the governor, had resigned his membership of the assembly in the heat of the crisis, allowing for a by-election in his constituency. The trio’s suspension was, however, lifted on December 20, 2023, after the first peace meeting initiated by President Tinubu between Wike and Governor Fubara. But following the failure of the three lawmakers to attend sittings after their suspension was lifted, their seats were then declared vacant on October 15, 2025, by the Amaewhule-led assembly in line with section 109 sub 1 (e) of the Constitution. The assembly had consequently written to the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to conduct a by-election to fill the vacant seats. But during last Monday’s plenary, Speaker Amaewhule read the letters from each of the three lawmakers explaining that they never saw the letter lifting their suspension earlier, which was the reason they didn’t attend the sitting and appealed for the House to rescind its decision. The assembly’s decision might not be unconnected with Sunday’s meeting between Wike, the lawmakers, Chairmen of Local Government Areas and other leaders of the coalition with Governor Fubara and members of his team. The lingering question, however, is: Can Fubara genuinely reconcile with a man who, on many occasions, publicly denigrated and humiliated him, attempted to impeach him, instigated his suspension for six months, denied him a second term in office, replaced his local government officials, and denied his loyalists tickets to contest House of Assembly seats? Political analysts believe this is a delicate path to reconciliation – one that the governor must be strategic about and tread smartly. There is no doubt that the peace talks are largely driven by Wike’s political interests, particularly now that he has been assigned to lead President Tinubu’s re-election campaign. They may also be aimed at limiting the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC)’s impact on the presidential and governorship elections in Rivers. How this will pan out, however, remains to be seen. If Fubara accepts the olive branch and supports Wike’s campaign, some may interpret his actions as a sign of weakness. But if he plays his cards well, he could emerge with more than one political victory. Tensions escalated in October 2023, when a fire incident damaged part of the assembly complex amid the dispute between both camps. Lawmakers loyal to Wike subsequently initiated impeachment proceedings against Fubara, deepening the confrontation between the executive and legislative arms of government. The crisis eventually led President Tinubu to declare a six-month emergency in Rivers State in March 2025, resulting in the suspension of the governor, his deputy and members of the state assembly. Wike had recently announced an end to the feud, saying Fubara had agreed to return to the political family that supported his emergence as governor. This was the same governor he made sure that the APC screened out of the ruling party’s primary election, forcing him to withdraw from the race. Chinda subsequently emerged as the APC’s sole candidate for the governorship election. Therefore, it is so ironic that the same FCT minister is desperately in need of Fubara, whom he had repeatedly denigrated and attempted to remove from office on many occasions. Last Monday, the intense troubleshooting efforts by Wike with Fubara continued, with the state assembly reversing its earlier decision to declare the seats of three lawmakers who supported the state governor vacant. At the assembly’s sitting, the 27 lawmakers led by Amaewhule resolved not only to rescind its threat against the Fubara-backed lawmakers, but to readmit them within their fold. This is a decision seen as critical to the peace process, which has since begun between the two camps. The pro-Fubara lawmakers, whose seats were earlier marked to be declared vacant, included Victor Oko-Jumbo, representing Bonny Constituency; Sokari Goodboy Sokari, Ahoada West; and Orubienimigha Timothy, Opobo/Nkoro Constituency. The assembly’s decision followed letters dated October 16, 2026 from the three lawmakers, which were read on the floor of the assembly during plenary. In the letter, the lawmakers requested that they be called back into the assembly to continue their legislative duties. It would be recalled that the assembly had, on October 30, 2023, in the heat of the political crisis, suspended the three lawmakers alongside Hon. Edison Ehie for alleged misconduct. Ehie, who later became the Chief of Staff to the governor, had resigned his membership of the assembly in the heat of the crisis, allowing for a by-election in his constituency. The trio’s suspension was, however, lifted on December 20, 2023, after the first peace meeting initiated by President Tinubu between Wike and Governor Fubara. But following the failure of the three lawmakers to attend sittings after their suspension was lifted, their seats were then declared vacant on October 15, 2025, by the Amaewhule-led assembly in line with section 109 sub 1 (e) of the Constitution. The assembly had consequently written to the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to conduct a by-election to fill the vacant seats. But during last Monday’s plenary, Speaker Amaewhule read the letters from each of the three lawmakers explaining that they never saw the letter lifting their suspension earlier, which was the reason they didn’t attend the sitting and appealed for the House to rescind its decision. The assembly’s decision might not be unconnected with Sunday’s meeting between Wike, the lawmakers, Chairmen of Local Government Areas and other leaders of the coalition with Governor Fubara and members of his team. The lingering question, however, is: Can Fubara genuinely reconcile with a man who, on many occasions, publicly denigrated and humiliated him, attempted to impeach him, instigated his suspension for six months, denied him a second term in office, replaced his local government officials, and denied his loyalists tickets to contest House of Assembly seats? Political analysts believe this is a delicate path to reconciliation – one that the governor must be strategic about and tread smartly. There is no doubt that the peace talks are largely driven by Wike’s political interests, particularly now that he has been assigned to lead President Tinubu’s re-election campaign. They may also be aimed at limiting the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC)’s impact on the presidential and governorship elections in Rivers. How this will pan out, however, remains to be seen. If Fubara accepts the olive branch and supports Wike’s campaign, some may interpret his actions as a sign of weakness. But if he plays his cards well, he could emerge with more than one political victory. Unlock these with Subscription Published - October 25, 2026 06:55 am IST - Washington, United States Former U.S. President Barack Obama delivered scathing criticisms of his successor, Donald Trump, at rallies on Saturday (October 24, 2026) in Ohio and Michigan to support Democratic candidates ahead of the November 3 midterm elections. Democrats are attempting to wrest back control of one or both chambers of the U.S. Congress, which are currently controlled by Mr. Trump’s Republican party. The former President retains considerable popularity among the Democratic base, which he is keen to leverage to support his Democratic Party’s candidates. In both states, the 65-year-old former President blamed the Trump administration for the rising cost of living, a top voter concern amid soaring fuel prices. “The current president chose to make a series of bad decisions,” Mr. Obama said in Ohio, where he rallied in support of former Democratic senator Sherrod Brown. “Most importantly, he decided to start an unnecessary war that nobody asked for.” “After two years of chaos and cruelty and corruption and incompetence, the likes of which we have not seen in the modern era, you get a chance to say, ‘Enough is enough,’” Mr. Obama declared in Cleveland. “We are voting for change right here in Ohio.” Later, in Michigan, Mr. Obama campaigned for Abdul El-Sayed, from the party’s left wing, who is in a close race with Republican Mike Rogers for the US Senate. “Imagine the power duo of Abdul and Elissa,” Mr. Obama said, referring to the incumbent Democratic Senator Elissa Slotkin, who is not up for election this year. “You got a Muslim man, you got a Jewish woman fighting for you in the United States Senate. That’s something, Michigan, you can be proud of.” Mr. Obama also urged voters to cast their ballots as soon as possible since early voting is already open in both states. In Ohio, Mr. Brown will attempt a comeback against incumbent Republican Senator Jon Husted, while the race for governor will be contested between Democrat Amy Acton and Republican Vivek Ramaswamy, a former presidential candidate in 2024. Polls for Ohio give Democrats a slight lead in both those races, but the results are expected to be close. Mr. Obama also took digs at Mr. Trump’s renovation projects across the U.S. capital, including his botched renovation of the National Mall’s Reflecting Pool, his construction of a massive White House Ballroom and the gilded decorations he has adorned the Oval Office with during his second tenure. “He’s got the White House looking like Saddam Hussein opened a Cheesecake Factory,” Mr. Obama said, referring to the popular but indulgent American restaurant chain. Nationally, polls also suggest that Democrats could regain control of the House of Representatives but face a much more competitive contest for the Senate. 发布时间——2026年10月25日 06:55 印度标准时间——美国华盛顿

美国前总统贝拉克·奥巴马于2026年10月24日星期六在俄亥俄州和密歇根州举行的集会上，严厉批评其继任者唐纳德·特朗普，以支持民主党候选人迎接11月3日举行的中期选举。

民主党正试图从特朗普先生所属的共和党手中夺回美国国会一个或两个议院的控制权。目前，这两个议院均由特朗普先生的共和党掌控。

这位前总统在民主党基础选民中仍颇受欢迎，他希望利用这一影响力支持民主党的候选人。

在两个州，这位65岁的前总统都将生活成本上涨归咎于特朗普政府。在燃油价格飙升之际，生活成本是选民最担忧的问题之一。

奥巴马先生在俄亥俄州为前民主党参议员舍罗德·布朗竞选时表示：“现任总统选择作出一连串糟糕的决定。最重要的是，他决定发动一场没人要求发动的没有必要战争。”

他在克利夫兰宣称：“经历了两年混乱、残酷、腐败和无能的局面——这是现代时期从未有过的——你们终于有机会说，‘够了，已经受够了。’我们就在俄亥俄州投票支持改变。”

随后，奥巴马先生在密歇根州为来自党内左翼、与共和党人迈克·罗杰斯竞选美国参议院席位的阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德助选。

奥巴马先生说：“想象一下阿卜杜勒和埃莉萨这对强大组合吧。”他指的是现任民主党参议员埃莉萨·斯洛特金，她今年不参加选举。“一位穆斯林男性和一位犹太女性都在美国参议院为你们而战。密歇根州，这就是你们可以引以为豪的事。”

由于俄亥俄州和密歇根州都已开始提前投票，奥巴马先生还敦促选民尽快投下选票。

在俄亥俄州，布朗先生将力战现任共和党参议员乔恩·赫斯特德，试图东山再起；州长选举则由民主党人艾米·阿克顿与共和党人维韦克·拉马斯瓦米竞争，后者曾是2024年总统候选人。

俄亥俄州的民调显示，民主党在这两场竞选中均略微领先，但预计最终结果将十分接近。

奥巴马先生还挖苦特朗普先生在美国首都各地进行的翻修项目，包括他搞砸的国家广场倒影池翻修工程、兴建的巨型白宫舞厅，以及他第二任期内为椭圆形办公室装上的镀金装饰。

奥巴马先生说：“他让白宫看起来就像是萨达姆·侯赛因开了一家Cheesecake Factory。”他指的是这家颇受欢迎但较为奢华的美国连锁餐厅。

全国范围的民调还显示，民主党有可能重新夺回众议院控制权，但在参议院选举中面临竞争激烈得多的争夺。

Unlock these with Subscription The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) has asked the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) to conduct a forensic security audit of the VAHAN, SARATHI, e-Challan and PUCC portals, which hold various types of vehicle-owner information. Vahan manages vehicle-registration records; Sarathi handles driving licences and related services; e-Challan records traffic violations and fines; and PUCC manages pollution control certificates. The move follows reports of vehicle information being sold through multiple apps and websites for as little as ₹5. One Telegram-based channel, for example, provided extensive personal data when supplied with a vehicle registration number, according to an investigation by the security firm Cyderes. Details included the owner’s full name, father’s name, present and permanent addresses, PIN code, and mobile number. It also offered driving-licence details, challan history, FASTag information, a downloadable registration certificate, and a PDF of the driving licence. Vehicle Information App (with 10 million downloads) and VehicleSetu — RC & Challan Info (with 1 million downloads) were the other popular apps identified. The Ministry has now written to major app store operators, including Google, requesting the removal of all such apps. A senior official from the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways said they have sought the intervention of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) to review its data-sharing policy and suggest ways to strengthen it. The Ministry also plans to audit various enforcement agencies accessing its portals. The data-sharing policy allows access to data from the National Transport Repository, a central MoRTH database that consolidates vehicle-registration and driving-licence records from VAHAN and SARATHI, as well as data from e-Challans, eDARs (Detailed Accident Reports), and FASTags. Under the policy, government bodies, including the police, law-enforcement and national-security agencies, may access all data fields available through the various applications, in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Meanwhile, private entities can access only selected data fields relevant to their domain and have a daily cap on searches. Data is shared through application programming interfaces (APIs), enabling machine-to-machine access or login-based access secured by secret keys, two-factor authentication, and Aadhaar-authenticated one-time passwords (OTPs). Personally identifiable information (PII) is masked for all except law-enforcement and security agencies. All entities must possess a Security Audit Certificate from CERT-In. Through an RTI request, the Internet Freedom Foundation (IFF) found that 25,314 credentials had been issued to private entities to access VAHAN, SARATHI, e-Challan, and PUCC data, through which 1.708 crore queries were run over a period of 33 months. According to another senior Road Ministry official, a preliminary investigation found evidence of data misuse involving the Indian government’s Unified Logistics Interface Platform (ULIP), managed by the National Industrial Corridor Development Corporation (NICDC). The finding was based on unusually high transaction volumes, with many entities permitted to access the portal recording more than 50 lakh hits in a month. According to a letter dated October 19, reviewed by The Hindu , the Road Ministry has asked NIC to audit the access and usage patterns of entities using ULIP and determine whether they accessed data strictly in line with the approved purpose, scope, and terms of access. The Ministry has also separately written to NICDC’s data services arm to request details regarding what due diligence was carried out before granting access to entities, the criteria used to determine an entity’s eligibility, the mechanism for establishing the scope of data access (including limits placed on shared data elements), and the process followed for monitoring and reviewing data access. Officials suspect bad actors were likely triangulating data gathered from different portals and compiling it. Road Ministry officials said that, following a representation from the IFF, the Ministry has further tightened technical controls and will limit data sharing for ULIP. Government agencies seeking data will now be required to get approval from the Transport Secretary, and requesting officers must be verified through an Aadhaar-based digital signature certificate or video KYC. However, officials ruled out suspending data sharing with private entities, saying it was necessary to support ease of doing business and ease of living. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/r.body_zh: 订阅还可解锁《 premium stories 》、社论、观点等更多内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。印度公路与高速公路部（MoRTH）已要求印度计算机应急响应小组（CERT-In）对 VAHAN、SARATHI、e-Challan 和 PUCC 门户网站开展数字取证安全审计，这些门户存储各类车辆所有人信息。VAHAN 管理车辆登记记录；SARATHI 处理驾驶证及相关服务；e-Challan 记录交通违规和罚款；PUCC 管理污染控制证书。此举是因为有报道称，车辆信息正通过多个应用和网站出售，价格低至 ₹5。安全公司 Cyderes 的一项调查据称显示，一个基于 Telegram 的频道只要输入车辆登记编号，就能提供大量个人数据。详情包括车主的全名、父亲姓名、现住址和永久住址、PIN 码及手机号码。该频道还提供驾驶证信息、罚款记录、FASTag 信息、可下载的登记证书以及驾驶证 PDF 文件。调查还发现了另外两款热门应用：Vehicle Information App（下载量 1000万次）和 VehicleSetu — RC & Challan Info（下载量 100万次）。印度公路与高速公路部现已致函包括 Google 在内的主要应用商店运营方，要求下架所有此类应用。该部一名高级官员表示，已请求电子与信息技术部（MeitY）介入，审查数据共享政策并提出加强建议。该部还计划审计访问其门户网站的各类执法机构。数据共享政策允许访问国家交通资料库的数据。该资料库是 MoRTH 的中央数据库，汇总 VAHAN 和 SARATHI 的车辆登记及驾驶证记录，也收录 e-Challan、eDAR（详细事故报告）和 FASTag 数据。根据该政策，包括警方、执法机构和国家安全机构在内的政府机构，可依据《2023年数字个人数据保护法》访问各种应用提供的全部数据字段。与此同时，私营实体只能访问与其业务领域相关的指定数据字段，且每日搜索次数设有上限。数据通过应用程序编程接口（API）共享，可进行机器对机器访问，也可通过秘密密钥、双因素认证和基于 Aadhaar 认证的一次性密码（OTP）进行登录访问。除执法和安全机构外，所有实体的个人身份信息（PII）均会隐去。所有实体都必须持有 CERT-In 出具的安全审计证书。互联网自由基金会（IFF）通过一项信息公开申请（RTI）请求发现，已有 25,314 份凭证签发给私营实体，用于访问 VAHAN、SARATHI、e-Challan 和 PUCC 数据；33个月内共通过这些凭证执行了 1.708 crore 次查询。印度公路与高速公路部另一名高级官员表示，初步调查发现印度政府的统一物流接口平台（ULIP）存在数据滥用证据，该平台由国家工业走廊开发公司（NICDC）管理。调查结论基于异常高的交易量，许多获准访问该门户的实体一个月内记录的访问量超过 50 lakh 次。《The Hindu》查阅的一封日期为 10月19日 的信件显示，印度公路与高速公路部已要求 NIC 审计使用 ULIP 的实体的访问和使用模式，并确定其是否严格依照获批目的、范围和访问条款访问数据。该部还另行致函 NICDC 的数据服务部门，要求提供以下详细信息：在向实体授予访问权限前进行了哪些尽职调查、采用什么标准确定实体资格、如何确定数据访问范围（包括对共享数据要素设置哪些限制），以及监测和审查数据访问所遵循的流程。官员怀疑，不法行为者很可能将不同门户网站收集的数据进行交叉比对并汇总。印度公路与高速公路部官员表示，在 IFF 提出交涉后，该部进一步加强了技术控制，并将限制 ULIP 的数据共享。今后，政府机构如需获取数据，必须获得交通秘书批准，申请人员还必须通过基于 Aadhaar 的数字签名证书或视频 KYC 完成验证。不过，官员排除了暂停与私营实体共享数据的做法，称这是支持便利营商和便利生活所必需的。评论必须使用英语，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你是《The Hindu》的注册用户且已登录，可以继续参与文章互动。如果你没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录自己的账户后，可以访问以前在 Vuukle 发布的评论

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/9199.title: Winners emerge in NCDMB Essay Competition
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/9199.summary: There were some 5,000 entries in the Essay Competition from 52 universities across the six geopolitical zones of the country, with consolation prizes going to the 4th to 9th place winners.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/9199.summary_zh: 全国六个地缘政治区的52所大学共提交了约5000篇散文比赛参赛作品，第四至第九名获得安慰奖。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/9199.body: The coveted prize of N1 million, a brand-new laptop and a plaque was won by Mr Wisdom David Fabunmi, a 200-level Physiotherapy student of the University of Ilorin, Kwara State, who emerged as overall winner, while the second prize of N700,000, laptop and plaque was won by Ms. Joy Oghogho Enogieru, a 100-level Doctor of Optometry student of the University of Benin, the first runner-up. The third prize of N500,000, laptop and a plaque was won by Mr. Ahmadu Kodan Yusuf, a 100-level Law student of Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria. There were some 5,000 entries in the Essay Competition from 52 universities across the six geopolitical zones of the country, with consolation prizes going to the 4th to 9th place winners. Representing the Executive Secretary of the NCDMB, Felix Omatsola Ogbe, at the Grand Finale of the Award and Prize-giving Ceremony, the General Manager, Corporate Communications Division (CCD), Dr. Obinna Ezeobi, stated that the competition is particularly important to the Board because it contributes to the realisation of its mandate, which centres on development of human and material capacity and monitoring of compliance by players in the oil and gas industry. Ezeobi pointed out that universities are institutions where ideas should be developed, problems examined, innovations encouraged and solutions created for the advancement of the society, hence the Board undertook to engage students and encourage them to think critically and write about Nigerian Content. The ideas, commitment and ingenuity of youths, he noted, were crucial to the future of Nigerian Content. He also listed the Nigerian Engineering Olympiad (NEO), to inspire innovation among engineering students, with the maiden edition concluded in July 2026. Ezeobi noted that the focus of this year’s essay competition on promoting manufacturing for sustainable local content development is intended to challenge participants to examine how Nigeria can strengthen its productive capacity and create greater economic value. According to him, “It is also the reason we implement a policy known as Nigerian Content Equipment Commitment (NCEC), which compels companies to show proof that they manufacture components and have capacity to execute key activities” before they get contract opportunities in the oil and gas industry. In his opening remarks, the Chairman of the occasion, Professor Promise Mebine, Vice Chancellor, Federal University, Otuoke, congratulated the NCDMB on its successful hosting and sponsorship of the competition and for staying faithful to the vision. “Year after year, you have proven that building Nigerian Content is not only about pipelines and platforms, but about building people, particularly our youths, the leaders of tomorrow,” he stated. To the winners, his word was, “Your prize today is well-deserved, but the real prize is not the cheque or the plaque. The real prize is that NCDMB has now opened a door for you. Walk through it!” To the other contestants, he said, “you are not losers; every essay you submitted is a seed. You have trained your mind to think. You have trained your hand to write. Keep writing; keep researching; keep believing in Nigeria; Next year, the podium may be yours.” In a goodwill message, the Director, Monitoring and Evaluation Directorate (MED) Mr. Esueme Dan Kikile, Esq. commended the Executive Secretary, the Corporate Communications Division and the programme consultant for all the effort toward sustenance of the competition, which he noted has been immensely beneficial to the Board and participants
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/9199.title_zh: 尼日利亚本地内容开发与监督委员会论文比赛揭晓获奖者
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/9199.body_zh: 人人梦寐以求的N1百万大奖、一台全新笔记本电脑和一块奖牌由Kwara State伊洛林大学200级物理治疗学学生Wisdom David Fabunmi先生夺得，他成为总得主；N700,000、笔记本电脑和奖牌组成的二等奖由University of Benin 100级验光学博士学生Joy Oghogho Enogieru女士获得，她荣膺亚军。N500,000、笔记本电脑和奖牌组成的三等奖由扎里亚Ahmadu Bello大学100级法学学生Ahmadu Kodan Yusuf先生获得。本次散文比赛共收到来自全国六个地缘政治区52所大学的约5,000份参赛作品，第四至第九名得主分别获得安慰奖。在颁奖与奖品授予仪式总决赛上，尼日利亚本地内容开发与监督委员会执行秘书Felix Omatsola Ogbe的发言代表、公司传播部门（CCD）总经理Dr. Obinna Ezeobi表示，这项比赛对委员会尤其重要，因为它有助于落实委员会以开发人力和物力能力、监测石油和天然气行业从业者合规情况为核心的职责。Ezeobi指出，大学是应当培育思想、审视问题、鼓励创新并创造解决方案、推动社会进步的机构，因此委员会着手与学生互动，鼓励他们批判性思考并撰写有关尼日利亚本地内容的文章。他指出，青年的创意、投入和 ingenuity对尼日利亚本地内容的未来至关重要。他还列举了旨在启发工程专业学生创新的尼日利亚工程奥林匹克（NEO），首届赛事已于2026年7月结束。Ezeobi表示，今年散文比赛聚焦于通过制造业促进可持续本地内容发展，意在促使参赛者思考尼日利亚如何增强生产能力并创造更大的经济价值。他说：“这也是我们推行一项名为尼日利亚本地内容设备承诺（NCEC）的政策的原因。该政策要求企业在获得石油和天然气行业的合同机会之前，提供证据证明其能够制造零部件，并具备执行关键活动的能力。”在开幕致辞中，活动主席、Federal University, Otuoke校长Promise Mebine教授祝贺尼日利亚本地内容开发与监督委员会成功举办并赞助本次比赛，并始终秉持既定愿景。他表示：“你们年复一年地证明，发展尼日利亚本地内容不仅是建设管道和平台，更在于培养人才，尤其是培养我们的青年——他们是未来的领导者。”他向获奖者表示：“你们今天获得的奖品实至名归，但真正的奖品不是支票或奖牌。真正的奖品是，尼日利亚本地内容开发与监督委员会现在已为你们打开了一扇门。迈过去吧！”他对其他参赛者说：“你们不是失败者；你们提交的每篇文章都是一颗种子。你们训练了自己的思维去思考，也训练了自己的双手去书写。继续写下去；继续研究；继续相信尼日利亚；明年，领奖台可能就是你们的。”在致辞中，监测与评估局（MED）局长Esueme Dan Kikile先生律师赞扬了执行秘书、公司传播部门和项目顾问为维持本次比赛作出的努力，并指出，这项比赛为委员会和参赛者带来了巨大益处

https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-links.summary_zh: 约翰·马哈马总统表示，非洲争夺自然资源控制权以及开采收益的斗争，是非洲大陆安全危机的核心因素；他还警告，强大利益集团会从长期不稳定中获利。在埃塞俄比亚巴赫达尔举行的第12届非洲和平坦纳高级论坛上，马哈马总统表示，非洲领导人如果未能加强对自身资源的控制，并自行确定安全优先事项，非洲大陆就将继续处于脆弱状态。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-links.body: President John Mahama says the struggle for control of Africa’s natural resources and the profits from their extraction are central to the continent’s security crises, warning that powerful interests benefit from prolonged instability. Addressing the 12th Tana High-Level Forum on Peace in Africa in Bahir Dar, Ethiopia, President Mahama said Africa, the President said the continent risks remaining vulnerable if its leaders fail to take greater control of their resources and determine their own security priorities. He said “Let me be clear, Africa is not an empty chessboard for foreign powers to play their games. We are not spectators,” he said. President Mahama said the importance of African minerals to the global green energy transition and digital economy should give the continent greater bargaining power, but communities endowed with these resources often bear the consequences of exploitation without enjoying the benefits. He argued that sovereignty must go beyond political independence and membership of international institutions. “Real sovereignty means having the administrative, legal, and economic power to govern your strategic assets, negotiate fair terms, and ensure the wealth beneath our people's feet actually puts food on their tables,” he said. He added that anything less amounted to “cosmetic independence that masks economic subjugation.” He says African leaders must look beyond weapons proliferation and military operations to confront the political and economic interests that sustain conflicts across the continent. “The real disease is mostly in the arena of political economy,” President Mahama said when presenting the 2026 State of Peace and Security in Africa Report at the 12th Tana High-Level Forum on Peace in Africa in Bahir Dar, Ethiopia. He challenged leaders to examine who controls natural resources, who benefits financially from their extraction and whose political and financial interests are better served by continued instability than lasting peace. “In every single theatre of conflict across this continent today, if you want to understand why guns are firing, do not start by counting the rifles,” he said. “Ask three basic questions, who controls the resource? Who cashes the cheque from its extraction? And whose political and financial fortunes are better served by perpetual chaos than by stable peace?” President Mahama cited Sudan, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Somalia and Mozambique as examples of how resource competition, governance failures and economic marginalisation contribute to insecurity. In Sudan, he said, the battle lines were drawn as much around gold extraction sites as around Khartoum. In eastern DRC, he linked the resurgence and entrenchment of the M23 group to coltan, cobalt and the global competition for minerals needed for the green energy transition. He also attributed the continued presence of Al-Shabaab in Somalia partly to governance failures that have created openings for the group to exploit. In Mozambique’s Cabo Delgado region, he said, the area’s substantial gas wealth has not translated into meaningful benefits for local young people, who instead viewed it as another source of marginalisation. “These are not separate, random brushfires. They are symptoms of a single, continent-wide firestorm,” he said
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-links.title_zh: 马哈马将非洲冲突与自然资源争夺联系起来
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-links.body_zh: 约翰·马哈马总统表示，围绕非洲自然资源控制权及其开采利润的斗争，是非洲大陆安全危机的核心因素，并警告称，强大的利益集团正从长期动荡中获益。在埃塞俄比亚巴赫达尔举行的第12届塔纳非洲和平高级论坛上，马哈马总统指出，如果非洲领导人未能更好地掌控本国资源、确定自身的安全优先事项，非洲大陆仍可能处于脆弱状态。他说：“让我明确一点，非洲不是外国强权用来玩弄权术的空白棋盘。我们并非旁观者。”马哈马总统表示，非洲矿产对全球绿色能源转型和数字经济至关重要，这应当赋予非洲大陆更大的议价能力，但拥有这些资源的社区往往承受剥削带来的后果，却无法享受相关收益。他主张，主权不能仅仅意味着政治独立和加入国际组织。“真正的主权意味着拥有行政、法律和经济权力来治理自身的战略资产、谈判公平条件，并确保我们人民脚下的财富确实能够转化为餐桌上的食物。”他说。他补充称，低于这一标准的做法无异于“掩饰经济从属地位的表面独立”。他说，非洲领导人必须超越武器扩散和军事行动，正视维持非洲大陆各地冲突的政治和经济利益。马哈马总统在埃塞俄比亚巴赫达尔举行的第12届塔纳非洲和平高级论坛上发布《2026年非洲和平与安全状况报告》时表示：“真正的疾病主要存在于政治经济领域。”他敦促各国领导人审视谁在控制自然资源、谁从资源开采中获取经济利益，以及谁的政治和财政利益更能从持续动荡而非持久和平中获益。“在当今非洲大陆的每一个冲突地区，如果你想了解枪炮为何开火，不要从清点步枪数量开始。”他说，“要问三个根本问题：谁控制资源？谁从资源开采中拿到收益？谁的政治和财富状况更能从永久混乱而非稳定和平中获益？”马哈马总统列举苏丹、刚果民主共和国（DRC）、索马里和莫桑比克为例，说明资源竞争、治理失败和经济边缘化如何加剧不安全局势。在苏丹，他说，围绕黄金开采点的战线与围绕喀土穆的战线同样明显。在刚果民主共和国东部，他指出，M23组织东山再起和势力巩固与钶钽矿、钴以及全球对绿色能源转型所需矿产的竞争有关。他还称，治理失败为青年党在索马里扩大影响和牟取利益创造了空间 partly，这也是青年党继续存在的原因之一。他说，在莫桑比克的德尔加多岛地区，当地丰富的天然气财富并未给当地年轻人带来切实好处，反而被视为另一种边缘化来源。“这些并非彼此孤立、随机出现的零星冲突。它们是一场席卷整个大陆的单一风暴的症状。”他说

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.summary_zh: 石油资源（天然气）国务部长埃克佩里克·埃克波宣布，联邦、州和地方政府将合力在阿夸伊博姆州为全日进步大会（APC）取得压倒性的选举胜利，这引发了人们对2027年选举前公共机构中立性的疑问。“这个州选区、这个联邦选区、这个参议院选区、这个阿夸伊博姆州都将取得100比100的胜利。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Minister of State for Petroleum Resources (Gas), Ekperikpe Ekpo, has declared that the federal, state and local governments will combine their powers to secure overwhelming electoral victories for the APC in Akwa Ibom State, raising questions about the neutrality of public institutions ahead of the 2027 elections. Mr Ekpo made the declaration at a political rally in Etim Ekpo Local Government Area of Akwa Ibom State, where he introduced the APC candidate for the Akwa Ibom State House of Assembly constituency. “This State Constituency, this Federal Constituency, this Senatorial District, this Akwa Ibom State is going to be 100 over 100. I can tell you that as a federal minister,” he told the crowd at the rally. “We will bring federal might and join with state might and join with local government might and make sure the people of this local government, whether you like that blessing, that blessing will come to you. A man of peace is on the throne.” The minister did not explain what he meant by combining the powers of the three tiers of government or how the proposed mobilisation would be carried out. His remarks drew attention to longstanding concerns surrounding the use of government power and public resources to influence electoral outcomes in Nigeria, where political expressions such as “federal might” have often fuelled suspicions of possible interference in the electoral process. Under Nigeria’s democratic architecture, elections are expected to provide a level playing field for political parties and candidates, while public institutions must operate within the law rather than serve the electoral interests of the party in power. Mr Ekpo’s spokesperson, Louis Ibah, did not respond to a media enquiry sent to him on WhatsApp on Friday, despite reading the message. A reminder sent on Saturday morning and a subsequent telephone call also went unanswered. In the enquiry, PREMIUM TIMES asked Mr Ibah to clarify what the minister meant by combining federal, state and local government power in the election and how the declaration aligned with democratic competition and the neutrality of public institutions. Mr Ekpo’s remarks follow concerns about political leaders making declarations that appear to presume electoral results before voters cast their ballots. In September, PREMIUM TIMES reported that Emmanuel Enoidem, a chieftain of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in Akwa Ibom and a Senior Advocate of Nigeria, insisted that a federal lawmaker, Clement Jimbo, would be returned to the House of Representatives in 2027, “whether you like it or not”. Mr Enoidem made the declaration while soliciting support for Mr Jimbo, who represents Abak/Etim Ekpo/Ika Federal Constituency. Some members of the audience reportedly rejected the appeal. Mr Enoidem subsequently told PREMIUM TIMES that his remarks were directed at APC members, arguing that party members were expected to support their party’s candidates. He also acknowledged the right of voters to freely choose their preferred candidates. Mr Ekpo’s expression steered political discourse in Akwa Ibom, invoking concerns about whether the machinery of government could be used to influence electoral competition in the 2027 general elections. Mr Ekpo’s declaration is particularly noteworthy because he occupies a federal executive position and noted that he speaks from the hindsight of being a minister while openly invoking the use of federal powers for an electoral result. Although political parties and their members are entitled to campaign for electoral victories, using public office or government institutions to confer an unfair advantage on a party would raise serious questions about electoral integrity. Nigeria’s constitution guarantees citizens the right to participate in government, while the Electoral Act provides the legal framework for conducting elections. The credibility of the process depends, in part, on voters being able to make their choices freely, without intimidation or improper interference. Mr Ekpo did not explicitly threaten violence in the remarks reviewed by PREMIUM TIMES. However, his reference to combining federal, state and local government “might,” coupled with his revelation that he is speaking based on his privileged position as a “federal minister,” raises questions about the means through which he intends to secure the sweeping electoral victory he predicted. Until he clarifies his remarks, that question remains unanswered
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: 2027年：部长威胁在阿夸伊博姆选举中动用“联邦力量”
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府石油资源（天然气）国务部长埃克佩里克·埃克波宣布，联邦、州和地方政府将合力，确保全进步大会党（APC）在阿夸伊博姆州取得压倒性选举胜利；此举引发外界对2027年选举前公共机构中立性的质疑。埃克波在阿夸伊博姆州埃廷·埃克波地方政府辖区的一场政治集会上发表上述声明，并在会上为阿夸伊博姆州众议院选区的APC候选人站台。他说：“这个州选区、这个联邦选区、这个参议员选区、整个阿夸伊博姆州都将以百分之百对百分之百的得票获胜。作为联邦部长，我可以向你们保证这一点。”他告诉集会人群：“我们将调动联邦力量，与州政府力量和地方政府力量汇合，确保这个地方政府的人民都能得到那份祝福；无论你们是否愿意接受，这份祝福都会降临到你们身上。和平之人将坐上王座。”这位部长没有解释他所说的三级政府力量合是什么意思，也没有说明拟议中的动员将如何实施。他的言论使人们再次关注尼日利亚围绕利用政府权力和公共资源影响选举结果的长期争议。在尼日利亚，“联邦力量”等政治言论常常加深外界对选举进程可能受到干预的疑虑。按照尼日利亚的民主制度，选举应当为政党和候选人提供公平竞争环境，而公共机构必须依法运作，不能服务于执政党的选举利益。PREMIUM TIMES于星期五通过WhatsApp向埃克波的发言人路易斯·伊巴发送媒体问询，但伊巴读后仍未回复。星期六上午发出的提醒以及随后拨打的电话也未获回应。在问询中，PREMIUM TIMES请伊巴澄清部长所说的在选举中合并联邦、州和地方政府力量具体意味着什么，以及这一声明如何符合民主竞争要求和公共机构中立性原则。此前已有关于政治人士提前宣布似乎预设选举结果的担忧。9月，PREMIUM TIMES报道称，阿夸伊博姆州全进步大会党（APC）高层、尼日利亚资深大律师埃马纽埃尔·埃诺伊德姆坚称，联邦议员克莱门特·金博无论人们是否愿意，都将在2027年再次当选众议员。埃诺伊德姆在为金博争取支持时作出这番声明。金博代表阿巴克/埃廷·埃克波/伊卡联邦选区。据报道，部分现场听众拒绝响应这一呼吁。埃诺伊德姆随后告诉PREMIUM TIMES，他的讲话是面向APC党员的，并称党员理应支持本党候选人。他还承认选民有权自由选择中意的候选人。埃克波的这番表态影响了阿夸伊博姆州的政治讨论，并再次引发人们关注政府机器能否被用于左右2027年大选中的选举竞争。埃克波的声明尤其值得注意，因为他担任联邦行政职务，并指出自己是以“联邦部长”的特殊身份说这番话，同时公开主张动用联邦力量来实现选举结果。尽管政党及其成员有权为赢得选举开展竞选，但利用公职或政府机构为某一政党赋予不公平优势，将引发对选举诚信的严重质疑。尼日利亚宪法保障公民参与政府的权利，《选举法》则为选举的举行提供法律框架。选举进程的可信度部分取决于选民能否在没有恐吓或不当干预的情况下自由作出选择。在PREMIUM TIMES审阅的言论中，埃克波并未明确威胁使用暴力。然而，他提到要合并联邦、州和地方政府的“力量”，并透露自己凭借“联邦部长”的特殊身份发表这番话，这使人们产生疑问：他究竟打算通过何种手段，确保自己预测的这场压倒性选举胜利？在他澄清这些言论之前，这一问题仍无答案。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/cagg-demands.summary: In a press release dated October 24, 2026, the coalition condemned the reported remarks, describing them as unlawful and reckless, and warning that they could undermine efforts to combat illegal mining, popularly known as galamsey. The coalition therefore wants the GoldBod CEO to immediately retract the alleged statement and issue an unqualified apology to the Ghanaian public.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/cagg-demands.summary_zh: 在一份日期为2026年10月24日的新闻稿中，该联盟谴责了有关言论，称其违法且鲁莽，并警告称，这些言论可能破坏打击俗称 galamsey 的非法采矿的努力。因此，该联盟要求 GoldBod 首席执行官立即撤回被指称的声明，并向加纳公众作出无保留的道歉。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/cagg-demands.body: The Ghana Coalition Against Galamsey (CAGG) has called on the Office of the Attorney-General to investigate the Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) over statements it claims encouraged artisanal miners to operate without licences, provided they avoid forest reserves and river bodies. In a press release dated October 24, 2026, the coalition condemned the reported remarks, describing them as unlawful and reckless, and warning that they could undermine efforts to combat illegal mining, popularly known as galamsey. CAGG argued that Ghana's mining laws do not exempt miners from licensing requirements based on the location of their operations. Citing Section 99(2)(a) of the Minerals and Mining Act, 2006 (Act 703), as amended by Act 995 of 2019, the coalition said anyone who undertakes mining without a licence granted by the Minister commits an offence. It further cited Section 99, arguing that anyone who commands, instigates, employs or facilitates others to engage in illegal mining could face the same penalties as the illegal miner. According to the coalition, offenders could face fines ranging from GH¢120,000 to GH¢180,000 and imprisonment of between 15 and 25 years, or both. The coalition therefore wants the GoldBod CEO to immediately retract the alleged statement and issue an unqualified apology to the Ghanaian public. It has also urged President John Dramani Mahama, the Minister for Lands and Natural Resources, and the Minerals Commission to publicly reaffirm that mining without a licence is illegal, regardless of where the activity takes place. CAGG further called on the Attorney-General's Office to investigate the matter for possible abetment of illegal mining, insisting that no individual should be exempt from the law. Beyond the legal implications, the coalition warned that the reported remarks could expose farmers and landowners to encroachment on their lands. It has consequently called on the Ministry of National Security, the Ghana Police Service and the Ministry of the Interior to strengthen protection for farmers and landowners and establish rapid-response channels for reporting encroachment. The group is also demanding a clear national plan to protect farmlands, including legal safeguards for agricultural lands, mapping and registration of farms, support for vulnerable farmers seeking to document their land rights, and compensation and restoration for those whose lands have been destroyed. CAGG said GoldBod was established to formalise and regulate artisanal mining, not to encourage unlicensed operations. It warned that normalising mining without licences would weaken the regulatory framework intended to distinguish legal small-scale mining from illegal mining. The coalition comprises civil society organisations, professional associations, environmental advocacy groups and other stakeholders
https://www.myjoyonline.com/cagg-demands.title_zh: CAGG要求加纳黄金局首席执行官撤回涉嫌支持非法采矿的言论并道歉
https://www.myjoyonline.com/cagg-demands.body_zh: 加纳反非法采矿联盟（CAGG）呼吁总检察长办公室调查加纳黄金局（GoldBod）首席执行官，因为该联盟声称，此人的言论鼓励手工采矿者在不办理许可证的情况下开采，只需避开森林保护区和河流即可。在日期为2026年10月24日的新闻公报中，该联盟谴责了据报道的相关言论，称其违法且鲁莽，并警告称，这些言论可能削弱打击俗称“galamsey”的非法采矿活动的努力。CAGG认为，加纳的采矿法律并未根据采矿活动的地点免除采矿者办理许可证的要求。该联盟援引经2019年第995号法案修订的《2006年矿产与采矿法》（第703号法案）第99(2)(a)条，称任何人在未获得部长颁发许可证的情况下从事采矿，均构成违法行为。该联盟还援引第99条，认为任何指使、煽动、雇用或协助他人从事非法采矿的人，都可能与非法采矿者面临同样的处罚。据该联盟称，违法者可能被处以GH¢120,000至GH¢180,000的罚款，并处以15年至25年监禁，或两者并处。因此，该联盟要求GoldBod首席执行官立即收回据称发表的言论，并不加保留地向加纳公众道歉。该联盟还敦促约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马总统、土地与自然资源部长以及矿产委员会公开重申，无论采矿活动在哪里进行，无许可证采矿均属违法。CAGG进一步呼吁总检察长办公室调查此事，审查是否构成对非法采矿的协助，并坚持任何个人都不应免于法律制裁。除法律影响外，该联盟警告称，据报道的相关言论可能使农民和土地所有者面临土地被侵占的问题。因此，该联盟呼吁国家安全部、加纳警察局和内政部加强对农民和土地所有者的保护，并建立快速响应渠道，以便报告土地侵占事件。该团体还要求制定明确的全国农地保护计划，包括为农业土地提供法律保障、绘制并登记农场、协助弱势农民确认土地权利，以及对土地遭到破坏者给予赔偿并协助恢复土地。CAGG表示，设立GoldBod是为了使手工采矿正规化并加强监管，而不是鼓励无证经营。该联盟警告称，将无许可证采矿正常化会削弱旨在区分合法小规模采矿与非法采矿的监管框架。该联盟由民间社会组织、专业协会、环保倡议团体及其他利益相关方组成

Unlock these with Subscription Delhi Education Minister Ashish Sood on Saturday said the government followed the prescribed process in procuring NCERT textbooks for schools at ₹28 per copy against ₹55 under the previous dispensation. Responding to Aam Aadmi Party’s (AAP) allegations of “substandard” quality textbooks supplied to students, the Minister said a review has been ordered. AAP challenged Chief Minister Rekha Gupta to send the books to a laboratory for testing. Addressing a press conference, Mr. Sood said, “AAP is alleging a scam to stay relevant and misleading the public. Despite inflation, the BJP government has capped the price of textbooks for government schools that was almost double during the AAP’s tenure.” Following a review, strict penal action will be initiated against those involved in spreading deliberate falsehoods, he added. On Friday, AAP’s Delhi chief Saurabh Bharadwaj alleged irregularities in the BJP government’s school textbook printing and tendering process. He claimed that the quality of the paper used in the textbooks was substandard. In response, Mr. Sood displayed a copy of the tender document and said the government had followed the prescribed process. Challenging Mr. Sood to make public the file in which his department officials have moved for full payment to the vendors, Mr. Bharadwaj said, “The Minister has not answered why these books have very poor printing quality and use cheap 60 GSM paper, while the tender specified standard 80 GSM paper.” Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. https://leadership.ng/abia-records-huge-.summary_zh: “自从推行强制免费基础教育政策和设立教育督导员以来，全州入学人数大幅激增，”他说。兼任州长基础教育与中等教育顾问的 Nwosu 表示，督导员的首要责任是找出失学儿童，并确保他们重返课堂。州政府此前表示，设立教育督导员是为了落实其强制免费基础教育政策。
https://leadership.ng/abia-records-huge-.body: Nwosu disclosed this in an interview with LEADERSHIP in Umuahia, the state capital, while highlighting the achievements of the Education Marshals, established about 16 months ago. “Since the introduction of the compulsory free basic education policy and establishment of the marshals, there had been a huge surge in school enrolment across the state,” he said. Nwosu, who is also the governor’s adviser on Basic and Secondary Education, said the primary responsibility of the marshals was to identify out-of-school children and ensure they returned to the classroom. He explained that the marshals enrolled the children in the nearest schools before reaching out to their parents or guardians to establish why they were not attending school. “So that is why we take such children and enrol them in a school, the nearest school within that area. Then we also now reach out to their parents or guardians,” he said. According to him, the marshals adopt a gradual approach to enforcing the policy, engaging parents and guardians to understand the circumstances keeping their children out of school. “You know, when you want to introduce a policy, you don’t go straight with an iron fist. You start step by step to ensure that your goals and your aspirations are met,” he said. Nwosu added that the initiative had also provided school uniforms and instructional materials to some children to support their return to school. “In some cases, we have also provided the children with school uniforms and instructional materials. And we’ve achieved quite a whole lot of success in that area,” he said. He said the marshals had also intensified public enlightenment campaigns in motor parks, marketplaces and other public places to educate parents and guardians on the importance of sending their children to school. The state government had earlier said the Education Marshals were established to enforce its compulsory free basic education policy. The Commissioner for Information, Okey Kanu, disclosed this while briefing journalists on the outcome of an Executive Council meeting chaired by Governor Otti at Government House, Umuahia. Kanu said the marshals would be supported by the state’s harmonised task force and relevant community stakeholders to enforce the policy. “The marshals will be assisted by the state’s harmonised task force and other necessary community stakeholders to enforce this critical policy,” he said. https://leadership.ng/abia-records-huge-.title_zh: 奥蒂推行免费教育政策后，阿比亚州入学人数大幅增长
https://leadership.ng/abia-records-huge-.body_zh: 恩沃苏在接受《领导报》记者于州首府乌穆阿利亚采访时透露了上述情况，同时强调了大约16个月前成立的教育督学所取得的成果。他说：“自推行免费义务基础教育政策并成立教育督学以来，全州入学人数大幅增长。”兼任州长基础教育与中等教育顾问的恩沃苏说，教育督学的首要职责是找出失学儿童，并确保他们重返课堂。他解释说，教育督学会先把儿童登记入附近的学校，再联系其父母或监护人，了解他们不上学的原因。他说：“因此，我们会把这些儿童安排入学，登记到该地区最近的学校。然后，我们再联系他们的父母或监护人。”据他介绍，教育督学采取渐进方式执行政策，通过与父母和监护人沟通，了解他们让孩子无法上学的具体原因。他说：“你要推行一项政策，就不能一开始就铁腕推进。你需要一步一步地实施，确保目标和愿望得以实现。”恩沃苏补充称，这项举措还向一些儿童提供了校服和教学资料，帮助他们重返学校。他说：“在某些情况下，我们还向儿童提供了校服和教学资料，并且在这方面取得了相当大的成效。”他说，教育督学还加强了公共场所的宣传教育，在汽车站、市场及其他公共场所开展活动，向父母和监护人说明让孩子入学的重要性。州政府此前表示，成立教育督学是为了执行全州免费义务基础教育政策。州新闻专员奥基·卡努在政府大楼向记者介绍由州长奥蒂主持的执行委员会会议成果时透露了这一点。卡努说，州政府协调统一的任务组以及相关社区利益攸关方将支持教育督学执行该政策。他说：“教育督学将在州政府协调统一的任务组及其他必要社区利益攸关方的协助下，推动这项关键政策落地。”掌握最新动态。实时报道、独家内幕和深度解读将直接发送到你的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入《领导新闻》的 WhatsApp 频道，随时获取全天候最新消息 →

https://leadership.ng/wike-mocks-obi-say.body: Wike spoke on Saturday during a town hall meeting with stakeholders in Bonny Local Government Area of Rivers State, where he criticised Obi’s leadership record and dismissed his online popularity as insufficient qualification for the presidency. “Truly speaking, I gave him president of social media. If you were to vote who will be president of social media, I will vote for him. But if it is to govern Nigeria, it capital no!” the minister said. He also ridiculed Obi’s practice of carrying his own bags, describing it as an attempt to project an image of frugality that, in his view, raised questions about his suitability for the nation’s highest office. “As a former governor, you cannot be stingy not to have employed a personal assistant who will carry your bag. You want to show you carry your bag. We don’t want such a stingy person as a president,” Wike said. The minister further challenged Obi’s record as Anambra governor, urging Nigerians to compare his administration with that of the incumbent governor, Chukwuma Soludo. He argued that aspiring leaders should be judged by their performance in office and their ability to manage political and governance challenges, rather than public perception or campaign rhetoric. Wike also criticised politicians who leave their parties during internal crises, citing his experience in the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) as evidence that political disputes should be confronted rather than avoided. “How will you solve the problem of the country? Did you see when there was a problem in PDP? Did I run? I defeated them,” he said. Turning to Rivers State, the minister accused the previous administration of wasting public funds on projects that failed to deliver commensurate benefits to residents. He alleged that $39 million, which he estimated at N53 billion, was spent on a proposed 1,000-bed Justice Karibi-Whyte Specialist Hospital without the project reaching the foundation stage. “Thirty-nine million US dollars, 53 billion naira, gone! As I speak to you, there’s no foundation, no one block laid,” he said. Wike also questioned the viability of the state’s monorail project, alleging that about N60 billion was spent on it without adequate returns for the people. On the sale of a gas turbine, he claimed the transaction was valued at $308 million, alleging that only $308,000 remained in the relevant state account when he assumed office in May 2015. He further recalled a proposal to spend $10 million on fumigating Rivers State to tackle mosquitoes, questioning the justification for the expenditure given the state’s geographical boundaries with neighbouring states. The minister urged voters to examine the records of politicians seeking public office, insisting that past performance should carry more weight than campaign promises. He also criticised the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential ticket and questioned the reliability of former Vice President Atiku Abubakar, whom he said he had known since their days in the PDP. Wike reaffirmed his support for President Bola Tinubu and the All Progressives Congress (APC), declaring his intention to back the party in the 2027 presidential election. He said the Rainbow Coalition had united politicians across party lines in Rivers State to reduce political tensions and violence, even as members prepared to contest elections under different platforms. “Under a Rainbow Coalition, that’s why in our state today, you see APC, PDP, all of us. No more Rivers of blood, no more shooting, not many people going to die,” he said. Wike announced that the coalition would unveil its candidates on October 27, naming Kingsley Chinda as its preferred candidate for the Rivers State governorship election. He also disclosed candidates for other elective positions, explaining that some would contest under the APC despite the coalition’s cross-party membership. The minister urged Rivers residents to support candidates he described as experienced and committed to public service, while assuring Bonny residents that issues raised during the meeting would receive attention. He also praised the completion of the Bonny-Bodo Road, describing it as a major infrastructure achievement that had improved access to the island community and eased the difficulties residents previously faced when travelling by boat. Wike said he had informed President Tinubu that the road’s completion was a significant milestone for Bonny, stressing that improved infrastructure was essential to the community’s development. https://leadership.ng/wike-mocks-obi-say.title_zh: Wike 嘲笑 Obi，称社交媒体人气不足以治理尼日利亚
https://leadership.ng/wike-mocks-obi-say.body_zh: 维ike周六在尼日利亚河流州博尼地方政府区域与利益相关方举行市民大会期间发表讲话，批评奥比担任州长的执政记录，并称奥比的网络人气不足以证明其具备总统竞选资格。这位部长说：“说真的，我封他为社交媒体总统。如果让你投票选社交媒体总统，我会投给他。但如果是治理尼日利亚，那他绝对不行！”他还嘲笑奥比亲自提包的作风，称这是试图塑造节俭形象，但在他看来，这反而让人质疑奥比是否适合担任国家最高职位。维ike说：“作为前州长，你不可能吝啬到连一个替你提包的私人助理都不请。你想表现自己会提包。我们不要这样吝啬的人当总统。”这位部长进一步质疑奥比担任阿南布拉州长时的施政记录，敦促尼日利亚人将其执政表现与现任州长楚库瓦马·索卢多进行比较。他认为有志从政者应根据其在任期间的表现以及处理政治和治理挑战的能力来评判，而不是依据公众印象或竞选口号。维ike还批评那些在党内危机期间退党的政治人物，并以自己在人民民主党（PDP）中的经历为依据，指出政治分歧应当正面应对，而非回避。他说：“你怎么解决国家的问题？你见过PDP出现问题时我是怎么做的吗？我跑了？我击败了他们。”谈到河流州时，这位部长指控前任政府将公共资金浪费在未能为居民带来相应效益的项目上。他称，拟建的拥有1,000张床位的卡里比-怀特专科医院耗资3,900万美元，他估算为530亿奈拉，但该项目甚至尚未进入奠基阶段。他说：“3,900万美元，530亿奈拉，没了！我现在跟你说话时，那里没有地基，一块砖都没砌。”维ike还质疑该州单轨铁路项目的可行性，称该项目耗资约600亿奈拉，却没有给民众带来充分回报。在出售燃气轮机一事上，他声称交易价值为3.08亿美元，并称他于2015年5月上任时，相关州账户中仅剩30.8万美元。他还提到一项耗资1,000万美元对河流州进行熏蒸以治理蚊虫的提议，质疑鉴于该州与邻近各州的地理边界，这笔支出的理由是否充分。这位部长敦促选民审视寻求公职的政治人物履历，强调过往表现应比竞选承诺占据更重要的分量。他还批评了非洲民主大会（ADC）的总统竞选组合，并质疑前副总统阿提库·阿布巴卡尔的可靠性，称自己从二人在PDP时期就相识。维ike再次表态支持总统博拉·蒂努布及全进步大会党（APC），并宣布有意在2027年总统选举中支持该党。他说，彩虹联盟已经将河流州不同党派的政治人物团结起来，以缓和政治紧张局势和暴力，尽管成员们准备以不同平台竞选。他说：“在彩虹联盟之下，所以今天在我们州里，你可以看到APC、PDP，我们所有人都在一起。河流州不再流血，不再有枪击，不会再有很多人死去。”维ike宣布，联盟将于10月27日公布候选人，并指定金斯利·钦达为河流州州长选举的首选候选人。他还披露了其他公职的候选人名单，并解释说，尽管联盟成员横跨多个党派，其中一些人仍将以APC名义参选。这位部长敦促河流州居民支持他所称经验丰富、致力于公共服务的人选，同时向博尼居民保证，会上提出的问题将得到处理。他还赞扬博尼—博多公路建成，称这是改善前往该岛屿社区交通条件的一项重大基础设施成就，也减轻了居民此前乘船出行时面临的困难。维ike说，他已告知蒂努布总统，公路建成为博尼带来了重要里程碑，并强调改善基础设施对该社区的发展至关重要。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独特视角，直接推送到你的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入《领导力新闻》的WhatsApp，获取全天候更新 →

Unlock these with Subscription Seven persons, including a government school teacher, were killed in a fire accident followed by an explosion near Bisimamidi village in Pinakota panchayat of Ananthagiri mandal in Alluri Sitharama Raju district on Saturday morning. The incident occurred when a tipper carrying large quantities of diesel caught fire while its workers were shifting the fuel to a pickup vehicle. The tipper was reportedly meant for transporting earthmovers engaged in road construction work. The deceased have been identified as J. Sunitha (44), a government school teacher; Mydrebu, a native of Hanumanthawaka in Visakhapatnam; Manyala Manikanta (23) from Devarapalli; A. Guru Pavan (27) from Kadapa district; Pangi Chiranjeevi of Pedabayalu in ASR district; Tinku Chandravamsi Singh, an earthmover operator from Bihar; Nazeer from Assam and M. Narayana Rao from Cheedikada in Anakapalli district. According to the police, the pickup truck was heading towards the Pinakota region where the Panchayat Raj Department was carrying out road construction work. A tipper was also heading towards the worksite. The pickup truck had four persons on board, including its driver, Manikanta; Sunitha, a government school teacher who reportedly took a lift to a village near Pinakota to reach her school; and two supervisors, Narayana Rao and Guru Pavan Kumar. The incident occurred at around 8.30 a.m., near Bisimamidi village, when Manikanta was reportedly trying to transfer fuel to the tipper with the help of the tipper driver, Chiranjeevi. Two earthmover operators, Tinku and Nazeer, were also reportedly present near the vehicles when the incident occurred. The police suspect that a spark generated during the fuel transfer from the tipper might have triggered the fire. The tipper was reportedly carrying around 250 litres of diesel. The flames soon spread to the pickup truck, triggering an explosion. As per the fellow workers, the tipper reportedly was also carrying an LPG cylinder, possibly for preparing food for the workers, apart from the fuel, which may also have contributed to the severity of the explosion. Eyewitnesses said they heard a deafening sound, following which flames engulfed both vehicles. The impact of explosion was so severe that bodies were reportedly flung several metres away from the spot. The incident occurred in an interior village near the Raiwada reservoir, where road connectivity and transport facilities are limited. The difficult terrain posed challenges for those rushing to the spot after the explosion. Initial report said gelatin sticks, used in road works, caused the explosion. However, the police said that there was no evidence of gelatin sticks present on the tipper. However, it is yet to be ascertained whether the tipper van was carrying an LPG cylinder, as claimed by the workers. The forensic report will reveal more clues, said a police officer. Meanwhile, Deputy Chief Minister K. Pawan Kalyan enquired about the incident. Expressing grief, he reportedly ordered an inquiry. Home Minister Vangalapudi Anitha, TDP Andhra Pradesh unit president Palla Srinivasa Rao and BJP A.P. president P.V.N. Madhav expressed grief over the deaths. District Collector T. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/2027.body: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) in Enugu State has called on the state government to ensure a level playing field for all political parties ahead of the 2027 general elections, alleging attacks on opposition supporters and urging authorities to prevent political violence. The party’s governorship candidate, Ocho Obodoeze, made the call after receiving an award from the Correspondents Chapel of the Nigeria Union of Journalists (NUJ), Enugu State Council. Obodoeze accused the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) of suppressing opposition parties and urged the state government to allow all political parties to campaign freely in accordance with the law. He also called on the government to fulfil its responsibility of protecting lives and property amid concerns over reported political violence in the state. “Enugu State Government should allow every political party to campaign in the state, in line with the Electoral Act and guidelines of the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) for the 2027 general election. “The government should desist from muzzling opposition parties. Instead, they should allow them to campaign freely like the ruling party, the All Progressives Congress (APC), is doing. Election is not a do-or-die affair. The will of the people must be allowed to prevail,” he said. Obodoeze dedicated his award to Ifeanyi Christopher Nworie, who reportedly died from gunshot injuries allegedly sustained during an attack on supporters of the opposition New Democratic Congress (NDC). Describing the gesture as emotional, the ADC candidate recalled that Nworie died from injuries he sustained during an attack by gunmen on an opposition party’s campaign office in Enugu on October 10, 2026. He alleged that the incident reflected a pattern of attacks against opposition parties since political activities began ahead of the 2027 elections. The Enugu State Government, however, has denied involvement in political attacks in the state, insisting that opposition parties are free to campaign and criticise Governor Peter Mbah’s administration. Meanwhile, the Enugu State chapter of the ADC has congratulated Obodoeze on the award presented to him during the Correspondents Chapel’s 2026 Press Week celebration. In a statement signed by the party’s state secretary, A. C. Udeh, the ADC described the award as well deserved and a morale booster for its members ahead of the 2027 elections. “The prestigious award is a clear testament that NUJ has discovered and recognised the uncommon good qualities embedded in our governorship candidate,” the party said. It described Obodoeze as humble, compassionate and committed to the welfare of ordinary citizens, expressing confidence in his capacity to lead the state if elected governor. The party also pledged that an Obodoeze administration would reduce what it described as high and multiple taxation burdening residents of Enugu State. It further promised to prioritise the welfare of workers and pensioners, describing its candidate as accessible and committed to the development and prosperity of the state. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/2027.title_zh: 2027年：恩古州ADC指控遭到袭击，要求公平竞争环境
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/2027.body_zh: 恩古州非洲民主大会党（ADC）已呼吁州政府，在2027年大选前为所有政党营造公平竞争环境，指称反对派支持者遭到袭击，并敦促当局防止政治暴力。该党州长候选人Ocho Obodoeze是在获得尼日利亚记者协会（NUJ）恩古州委员会记者团颁发的奖项后发出上述呼吁的。Obodoeze指控执政的进步大会党（APC）压制反对党，并敦促州政府依照法律允许所有政党自由开展竞选活动。他还呼吁政府履行保护生命和财产的责任，因为外界担忧该州发生了政治暴力事件。他说：“恩古州政府应依据《选举法》和独立国家选举委员会（INEC）关于2027年大选的指引，允许每个政党在该州开展竞选活动。“政府应停止压制反对党，而应允许它们像执政的进步大会党（APC）一样自由开展竞选。选举并非生死攸关之事。必须让人民的意愿 prevail，”他说。Obodoeze将该奖项献给Ifeanyi Christopher Nworie。据报道，Nworie在反对党新民主大会党（NDC）支持者遭到袭击时中了枪伤，最终死亡。ADC候选人称这一举动饱含情感，并回忆称，Nworie是在2026年10月10日恩古一个反对党竞选办公室遭枪手袭击时受伤，随后因伤势过重死亡。他指称，这一事件反映出自2027年选举前的政治活动开始以来，针对反对党的袭击已形成一种模式。不过，恩古州政府否认参与该州的政治袭击事件，并坚持称反对党可以自由竞选和批评州长Peter Mbah的政府。与此同时，ADC恩古州分部祝贺Obodoeze获颁记者团2026年新闻周活动期间颁发的奖项。该党在由州秘书A. C. Udeh签署的声明中称，这项奖项当之无愧，也将在2027年大选前提振该党成员士气。该党表示：“这一荣誉奖项清楚印证了NUJ发现并认可我们州长候选人所具备的非凡优秀品质。”该党称Obodoeze谦逊、富有同情心，并致力于普通公民的福祉，对他当选州长后领导该州的能力表示有信心。该党还承诺，如果Obodoeze组建政府，将减轻其所称的恩古州居民面临的高额且名目繁多的税收负担。该党进一步承诺优先保障工人和退休人员的福祉，并称其候选人平易近人，致力于该州的发展与繁荣。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title: Trump's diesel price relief efforts grow costlier as election nears
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: With the November midterm elections fast approaching, President Donald Trump is throwing an array of costly and politically fraught solutions at one stubborn problem: the price of diesel. Yet diesel prices rose again last week, leaving Trump spending political and financial capital without delivering the relief his party wants as voters go to the polls.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 随着11月中期选举迅速临近，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普正为柴油价格这一棘手问题抛出各种代价高昂且政治风险难料的对策。然而，柴油价格上周再次上涨。随着选民前往投票，特朗普的政党原本希望获得纾困，但特朗普投入了政治和财政资本，却未能带来他们所期待的缓解措施。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: With the November midterm elections fast approaching, President Donald Trump is throwing an array of costly and politically fraught solutions at one stubborn problem: the price of diesel. His administration has offered billions of dollars to farmers, relaxed rules for truckers, eased sanctions on Russian fuel and pressured European allies to release emergency stocks. Yet diesel prices rose again last week, leaving Trump spending political and financial capital without delivering the relief his party wants as voters go to the polls. US diesel prices rose nearly 10 cents a gallon in the latest week to an average of $6.28, reversing two weeks of declines and remaining near record highs, according to the Energy Information Administration. Diesel in the last two months has become a central issue not only in the midterms but as a catalyst driving up already-elevated US inflation. The fuel is critical for farmers, construction companies, freight operators and more, and government data last week showed its rise was partly behind hefty increases in delivery costs, early-stage food production costs and even toy prices. The political pressure is particularly acute in traditionally Republican Farm Belt states like Iowa and Kansas, where rising fuel and fertilizer costs, trade disruptions and weak farm economics have fueled discontent among some of Trump's core supporters. Trump has promoted his diesel measures at campaign rallies across the region. He signed an executive order onstage in Nebraska allowing red-dyed diesel to be used in highway vehicles and announced $8 billion in new farm aid during a rally in Kansas on Monday. The measures illustrate the trade-offs Trump is accepting in pursuit of near-term relief. The new aid adds fresh strain on federal spending, while the Russian fuel move risks helping Moscow finance its war in Ukraine. Pressure on European allies to release emergency stocks, backed by a threat to restrict US diesel exports, has created diplomatic friction. “The president tends to discount long-term losses over short-term gain, and I am skeptical if there is any short gain to be had here,” said Chris Borick, a pollster and political scientist at Muhlenberg College in Pennsylvania. The White House attributed high diesel prices to “pre-existing issues,” including years of refinery closures and damage from Russia's war in Ukraine, while defending Trump's efforts to ease costs. “The President wants diesel prices to fall, which is why he has taken historic actions to save American farmers, truckers, and workers every hard-earned penny," White House spokeswoman Taylor Rogers said. One of Trump's most direct attempts to lower diesel costs has struggled to gain traction. Trump signed an executive order this month allowing truckers to use red-dyed diesel, typically intended for off-road use such as farm equipment, for highway driving while temporarily avoiding certain federal tax reporting and record-keeping requirements. But the IRS has not eliminated the federal diesel tax, instead temporarily waiving related reporting requirements and penalties through year-end, leaving uncertainty for truck stops and fuel sellers. David Fialkov, top lobbyist at NATSO, a trade group representing the largest US truck stop operators, said members appreciate Trump's effort to tackle diesel costs but that the guidance remains "murky" and carries too much risk. "I really don’t see any of these dyed diesel announcements making a meaningful dent in diesel prices," Fialkov said. Trump is also turning to federal payments to cushion some of the constituencies feeling the pain. Government payments to farmers were already expected to top $47 billion this year, buoyed by commodity payments and $12 billion in tariff relief distributed by the US Department of Agriculture earlier this year. The $8 billion farm relief program would push the total to a record $55.4 billion, exceeding the previous high of $45 billion in 2020, when farmers received pandemic assistance. The payments can help farmers manage higher costs and lost sales but do not directly address the market disruptions driving up fuel and fertilizer prices. They also raise questions about taxpayer spending to compensate producers for damage that farm groups say is linked partly to the administration’s own trade and foreign policies. “This is the second round of emergency aid this year to address losses that were largely foreseeable,” National Farmers Union President Rob Larew said. “Trade disruptions and rising fuel costs tied to conflict abroad have put family farmers in a difficult position, and one-time payments can't provide the stability they need to plan for the future.” The aid will arrive after the November 3 election, and likely not reach farmers until the end of the year, USDA official Richard Fordyce told Reuters on Friday. Some of Trump's efforts to increase diesel supplies carry geopolitical trade-offs. His decision to ease sanctions on Russian diesel that were designed to restrict Moscow’s energy revenues and limit its ability to finance its war in Ukraine has drawn bipartisan criticism -- and raised questions about whether the move will meaningfully lower US fuel prices. Trump has defended the sanctions relief as necessary to draw Russian President Vladimir Putin into negotiations to end the war in Ukraine and to release American prisoner Stephen Hubbard. As the administration's intervention efforts have failed to lower fuel costs, Trump has sought to shift blame toward Ukraine and President Volodymyr Zelenskiy rather than the Iran war ahead of the elections. Analysts say the Iran conflict has been the much bigger driver of the diesel price spike, disrupting global oil flows and refined-fuel supplies, while Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries have helped tighten supplies but played a more limited role in the price. “I sort of see it as a blame-shifting kind of scapegoating operation, more than a genuine attempt to moderate prices in the lead-up to the election,” said Edward Fishman, director of the Maurice R. Greenberg Center at the Council on Foreign Relations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 随着选举临近，特朗普缓解柴油价格压力的努力成本越来越高
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 随着11月中期选举迅速临近，总统唐纳德·特朗普正针对柴油价格这一棘手问题推出多项成本高昂且政治上颇具争议的解决方案。他的政府已向农民提供数十亿美元，放宽卡车司机相关规则，解除对俄罗斯燃料的部分制裁，并迫使欧洲盟友释放紧急储备。然而，上周柴油价格再次上涨；在选民前往投票站之际，特朗普不仅消耗了政治和财政资本，却未能提供其政党所期待的纾困措施。据美国能源信息署数据，美国柴油价格最新一周每加仑上涨近10美分，平均达到6.28美元，逆转了此前连续两周的跌势，并仍接近历史高位。过去两个月，柴油不仅成为中期选举的核心议题，也成为进一步推高本已高企的美国通胀的催化因素。这种燃料对农民、建筑公司、货运运营商等行业至关重要。政府上周公布的数据显示，柴油价格上涨是配送成本、食品初级生产成本乃至玩具价格大幅上涨的部分原因。在传统上属于共和党阵营的农业带州，如爱荷华州和堪萨斯州，政治压力尤其强烈。燃料和化肥成本上升、贸易中断以及农场经济疲软，已在特朗普部分核心支持者中引发不满。特朗普在该地区各地竞选集会上宣传其柴油应对措施。他在内布拉斯加州签署行政令，允许公路车辆使用红色染色柴油，并于周一在堪萨斯州竞选集会上宣布新增80亿美元农业援助。这些措施凸显了特朗普为寻求短期纾困而接受的取舍。新增援助令联邦支出承受更大压力，而放松俄罗斯燃料限制则可能帮助莫斯科获得资金继续对乌战争。特朗普施压欧洲盟友释放紧急储备，并威胁限制美国柴油出口，由此造成外交摩擦。宾夕法尼亚州穆伦伯格学院民调专家和政治科学家克里斯·博里克表示：“总统往往更看重短期收益，而不把长期损失放在眼里；我怀疑这件事究竟能否带来任何短期收益。”白宫将柴油高价归因于“既有问题”，包括多年来炼油厂关闭以及俄罗斯对乌克兰战争造成的破坏，同时为特朗普降低成本的努力辩护。白宫发言人泰勒·罗杰斯说：“总统希望柴油价格下降，因此采取了历史性举措，为美国农民、卡车司机和劳动者保住每一枚辛苦挣来的便士。”特朗普为降低柴油成本采取的最直接措施之一，在落实中进展不顺。本月，特朗普签署行政令，允许卡车司机将通常用于农场设备等非公路场景的红色染色柴油用于公路行驶，同时暂时免除某些联邦税务申报和记录保存要求。但美国国税局并未取消联邦柴油税，只是暂时豁免相关申报要求和罚款至年底，令卡车停靠站和燃料销售商仍面临不确定性。代表美国最大卡车停靠站运营商的行业协会NATSO首席游说人士戴维·菲尔科夫称，成员认可特朗普为应对柴油成本付出的努力，但相关指导仍“模糊不清”，且风险过高。菲尔科夫说：“我真不认为这些染色柴油公告中的任何一项能对柴油价格产生实质性影响。”特朗普还动用联邦付款，为承受部分冲击的群体提供缓冲。政府今年向农民发放的款项原本预计将超过470亿美元，其中包括大宗商品付款，以及美国农业部今年早些时候发放的120亿美元关税纾困资金。这项80亿美元农业纾困计划将使总额升至创纪录的554亿美元，超过2020年 pandemic 援助时期450亿美元的前高。相关付款可帮助农民应对成本上升和销售减少，却无法直接解决推高燃料和化肥价格的市场失衡，也引发有关纳税人支出是否应补偿生产者的疑问。农业团体称，部分损失与政府自身的贸易和外交政策有关。全国农民联盟主席罗布·拉鲁说：“这是今年第二轮紧急援助，用于应对原本在很大程度上可以预见的损失。贸易中断以及与海外冲突相关的燃料成本上涨，使家庭农场主陷入困境，一次性付款无法提供他们规划未来所需的稳定性。”美国农业部官员理查德·福迪斯周五告诉路透社，这笔援助将在11月3日选举后发放，而且很可能要到年底才能到达农民手中。特朗普增加柴油供应的举措也伴随地缘政治取舍。他决定放松针对俄罗斯柴油的制裁；这些制裁原本旨在限制莫斯科的能源收入，削弱其为对乌战争提供资金的能力。此举招致两党批评，也使人质疑这一决定能否显著降低美国燃料价格。特朗普为放松制裁辩护称，此举是必要的，有助于推动俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京参与结束乌克兰战争的谈判，并释放美国囚犯斯蒂芬·哈伯德。随着政府干预未能降低燃料成本，特朗普试图在选举前把责任推向乌克兰和总统沃洛季米尔·泽连斯基，而非伊朗战争。分析人士称，伊朗冲突才是柴油价格飙升更重要的推动因素，它扰乱了全球石油流动和成品油供应；乌克兰对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击虽促使供应收紧，但对价格的影响相对有限。外交关系协会莫里斯·R·格林伯格中心主任爱德华·费什曼说：“在我看来，这更像是一种推卸责任、寻找替罪羊的操作，而不是在选举前真正努力抑制价格。”
