Unlock these with Subscription The Tamil Nadu government has written to the National Medical Commission (NMC) and University Grants Commission (UGC) seeking appropriate action against Saveetha Medical College for collecting additional fees from undergraduate medical students and for disabling access to the students’ attendance portal, Health Minister K.G. Arunraj said. In a press release issued on Wednesday, he said that NMC, in a public notice issued on April 7, had said the fees for MBBS course should be collected only for the prescribed academic duration of four and a half years. The State government took the complaints seriously, and the Directorate of Medical Education and Research constituted a three-member committee to conduct an inquiry. A total of 17 students and seven parents participated in the inquiry conducted on October 12. The management of Saveetha Medical College, which was called for the inquiry, did not attend it. The inquiry found that the college did not follow the NMC guidelines on collecting tuition fees from students, the Minister said. It was also found that the college had disabled the attendance portal for students who had not paid the full annual fee for the fifth year from September 30. As Saveetha Medical College is a deemed-to-be university, its fee structure falls outside the purview of the State Fee Fixation Committee. As the institution is regulated by the NMC and UGC, the State government wrote to them on October 21, urging them to take action against the college for collecting additional fees and to direct it to collect only half the annual fee for the fifth year, Dr. Arunraj said. The State government also urged the Commission to direct the college to restore students’ access to the attendance portal and ensure that no student was denied attendance, clinical training, or eligibility to appear for examinations for failing to pay the additional amount. It also sought directions to refund or adjust the amount collected in excess and to ensure that no student or parent faces consequences for filing a complaint or participating in the inquiry. The Minister said the State government was firm that no student’s education should be affected over fee issues. Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. 泰米尔纳德邦政府已致函印度国家医学委员会（NMC）和大学拨款委员会（UGC），要求针对 Saveetha Medical College 向医学本科学生收取额外费用以及禁用学生考勤门户一事采取适当行动。卫生部长 K.G. Arunraj 表示。

他在周三发布的新闻公报中说，NMC 在 4 月 7 日发布的公告中表示，MBBS 课程的费用只能在规定的 4 年半学制期间收取。邦政府认真对待这些投诉，并成立了一个由 3 名成员组成的委员会进行调查。共有 17 名学生和 7 名家长参加了 10 月 12 日举行的调查。应要求参加调查的 Saveetha Medical College 管理层未予出席。

部长说，调查发现该学院未遵守 NMC 关于向学生收取学费的规定。调查还发现，自 9 月 30 日起，该学院禁用了未缴清第 5 年全年费用的学生考勤门户。

由于 Saveetha Medical College 是一所享有同等大学地位的大学，其收费结构不受邦费用固定委员会的监管。该机构受 NMC 和 UGC 监管，因此邦政府于 10 月 21 日致函两机构，敦促其针对该学院收取额外费用采取行动，并指示该学院第 5 年只收取半年费用。Arunraj 博士说。

邦政府还敦促委员会指示该学院恢复学生使用考勤门户的权限，并确保任何学生都不会因未支付额外费用而被拒绝考勤、参加临床培训或获得参加考试的资格。政府还要求有关部门指示学院退还多收的款项或予以调整，并确保任何学生或家长都不会因提出投诉或参与调查而面临后果。

部长表示，邦政府坚决认为，任何学生的教育都不应因费用问题受到影响。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Solidigm, SK hynix’s NAND flash memory subsidiary, has decided to halt its review of potential pre-initial public offering (IPO) fundraising and IPO options, citing volatile capital markets and recent trends in semiconductor stock prices, the chip giant said Friday. "While SK hynix and Solidigm continue to deliver solid business performance, financial market volatility has increased, contributing to a broader correction in semiconductor stocks," SK hynix said in a press statement.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: SK hynix旗下NAND闪存子公司Solidigm周五表示，由于资本市场波动以及近期半导体股价格走势，该公司已决定暂停对潜在首次公开募股（IPO）融资及IPO方案的审查。SK hynix在新闻稿中表示：“尽管SK hynix和Solidigm继续交出稳健的业绩，但金融市场波动加剧，推动半导体股票出现更广泛的调整。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Solidigm, SK hynix’s NAND flash memory subsidiary, has decided to halt its review of potential pre-initial public offering (IPO) fundraising and IPO options, citing volatile capital markets and recent trends in semiconductor stock prices, the chip giant said Friday. The company was established in the United States following SK hynix’s $9 billion acquisition of Intel’s NAND flash memory business. "While SK hynix and Solidigm continue to deliver solid business performance, financial market volatility has increased, contributing to a broader correction in semiconductor stocks," SK hynix said in a press statement. Reports circulated that Solidigm was considering a U.S. IPO as early as next year that could value the company at up to $150 billion, with the listing seen as a way to secure funding for U.S. production facilities and technology development amid growing demand for enterprise solid-state drives for artificial intelligence data centers. However, the potential listing had raised concerns over its impact on SK hynix's shareholder value, as well as regulatory scrutiny over the possibility of a subsidiary listing overseas while its parent company remains listed in Korea. Amid mounting controversy over Solidigm’s potential dual listing, financial authorities warned that the plan would face regulatory checks. Earlier this week, Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) Gov. Lee Chan-jin said both the FSS and the Financial Services Commission viewed Solidigm as subject to restrictions on duplicate listings. However, SK hynix said the decision does not reflect any change in the company’s growth prospects or investment needs. “Rather, it reflects a reassessment of whether an IPO would be the most beneficial option for SK hynix and its existing shareholders under current market conditions," it added. SK hynix said raising external capital through an IPO could have improved its consolidated cash flow, helping fund facility investments while supporting shareholder returns through dividends, share buybacks and share cancellations. It also said an IPO could have allowed the market to better recognize Solidigm’s growth potential, which it believes is not adequately reflected in SK hynix’s current corporate value. Expanding Solidigm’s production capacity and strengthening its competitiveness remain key priorities, SK hynix said, adding that it would continue to assess investment timing, scale and financing options to support the subsidiary’s growth and enhance value for existing shareholders
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: SK海力士暂停审查Solidigm在美国股市上市计划
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: SK hynix旗下NAND闪存子公司Solidigm周五表示，鉴于资本市场波动以及近期半导体股价格走势，该公司已决定暂停评估通过首次公开募股（IPO）筹资及实施IPO的方案。SK hynix以90亿美元收购英特尔的NAND闪存业务后，在美国设立了这家公司。SK hynix在一份新闻稿中表示：“尽管SK hynix和Solidigm持续取得稳健的业务业绩，但金融市场波动加剧，促使半导体股票出现更广泛回调。”此前有报道称，Solidigm最早可能在明年考虑赴美IPO，公司估值最高可达150亿美元；在人工智能数据中心对企业级固态驱动器需求不断增长的背景下，上市被视为一种筹资方式，可为美国生产设施和技术开发提供资金。然而，潜在的上市引发了外界担忧：一是可能影响SK hynix的股东价值；二是子公司在海外上市而母公司在韩国上市，可能受到监管审查。随着围绕Solidigm潜在双重上市的争议不断升温，韩国金融当局警告称，该计划将面临监管审查。本周早些时候，韩国金融监督院长李 chan-jin表示，金融监督院和韩国金融委员会均认为，Solidigm的上市安排须遵守重复上市限制。不过，SK hynix表示，这一决定并不意味着公司增长前景或投资需求发生了变化。公司称：“相反，这反映了对在当前市场条件下，IPO是否仍是SK hynix及其现有股东的最佳选择的重新评估。”SK hynix表示，通过IPO筹集外部资本原本可以改善其合并现金流，为设施投资提供资金，同时通过分红、股份回购和股份注销支持股东回报。公司还表示，IPO原本可以让市场更充分地认识到Solidigm的增长潜力，而该公司认为这一潜力尚未充分反映在SK hynix目前的整体企业价值中。SK hynix称，扩大Solidigm的产能并增强其竞争力仍是重点优先事项；公司将继续评估投资的时机、规模和融资方案，以支持该子公司增长并提升现有股东的价值

https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-touts.body: President John Dramani Mahama has touted his administration’s $10 billion Big Push Infrastructure Programme, saying the initiative will accelerate infrastructure development, create hundreds of thousands of jobs and complete stalled legacy projects across the country. Speaking at the 13th Financial Times (FT) Africa Summit in London, President Mahama said the programme would be implemented over five years, with $2 billion allocated annually. “We are building infrastructure through the Big Push Programme. It is a $10 billion programme over five years, with $2 billion allocated each year,” he said. He explained that the programme, which began with road infrastructure, would expand to cover schools, hospitals, irrigation schemes, and other projects to support national development. President Mahama also announced plans for a new economy plan involving $10 billion in self-financed investment over four years. He said the funds would go to nine job-rich sectors, including tourism, energy, agriculture, agro-processing, pharmaceuticals, and textiles and garments. He attributed the planned investments to fiscal adjustments his administration is undertaking, including reducing the primary balance target agreed with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) from 1.5 per cent to 0.5 per cent. The President said the adjustment would create an additional fiscal space equivalent to one percentage point, which would be channelled into the targeted sectors to stimulate economic activity and employment. “However, the economy is holding steadily. Our currency is stable, and interest rates are still falling. I think there is a lot we can do for ourselves, even as we call for reform of the global order,” he said. The two-day summit, held under the theme “Mobilising Growth in a New Global Order”, brought together global business leaders, policymakers and heads of state to discuss economic growth and development. Addressing Africa’s debt burden and the global financial system, President Mahama argued that the international economic order placed the continent at a disadvantage, particularly in accessing financing to respond to climate change. “We contribute just four per cent of greenhouse gas emissions, yet we borrow at eight times the cost to deal with the effects of flooding, forest fires and other climate-related challenges,” he said. He further cited the financial resources leaving the continent through debt servicing and illicit financial flows, saying about $80 billion went out annually in interest and debt repayments, while another $90 billion was lost through illicit financial flows, transfer pricing and related practices. The President also expressed concern about declining Overseas Development Assistance (ODA), noting that it fell by 23.5 per cent in 2025 and was expected to decline further in 2026. Despite these challenges, he described Africa as resilient, arguing that the continent continued to endure substantial financial outflows even as development assistance dwindled. “More than $200 billion goes out every year while ODA continues to dwindle,” he said, questioning how Europe would have coped under similar circumstances
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-touts.title_zh: 马哈马宣传价值100亿美元的“大推进”计划，以推动基础设施建设和就业
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-touts.body_zh: 约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马总统赞扬了本届政府规模为100亿美元的“大推进”基础设施计划，称该计划将加快基础设施建设，创造数十万个就业岗位，并完成全国各处停滞的遗留项目。马哈马总统在伦敦举行的第13届《金融时报》非洲峰会上表示，该计划将在5年内实施，每年拨款20亿美元。他说：“我们正通过‘大推进’计划建设基础设施。这是一个为期5年、总额100亿美元的计划，每年拨款20亿美元。”他解释道，该计划将从道路基础设施开始，随后扩展至学校、医院、灌溉设施及其他支持国家发展的项目。马哈马总统还宣布制定一项新经济计划，计划在4年内投入100亿美元的自筹资金。他说，这些资金将投向9个就业密集型部门，包括旅游、能源、农业、农产品加工、制药、纺织和服装业。他表示，拟议中的投资得益于本届政府正在进行的财政调整，包括将与国际货币基金组织（IMF）商定的基本盈余目标从1.5%降至0.5%。总统说，这一调整将额外释放相当于国内生产总值1个百分点的财政空间，并将其投入重点部门，以刺激经济活动和就业。他说：“不过，经济保持稳定。我们的货币保持稳定，利率仍在下降。我认为，即使我们呼吁改革全球秩序，我们仍然可以在很多事情上依靠自己。”这场为期两天的峰会以“新全球秩序下调动增长”为主题，汇聚全球商界领袖、政策制定者和国家元首，讨论经济增长与发展问题。谈及非洲债务负担和全球金融体系时，马哈马总统认为，国际经济秩序使非洲处于不利地位，尤其是在获得应对气候变化所需的融资方面。他说：“我们的温室气体排放量只占4%，然而，为应对洪水、森林火灾和其他气候相关挑战而借款，我们支付的利率却是其他借款的8倍。”他还提到，因偿债和非法资金流动而离开非洲的金融资源，称非洲每年为利息和债务偿还流出约800亿美元，另有900亿美元因非法资金流动、转让定价及相关做法而流失。总统还对海外发展援助（ODA）减少表示关切，指出其2025年下降了23.5%，预计2026年还会进一步下降。尽管面临这些挑战，他仍认为非洲具有韧性，并指出，即使发展援助日益减少，非洲仍在承受大量资金外流。他说：“每年有超过2000亿美元流出，而海外发展援助却持续萎缩。”他质疑，在类似情况下，欧洲将如何应对。

He said the country’s youthful population could contribute significantly to national development if young people acquired relevant skills and had access to meaningful economic opportunities.
https://dailytrust.com/fg-giz-push-skill.summary_zh: 联邦政府和德国发展机构GIZ呼吁加强技能培养与就业机会之间的衔接，帮助尼日利亚青年获得工作，也让企业能够找到合格劳动力。他表示，如果年轻人掌握相关技能并获得有意义的经济机会，该国庞大的青年人口就能为国家发展作出重大贡献。
https://dailytrust.com/fg-giz-push-skill.body: The Federal Government and the German development agency, GIZ, have called for stronger links between skills development and employment opportunities to help Nigerian youths secure jobs and enable businesses to find qualified workers. They made the call at the Abuja Job and Career Fair 2026, where government officials and development partners stressed the need for improved career guidance, effective job-matching services and closer cooperation with employers. The Minister of Labour and Employment, Dr Muhammad Maigari Dingyadi, said the government was committed to expanding access to employment through public job centres and the National Electronic Labour Exchange (NELEX), a digital platform designed to connect job seekers with employers. He said the country’s youthful population could contribute significantly to national development if young people acquired relevant skills and had access to meaningful economic opportunities. Dingyadi, who declared the fair open, identified skills mismatches, informal employment and difficulties connecting job seekers with employers as challenges requiring coordinated action. He said the fair provided opportunities for recruitment, career counselling, professional networking and skills development, with sessions covering workplace readiness, entrepreneurship, digitalisation and migration pathways. The minister called on employers to look beyond academic qualifications when assessing candidates and consider their abilities, potential and willingness to learn. Mrs Oladoyin Olayi, Organisational Development Coordinator at GIZ Nigeria, said the organisation had worked with the Ministry of Labour and Employment for eight years to strengthen employment services in the country. Representing GIZ Country Director Dr Marcus Wagner, she said the partnership had supported job centres, vocational training, labour migration advice, business digitalisation and entrepreneurship. Olayi disclosed that 11 job centres had been established across five states under the Skills Development for Youth Programme, with four additional centres planned. She said the centres had served more than 65,000 people, over half of them women, by providing career guidance, connecting job seekers with vacancies and referring them to training opportunities. On labour migration, Olayi said more than 31,000 people had received advice on regular migration since 2023, while over 14,000 had been referred to qualification programmes in sectors including hospitality, information and communications technology, construction, renewable energy and fashion. She said more than 3,600 Nigerians returning from abroad had also received support to review their livelihoods. Olamide Adeyeye, Country Head of Programme at Jobberman Nigeria, said physical career fairs remained important despite the increasing use of digital recruitment platforms. He said many young people continued to face barriers to accessing online employment opportunities because of their location, gender, financial circumstances and limited access to digital resources. He said bringing employers and job seekers together physically allowed candidates to demonstrate their capabilities, ask questions and establish professional relationships. Adeyeye disclosed that more than 150,000 people had secured jobs through job fairs, career events and job centres in the past year, describing direct engagement as an important way to connect qualified candidates with employers. He said employment initiatives must focus not only on preparing young people for work but also on ensuring that suitable opportunities were available to them. Adeyeye urged participants to engage actively with recruiters and make the most of the training sessions, while encouraging employers to recognise the potential of candidates beyond their CVs. https://dailytrust.com/fg-giz-push-skill.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府和德国国际合作机构推动技能与就业衔接，应对青年失业问题
https://dailytrust.com/fg-giz-push-skill.body_zh:
尼日利亚联邦政府与德国发展机构GIZ呼吁加强技能培养与就业机会之间的衔接，帮助尼日利亚青年获得就业机会，也让企业找到合格的劳动者。他们在2026年阿布jobs职业博览会上发出这一呼吁。会上，政府官员和发展伙伴强调，需要改善职业指导、提供有效的职位匹配服务，并与雇主加强合作。

劳工与就业部长Muhammad Maigari Dingyadi博士表示，政府致力于通过公共就业中心和国家电子劳动力交易所（NELEX）扩大就业获取渠道。国家电子劳动力交易所是一个连接求职者与雇主的数字平台。他说，如果年轻人掌握相关技能并获得有意义的经济机会，尼日利亚庞大而年轻的劳动力人口就能为国家发展作出重大贡献。Dingyadi宣布博览会开幕，并指出技能错配、非正规就业以及求职者与雇主之间难以建立联系等问题，这些问题需要协调应对。

他说，本次博览会为招聘、职业咨询、专业 networking 和技能发展提供了机会，议程涵盖职场准备、创业、数字化和移民 pathways。部长呼吁雇主在评估求职者时超越学历要求，考虑他们的能力、潜力和学习意愿。

GIZ Nigeria组织发展协调员Oladoyin Olayi女士表示，该机构已与劳工与就业部合作8年，旨在加强尼日利亚的就业服务。她代表GIZ国家主任Marcus Wagner博士表示，双方合作支持了就业中心、职业培训、劳务移民咨询、企业数字化和创业发展。

Olayi透露，“青年技能发展计划”已在5个州建立11个就业中心，并计划再增设4个。她表示，这些中心已通过提供职业指导、连接求职者与职位空缺、将求职者转介至培训机会等方式，为超过65,000人提供服务，其中超过一半是女性。

谈及劳务移民，Olayi表示，自2023年以来，已有超过31,000人获得正规移民方面的咨询，超过14,000人被转介至酒店业、信息通信技术、建筑、可再生能源和时尚等行业资格培训项目。她表示，还有超过3,600名从海外返回的尼日利亚人获得了支持，以重新评估自己的生计方式。

Jobberman Nigeria项目负责人Olamide Adeyeye表示，尽管数字招聘平台的使用日益增加，实体职业博览会仍然十分重要。他说，许多年轻人因所在地、性别、经济状况以及数字资源获取能力有限等因素，仍然难以获得线上就业机会。

Adeyeye说，在实体场所把雇主和求职者聚集在一起，可以让求职者展示能力、提出问题并建立职业关系。他透露，过去一年，超过150,000人通过职业博览会、职业活动和就业中心获得了工作；他将与合格求职者和雇主直接接触视为实现匹配的重要途径。

Adeyeye表示，就业举措不仅要让年轻人为工作做好准备，还要确保他们能够获得合适的就业机会。他敦促参与者积极参与招聘人员互动，充分利用培训课程，同时鼓励雇主不要只依据求职者简历，而应认识到他们的潜力。

Unlock these with Subscription A U.S. judge on Thursday (October 22, 2026) issued President Donald Trump a December 11 deadline to testify under oath in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC . Judge Enjolique Lett in Miami gave the order in response to complaints by the British broadcaster that Mr. Trump has refused to sit for a deposition, including canceling a previously agreed date of October 16. If Mr. Trump fails to attend the deposition by then, he risks sanctions, including dismissal of his lawsuit, the court said. Mr. Trump has accused the BBC of deceptively editing its documentary "Trump: A Second Chance" to make it seem as if he was inciting violence when he told supporters to march on the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021, after losing the presidential election. The crowd proceeded to storm Congress in an attempt to stop the formal certification of Democrat Joe Biden's victory. While the BBC has apologised for the incident, which prompted the resignation of multiple senior executives, the broadcaster has denied it caused Mr. Trump any real injury and moved for the case to be dismissed. Mr. Trump filed his suit against the BBC in December 2025 and is seeking at least $5 billion on each of two counts. Charles Tobin, a lawyer for the BBC , said in court that Mr. Trump had no real excuse not to testify and that on October 16, he had only been campaigning, "participating in party politics." In a court filing Wednesday (October 21), Mr. Trump's legal team argued that he was not seeking to avoid a deposition but had been constrained by "matters of national importance." The lawyers said Mr. Trump would be able to give a deposition between January 11 and 22. Mr. Trump has made attacks on the media a signature of his two presidential terms, insulting reporters who ask questions he doesn't like and seeking to ban outlets airing critical reports from the White House. Most recently, the administration has plunged into a legal dispute with CNN, MSNOW and Politico over attempts to bar them from the White House. With his approval ratings in the low 30% range and polls showing his Republican Party likely to lose control of the House of Representatives in the November 3 midterm elections, Mr. Trump faces increasing headwinds as he approaches his final years in power. https://punchng.com/umahi-urges-states-t.body_zh: 工程部长David Umahi敦促各州政府效仿卡诺州在环境卫生方面开展的工作，并赞扬州长Abba Kabir Yusuf为保持该州清洁而采取的各项举措。Umahi于周二在卡诺州王冠厅举行的一次全进步大会党团会议上作出上述赞扬。他在会上称赞了州政府的环境卫生项目，包括“卡诺清洁行动”（Operation Kano Tsaf-Tsaf）。据垃圾管理与卫生委员会公共关系官Abubakar Ahmad周三发布的声明，这位部长在卡诺公路—卡诺公路正式启用仪式抵达卡诺。“我敦促其他州效仿卡诺州的工作，因为环境清洁对公共健康和居民福祉至关重要，”Umahi说。“卡诺州展现了致力于环境清洁的坚定决心。尼日利亚其他州应从卡诺州的工作中汲取经验，采取类似措施，为本国公民营造更清洁、更健康的环境，”部长援引其讲话称。卡诺朝觐委员会退还2027年朝觐多缴押金；约博州青年称赞Buni任命新任总检察长；奥贡州社区要求Yayi改善基础设施。声明指出，此次赞扬体现了州政府通过定期开展卫生活动和鼓励公众参与，推动营造清洁、可持续环境的努力。声明补充称：“‘卡诺清洁行动’鼓励居民保持周边环境清洁、妥善处置废弃物，并支持政府保护公共健康的工作。”该委员会敦促州政府持续推进环境卫生举措，强调政府机构、卫生工作人员和居民之间相互合作对于维护更清洁环境的重要性。Hussaini Ibrahim

https://leadership.ng/senate-moves-to-st.body: The proposed legislation, sponsored by Senate Leader Opeyemi Bamidele, representing Ekiti Central Senatorial District, seeks to establish a modern legal framework for the establishment, regulation, monitoring and management of universities and other degree-awarding institutions across the country. The bill, titled National Universities Commission Act (Repeal and Re-enactment) Bill, 2026 (SB. 1056), was presented on behalf of Bamidele by Senate Chief Whip Tahir Monguno, representing Borno North Senatorial District. Leading the debate, Monguno said the existing NUC Act had become outdated in view of changes in Nigeria’s higher education landscape, including the proliferation of private universities, technological advancements, internationalisation of education and evolving national development priorities. He said the proposed legislation would strengthen the commission’s ability to enforce regulations, penalise violations, improve quality assurance and promote internationally recognised academic standards. According to Monguno, the bill also seeks to balance regulatory oversight with institutional autonomy, modernise the commission’s governance structure, encourage international partnerships and address funding challenges affecting university education. “These reforms have become necessary to reposition the NUC as a dynamic catalyst for positive change and innovation in the delivery of quality university education,” he said. He urged senators to support the bill, arguing that a stronger regulatory framework would enable the commission to discharge its statutory responsibilities more effectively. Contributing to the debate, Senator Victor Umeh, representing Anambra Central Senatorial District, called for stronger enforcement powers for the NUC, alleging that some private universities had adopted management structures inconsistent with the existing legal framework. Umeh said that while the commission had initially focused on public universities, the growth of private institutions had created additional regulatory challenges. He alleged that some private universities registered as limited liability companies or companies limited by guarantee had introduced management arrangements involving managing directors and executive directors instead of adhering to governance structures prescribed by law. “The NUC, when it was established, was managing public universities, and at some point, private universities came into being. The private universities that we have in Nigeria today are being run by people who do not keep to the standards as prescribed by the National Universities Commission,” he said. According to Umeh, the commission sometimes struggled to enforce compliance when institutions ignored its directives or challenged its authority. He said the proposed legislation presented an opportunity to strengthen the NUC’s powers and ensure that universities complied with regulations governing their establishment and administration. “When you are told that you are not doing the right thing, that the way and the structure of governance in that private university is not in accordance with the law, you go to court and continue to vacillate,” he said. Umeh recalled that the commission had previously exercised considerable influence over university management by ensuring that institutions complied with its directives. He argued that stronger enforcement provisions were necessary to prevent institutions from disregarding regulatory orders. “Any university that is operating anywhere in Nigeria must align itself with the governance directives of the National Universities Commission. Otherwise, such universities should be proscribed,” he said. He added that the primary objective should be to protect academic standards and ensure that private universities operated within the law. During the debate, senators also discussed allegations of irregular management practices at Tansian University in Anambra State. Umeh cited the institution as an example of what he described as concerns over governance structures and compliance with NUC directives. He alleged that the university’s management arrangements allowed a managing director to exercise powers over appointments and administrative decisions in ways he considered inconsistent with established university governance practices. The allegations were raised during the Senate debate as lawmakers considered whether the proposed legislation would provide the commission with more effective tools to enforce compliance. The discussion also prompted calls for clearer procedures to address institutions that fail to comply with regulatory directives. The Senate President indicated that stronger legislation could help the National Assembly support the commission’s oversight responsibilities and address persistent cases of non-compliance. He also raised the possibility of recommending the proscription of institutions that failed to meet the required standards, subject to the appropriate legal and executive procedures. Beyond enforcement, the proposed legislation seeks to update the NUC’s regulatory framework to reflect developments in higher education. The bill aims to strengthen programme accreditation, update minimum academic standards, improve monitoring mechanisms and promote research and innovation. It also proposes changes to the composition and functions of the commission’s governing board to improve operational efficiency and accountability. Other objectives include providing a clearer framework for international partnerships, foreign investment in university education and the attraction of international faculty and students. The proposed reforms are also intended to encourage greater institutional autonomy while maintaining effective regulatory oversight. Monguno said the changes would help position Nigeria’s university system to respond to emerging challenges and compete more effectively internationally. Following the debate, the Senate passed the bill for second reading through a voice vote. The legislation was subsequently referred to the Senate Committee on Tertiary Institutions and TETFund for further legislative consideration, with the committee directed to report back to the Senate within four weeks. https://leadership.ng/senate-moves-to-st.title_zh: 参议院推动加强国家大学委员会权力，针对违反规定的高校采取行动
https://leadership.ng/senate-moves-to-st.body_zh:
由代表埃基蒂州中部选区的参议院领袖奥佩米·巴米德莱提出的法案，拟为全国大学及其他学位授予机构的设立、监管、监督和管理建立现代法律框架。该法案名为《2026年国家大学委员会法（废止并重新制定）法案》（SB. 1056），由代表博尔诺州北部选区的参议院首席党鞭 Tahir Monguno 代表巴米德莱提交。主持辩论时，Monguno表示，鉴于尼日利亚高等教育格局发生变化，包括私立大学激增、技术进步、教育国际化以及国家发展重点不断演变，现行《国家大学委员会法》已经过时。他说，拟议立法将增强委员会执行规定、惩处违规行为、改善质量保证以及推广国际认可学术标准的能力。

据Monguno介绍，该法案还寻求在监管与机构自主权之间取得平衡，推进委员会治理结构现代化，鼓励国际合作，并解决影响大学教育的资金难题。他说：“为了将国家大学委员会重新定位为提供优质大学教育和推动积极变革与创新的充满活力的催化剂，这些改革已成为必要。”他敦促参议员支持该法案，认为更有力的监管框架将使委员会更有效地履行法定职责。

代表阿南布拉州中部选区的参议员 Victor Umeh 参与辩论时，呼吁赋予国家大学委员会更强的执法权，并指称一些私立大学采用了与现行法律框架不一致的管理结构。Umeh表示，尽管委员会最初主要关注公立大学，但私立机构的发展带来了更多监管挑战。他指称，一些以有限责任公司或担保有限公司形式注册的私立大学引入了由常务董事和执行董事参与的管理安排，而没有遵循法律规定的治理结构。

他说：“国家大学委员会成立之初负责管理公立大学，后来私立大学也开始出现。如今尼日利亚的私立大学由一些人经营，他们没有遵守国家大学委员会规定的标准。”据Umeh介绍，当一些机构无视委员会指示或对其权威提出质疑时，委员会有时难以确保其遵守规定。他说，拟议立法为加强国家大学委员会的权力，并确保大学遵守有关设立和管理的规定提供了机会。

他说：“当你被告知没有正确履行职责，告知那所私立大学的治理方式和结构不符合法律时，你却仍然起诉并继续摇摆不定。”Umeh回顾称，委员会过去曾通过确保各机构遵守其指示，对大学管理施加了相当大的影响。他认为，必须设置更有力的执法条款，以防止机构无视监管命令。

他说：“任何在尼日利亚境内运营的大学都必须遵守国家大学委员会的治理指令，否则就应禁止其办学。”他还补充说，首要目标应是保护学术标准，确保私立大学依法运营。

辩论期间，参议员还讨论了关于阿南布拉州 Tansian University 管理做法不规范的指控。Umeh将该院校列为一个例子，用以说明他所称的治理结构问题以及不遵守国家大学委员会指示的问题。他指称，该大学的管理安排允许常务董事对任命和行政决定行使权力，而他认为这种做法与既定大学治理惯例不符。

这些指控是在参议院辩论期间提出的，当时议员正在审议拟议立法能否为委员会提供更有效的工具以执行合规要求。相关讨论还促使各方呼吁建立更明确的程序，以处理不遵守监管指示的机构。参议院议长表示，更强有力的立法能够帮助国民议会支持委员会的监督职责，并解决长期存在的不合规问题。他还提出，可以建议禁止未能达到规定标准的机构，但须遵守适当的法律和行政程序。

除执法外，拟议立法还旨在更新国家大学委员会的监管框架，使其反映高等教育领域的发展。该法案力求加强专业认证、更新最低学术标准、改善监督机制，并促进研究与创新。法案还提议调整委员会理事会的组成和职能，以提高运营效率和问责水平。其他目标包括为国际合作、大学教育领域的外国投资以及吸引国际教师和学生建立更清晰的框架。

拟议改革还旨在鼓励更大程度的机构自主权，同时保持有效的监管监督。Monguno表示，这些变化将帮助尼日利亚大学体系做好应对新挑战的准备，并在国际市场上具备更强的竞争力。辩论结束后，参议院以口头表决方式通过该法案，进入二读程序。随后，该法案被移交参议院高等教育机构及 TETFund 委员会作进一步立法审议，并指示该委员会在4周内向参议院提交报告。

https://leadership.ng/senate-orders-prob.body: The directive followed concerns raised by Senator Victor Umeh, representing Anambra Central Senatorial District, during deliberations on a bill seeking to repeal and re-enact the National Universities Commission Act. Umeh called for an immediate investigation into the university’s governance structure, particularly allegations concerning the appointment and removal of university officials and the exercise of management powers. He argued that alleged disregard for established regulatory procedures could undermine university governance, weaken academic standards and damage the international reputation of Nigerian graduates. Responding to the concerns, Senate President Godswill Akpabio emphasised the need to strengthen the regulatory authority of the NUC to ensure that public and private universities operated within the confines of the law. Akpabio noted that the National Assembly had an oversight responsibility to support the commission in enforcing standards across the university system. He added that where an institution was found to have violated applicable laws, the National Assembly could recommend appropriate action to the President, including its proscription, subject to the relevant legal procedures. Following the deliberations, the Senate approved a motion for an investigation into Tansian University’s operations and management and directed the relevant committee to report back within two weeks. Umeh had expressed concern that some private universities allegedly operated management structures inconsistent with established regulatory requirements. He warned that allowing university operators to disregard the NUC’s directives could weaken accountability and undermine confidence in the country’s higher education system. The senator called on the Senate to take action against any institution found to be operating outside the approved regulatory framework, stressing that enforcement should not wait for the proposed amendment to the NUC Act to become law. He also warned that failure to address alleged irregularities could have wider implications for the credibility of Nigerian university qualifications. The investigation is expected to establish whether Tansian University’s governance arrangements comply with applicable regulations and determine whether further action is warranted. The allegations against the institution have yet to be established by the investigation. The probe comes as the Senate considers a bill seeking to repeal and re-enact the National Universities Commission Act to strengthen the commission’s regulatory powers and improve oversight of university education in Nigeria. The bill, sponsored by Senate Leader Opeyemi Bamidele and presented by Senate Chief Whip Tahir Monguno, seeks to establish an updated legal framework for the regulation, monitoring and management of universities and other degree-awarding institutions. The proposed legislation aims to strengthen enforcement mechanisms, update minimum academic standards, improve accreditation processes and ensure that Nigerian universities align with international best practices. It also seeks to provide appropriate sanctions for regulatory violations and reinforce the NUC’s position as the apex regulatory authority for academic programme accreditation. During the debate, lawmakers argued that the existing legal framework needed to be updated to address changes in the university sector, particularly the expansion of private institutions and emerging challenges in university administration. They maintained that stronger regulation was necessary to improve quality assurance, promote research and innovation, and ensure that Nigerian universities remained competitive internationally. The Senate subsequently referred the investigation into Tansian University to the relevant committee for further consideration, with a directive to report back within two weeks. The committee is expected to examine the institution’s governance arrangements and determine whether they comply with the regulatory guidelines governing university administration in Nigeria. The development signals the Senate’s intention to strengthen oversight of university management as lawmakers consider broader reforms to the legal framework governing higher education. https://leadership.ng/senate-orders-prob.title_zh: 参议院下令调查坦桑大学涉嫌违反监管规定一事
https://leadership.ng/senate-orders-prob.body_zh: 该指令源于参议员维克托·乌梅赫在审议一项寻求废除并重新制定《国家 Universities Commission Act》的法案时提出的关切。乌梅赫代表阿南布拉中部选区，他呼吁立即调查该大学的治理结构，重点调查有关大学官员任免和管理权力行使的指控。他认为，无视既定监管程序的行为可能削弱大学治理、降低学术标准，并损害尼日利亚毕业生的国际声誉。针对这些关切，参议院议长戈德斯威尔·阿克帕比奥强调，需要加强国家 Universities Commission（NUC）的监管权，确保公立和私立大学依法运营。阿克帕比奥指出，国民议会负有监督责任，应支持该委员会在整个大学体系中执行标准。他补充说，如果发现某机构违反适用法律，国民议会可建议总统采取适当行动，包括依法关闭该机构。经过审议，参议院批准了一项动议，对 Tansian University 的运营和管理展开调查，并指示相关委员会在两周内提交报告。乌梅赫此前表示担忧，一些私立大学据称采用与既定监管要求不一致的管理结构。他警告说，如果允许大学运营方无视 NUC 的指令，可能削弱问责制并损害外界对尼日利亚高等教育体系的信心。乌梅赫呼吁参议院对任何被发现脱离既定监管框架运营的机构采取行动，并强调执法不应等待拟议中的 NUC Act 修正案生效。他还警告称，未能处理涉嫌违规行为，可能对尼日利亚大学学历的可信度带来更广泛影响。此次调查预计将确定 Tansian University 的治理安排是否符合适用法规，并判断是否有必要采取进一步行动。针对该机构的指控尚未通过调查得到证实。调查之际，参议院正在审议一项寻求废除并重新制定《国家 Universities Commission Act》的法案，以加强该委员会的监管权力并加强对尼日利亚大学教育的监督。该法案由参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱提出，并由参议院首席党鞭塔希尔·蒙努诺提交，旨在为大学及其他学位授予机构的监管、监测和管理建立更新后的法律框架。拟议立法旨在加强执法机制、更新最低学术标准、改善认证流程，并确保尼日利亚大学符合国际最佳实践。法案还 seeks 对监管违规行为规定适当制裁，并强化 NUC 作为学术项目认证最高监管机构的地位。辩论期间，议员们认为，现有法律框架需要更新，以应对大学领域的变化，尤其是私立机构的扩张以及大学管理中 emerging 的挑战。他们坚持认为，加强监管对于改善质量保障、促进研究与创新，以及确保尼日利亚大学保持国际竞争力都是必要的。参议院随后将对 Tansian University 的调查移交相关委员会进一步审议，并指示其在两周内提交报告。预计该委员会将审查该机构的治理安排，确定其是否符合尼日利亚大学管理的监管指引。这一进展表明，参议院有意加强对大学管理的监督，同时议员们正在考虑对高等教育法律框架进行更广泛的改革。拟议中的 NUC 修正案已通过二读，目前正在进行进一步立法审议。我们掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家爆料和独家角度，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS WhatsApp 频道，随时获取全天候更新 → 加入我们的 WhatsApp 频道 --> --> Samson Elijah 是一名就职于 Leadership Newspaper 的记者，专门从事政治报道和公共事务分析。他以深入的事实分析而闻名，这些分析超越表面报道，使他成为该领域值得信赖且权威的声音

Speaking on the resolutions, the Speaker of the House, Alhaji Chiroma Buba Mashio, said the bills were forwarded to state legislatures to enable them to consider and vote on the proposed amendments in line with constitutional requirements. Mashio explained that the proposal for State Police was aimed at providing a constitutional framework for states to establish their own police services. He said the proposal formed part of ongoing national discussions on security sector reform, particularly efforts to strengthen the country’s capacity to address emerging security challenges. The 26 proposed constitutional alteration bills seek amendments to various provisions of the 1999 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Under the constitutional amendment process, proposed alterations require the approval of at least two-thirds of the state Houses of Assembly to meet the relevant legislative requirement. The Yobe Assembly’s approval represents the state’s position on the proposal, while its implementation depends on the completion of the constitutionally prescribed amendment process. https://www.myjoyonline.com/trump-ordere.body: A US judge has ordered President Donald Trump to answer questions under oath in his defamation lawsuit against the BBC by 11 December. Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave before the riot at the US Capitol in 2021. Charles Tobin, a lawyer representing the BBC, said in court that "we still haven't been able to depose the plaintiff" with two months left in the discovery period, during which both sides are legally required to exchange information with each other on their case. Trump cancelled a previous deposition on 16 October, citing "matters of national importance" while he was campaigning in Georgia. In US law, a deposition is an out-of-court statement made under oath in response to questions, which is recorded for use in later proceedings. The judge in the case, US Magistrate Judge Enjoliqué Lett, said that Trump must sit for the deposition by 11 December, unless the discovery period is extended. Last week, attorneys asked that Lett compel Trump to face deposition after the last scheduled meeting did not take place. On that day, Trump attended a midterms campaign rally in Dalton, Georgia and a fundraiser at his property in Mar-a-Lago in Florida. Trump's lawsuit - filed in Florida - accuses the BBC of "intentionally, maliciously, and deceptively doctoring" the speech he gave outside the Capitol on 6 January 2021. The BBC apologised for the error and said that the broadcast gave "the mistaken impression that President Trump made a direct call for violent action". The broadcaster has since asked that the court dismiss the lawsuit, arguing that the programme does not meet the legal criteria for defamation and was not available in the US. In July, Trump's lawyers conceded that they had no evidence that the documentary was available in the US on the BBC's BritBox subscription service - as they originally claimed - or on the BBC's website, BBC select or through US broadcasters. Trump ultimately agreed to drop the lawsuit against BBC Studios, its commercial arm, after the BBC argued that it had "no role in creating or producing the documentary". Typically, depositions take place in a lawyer's office - rather than a courtroom - without a judge physically present. Depositions, however, carry legal weight and take place under oath. They are recorded verbatim by a court reporter, and the transcripts can later be used as evidence during trials. In defamation cases, lawyers for both sides are normally present for depositions
https://www.myjoyonline.com/trump-ordere.title_zh: 特朗普须在BBC诉讼案中宣誓回答问题
https://www.myjoyonline.com/trump-ordere.body_zh: 美国法官已命令总统唐纳德·特朗普在12月11日前，就他针对BBC提起的诽谤诉讼宣誓回答问题。特朗普起诉BBC，原因是《全景》节目的一期内容将他在2021年美国国会大厦发生骚乱前发表的一次演讲中两个不同的片段剪辑到了一起。代表BBC的律师查尔斯·托宾在法庭上表示，在证据开示期还剩两个月的情况下，“我们仍未能够让原告接受宣誓取证”，而在此期间，双方依法都必须交换与各自案件有关的信息。特朗普此前取消了10月16日的一次宣誓取证，理由是他正在佐治亚州竞选，声称存在“具有全国重要性的事务”。在美国法律中，宣誓取证是指在法庭外宣誓后回答问题所作的陈述，并会被记录下来，供后续诉讼程序使用。本案法官、美国治安法官恩乔利凯·莱特表示，除非证据开示期获准延长，否则特朗普必须在12月11日前接受宣誓取证。上周，律师请求莱特强迫特朗普接受宣誓取证，因为原定进行的最后一次会面未能举行。当天，特朗普出席了佐治亚州多尔顿市举行的中期选举竞选集会，以及佛罗里达州海湖庄园内的一场筹款活动。特朗普在佛罗里达州提起的诉讼指控BBC“故意、恶意且欺骗性地篡改”了他于2021年1月6日在国会大厦外发表的演讲。BBC为这一错误道歉，并称该节目“使人误以为特朗普总统直接呼吁采取暴力行动”。此后，该媒体请求法院驳回诉讼，理由是该节目不符合诽谤罪的法律标准，而且在美国无法收看。7月，特朗普的律师承认，他们没有证据证明该纪录片可通过BBC的BritBox订阅服务——正如他们最初所称——或通过BBC网站、BBC Select或美国各广播机构在美国收看。最终，在BBC主张其“在制作或创作该纪录片方面没有任何作用”后，特朗普同意放弃对BBC商业部门BBC Studios提起的诉讼。宣誓取证通常在律师事务所而非法庭内进行，法官不会亲自到场。不过，宣誓取证具有法律效力，并以宣誓方式进行。法庭记录员会逐字录制整个过程，记录文本之后可在审判中作为证据。在诽谤案件中，双方律师通常都会出席宣誓取证……

https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/10/2.title: US Treasury proposes a rule to crack down on high-tech investments in China and other ‘countries of concern’
https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/10/2.summary: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Treasury Department proposed a rule Thursday to crack down on American high-tech investments such as supercomputing and artificial intelligence in China, Russia, North Korea and other “countries of concern.’’ The U.S. government has been working for years to deny China and other adversaries investments that could help them boost their military power.
https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/10/2.summary_zh: 华盛顿——美国财政部周四提出一项规则，旨在打击美国对中国、俄罗斯、朝鲜及其他“受关注国家”的高科技投资，例如超级计算和人工智能投资。多年来，美国政府一直设法阻止中国及其他对手获得能够增强其军事力量的投资。
https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/10/2.body: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Treasury Department proposed a rule Thursday to crack down on American high-tech investments such as supercomputing and artificial intelligence in China, Russia, North Korea and other “countries of concern.’’ The U.S. government has been working for years to deny China and other adversaries investments that could help them boost their military power. That program began in 2023 when then-President Joe Biden signed an executive order putting restrictions on outbound U.S. investments in sectors such as semiconductors, quantum computing and artificial intelligence going into China. Treasury later established the Outbound Investment Security Program. In December 2025, Congress passed a law that codified and expanded the program to target more technologies and more foreign countries, including Cuba, Iran, North Korea and Russia. The inclusion of Russia in the proposed rule has come days after President Donald Trump waived sanctions on Russia following a diesel deal with President Vladimir Putin. The rule announced Thursday would expand the restrictions to cover investments in hypersonic systems (capable of traveling at five times the speed of sound), supercomputing, biotechnology and artificial intelligence, though Treasury used Trump’s favored term for AI, “superintelligence” or SI. The proposed rule “sends an important signal to markets that Washington is tracking where U.S. capital is flowing and what capabilities it is helping build,” said Craig Singleton, a senior fellow at the think tank Foundation for Defense of Democracies. The screening of outbound investments “recognizes that capital can accelerate military-relevant capabilities just as surely as technology transfer can,” Singleton said. Treasury’s rule to implement the 2025 law — the Comprehensive Outbound Investment National Security Act — would only apply to investments that exceed $50,000 and would exclude many financial investments, including stock purchases. Treasury will hear public comments on the proposal before issuing a final rule. “It’s just the first step in a fairly long process to get to changes which presumably will be more enforcement-minded, to put more teeth behind the outbound investment program,” said former U.S. trade official Ryan Majerus, now a partner at King & Spalding law firm. Since Trump’s first term, the United States and China — the world’s two biggest economies — have been locked in an economic and tech rivalry. They’ve restricted the export of sensitive technology and critical products (China’s rare earth minerals, America’s advanced computer chips) to each other and slapped tariffs on each other’s products. Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed last year to ease tensions while they engaged in talks, a temporary truce they last month extended into January. But the sparring continues. In July, the Treasury Department issued a $200,000 fine against a U.S.-based company for failing to report to the department a $92,500 investment in a Chinese artificial intelligence and robotics company by one of its subsidiaries
https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/10/2.title_zh: 美国财政部提议制定规则，打击对中国及其他“受关注国家”的高科技投资
https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/10/2.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国财政部周四提议制定一项规则，严厉限制美国对中国、俄罗斯、朝鲜及其他“受关注国家”的高科技投资，例如超级计算和人工智能。美国政府多年来一直致力于阻止中国及其他对手获得可能提升其军事力量的投资。该计划始于2023年，时任总统乔·拜登签署行政命令，限制美国对华 semiconductors、量子计算和人工智能等领域的对外投资。此后，财政部设立了对外投资安全计划。2025年12月，国会通过一项法律，将该计划成文化并予以扩大，将更多技术和更多外国国家列为目标，包括古巴、伊朗、朝鲜和俄罗斯。就在拟议规则发布前几天，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京达成柴油交易后，豁免了对俄罗斯的制裁。周四公布的规则将扩大限制范围，涵盖对高超音速系统（飞行速度可达音速5倍）、超级计算、生物技术和人工智能的投资，不过财政部采用了特朗普偏好的人工智能称谓“超级智能”或SI。民主国防基金会高级研究员克雷格·辛格顿表示，拟议规则“向市场发出一个重要信号，表明华盛顿正在追踪美国资本流向何处，以及这些资本正在帮助构建什么能力”。辛格顿说，对对外投资进行审查，“承认资本与技术转让一样，能够加速与军事相关的能力发展”。财政部为落实2025年法律——《综合对外投资国家安全法》——而制定的规则，仅适用于金额超过50,000美元的投资，并将排除许多金融投资，包括购买股票。财政部将在发布最终规则前听取公众对该提案的意见。现任King & Spalding律师事务所合伙人、美国前贸易官员瑞安·马杰鲁斯说：“这只是推动对外投资计划发生改变的一个初步步骤，而这一过程相当漫长；最终出台的规定大概会更加注重执法，使该计划拥有更强的约束力。”自特朗普首个任期开始以来，世界两大经济体美国和中国一直陷于经济与科技竞争。双方相互限制敏感技术和关键产品的出口，其中包括稀土矿产（中国）和先进计算机芯片（美国），并对彼此产品加征关税。去年，特朗普和中国国家主席习近平同意在会谈期间缓和紧张局势，双方达成的临时休战上月又延长至1月。但双方仍不断交锋。今年7月，财政部对一家美国公司处以200,000美元罚款，原因是该公司未向财政部报告其一家子公司对一家中国人工智能和机器人公司进行的92,500美元投资

https://punchng.com/yobe-assembly-approv.body: The Yobe State House of Assembly has approved the establishment of a state police service as part of its consideration of proposed amendments to the 1999 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. The approval followed deliberations by lawmakers on proposed constitutional amendment bills transmitted by the National Assembly to state Houses of Assembly for consideration and voting. The resolution was reached on Thursday, according to the proceedings of the House. The Speaker, Rt. Hon. Chiroma Buba Mashio, said the bills were forwarded to state legislatures to consider and vote on the proposed alterations in line with constitutional requirements. Mashio said the House’s position on state police was aimed at providing a constitutional framework that would allow states to establish their own police services alongside the existing Nigeria Police Force. He said, “The proposed establishment of state police is aimed at providing a constitutional framework that will enable states to maintain their own police services alongside the existing Nigeria Police Force.” The Speaker added that the proposal was part of ongoing national discussions on security sector reform aimed at strengthening Nigeria’s capacity to address emerging security challenges. “The establishment of state police is a key component of ongoing national discussions on security sector reform aimed at strengthening the country’s capacity to address emerging security challenges,” he said. https://leadership.ng/state-police-gombe.body: The bill, comprising 26 clauses, was transmitted to the state assembly by the National Assembly on October 6, 2026, for concurrence in line with Section 9(2) of the 1999 Constitution, as amended. The proposed legislation seeks to amend the Constitution to establish a legal framework for a State Police Service, distinct from the Nigeria Police Force and under federal control. LEADERSHIP reports that the assembly passed the bill on Thursday after considering the report of its Ad-hoc Committee on the Review of the 1999 Constitution. Upon receipt of the bill, the House constituted a seven-member ad hoc committee, chaired by the Deputy Speaker, Hon. Sadam Bello Sale, to examine the proposed amendments. Presenting the committee’s report, Sale said members had consulted relevant stakeholders as part of their review of the bill. He added that the report received the support of a two-thirds majority of members, in accordance with Order 17, Rule 3 of the Gombe State House of Assembly Standing Orders, 2020. During Thursday’s plenary, lawmakers considered the report at the Committee of the Whole. They adopted recommendations to amend various provisions of the Constitution, including those relating to the establishment and operation of state police services separate from the federal police. The passage places Gombe among the states whose legislatures have endorsed the proposed constitutional changes to establish state police as part of efforts to address Nigeria’s security challenges. Commenting on the bill, the Speaker of the House, Abubakar Muhammad Luggerewo, said members unanimously supported the proposed legal framework for establishing state police, noting that it would strengthen security in the country. He commended the lawmakers for their commitment and resilience. Barr. Hauwa Abdullahi and Barr. Babadidi J. Mele served as secretaries to the committee. We’ve got the edge. https://www.myjoyonline.com/ministry-of-.body: The Ministry of Education is creating direct reporting channels, including a hotline, to allow students, parents, teachers and community members to report sexual abuse in schools without having to go through head teachers or other local authorities who may be implicated. Deputy Education Minister Dr Clement Apaak disclosed this on JoyNews’ News Night on Thursday, October 22, 2026, saying the allegations involving the headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) had exposed weaknesses in the existing reporting structure. “In the wake of this issue, we became aware that there was a challenge within the reporting structure as far as GES is concerned,” he said. Dr Apaak said the proposed channels would provide an alternative route for complaints to reach the Ministry of Education, enabling authorities to respond to allegations more promptly. “We believe that if we were to provide a bypass that would allow victims, parents of victims, teaching and non-teaching staff in the schools where some of these despicable occurrences take place, or even community members and leaders, it will make it easier for such complaints to get to the ministry so that we can act tenaciously,” he said. Dr Apaak stressed that a hotline was one of several reporting options under consideration, acknowledging that students are generally not permitted to carry mobile phones in school. “The concept of the hotline is one among many other options,” he said. He cited the Obuasi SHTS case as an example of how complaints could remain unresolved when people who become aware of alleged abuse cannot secure an effective response through existing channels. “From the documentary, we saw pieces of evidence to suggest that other teachers, a housemistress, and even parents had become aware, and because the structure did not allow them to get the needed response in terms of action, this dragged on,” he said. The Deputy Minister said the delay may have created opportunities for the alleged abuse to continue and affect other students. “That may have then given an opportunity to the accused individual to even engage in this conduct and perpetrate this crime against other female students,” he said. The proposed reporting channels follow allegations of sexual abuse involving the suspended headmaster of Obuasi SHTS, Zakaria Abdulai. An investigative documentary by journalist Manasseh Azure Awuni examined allegations involving multiple students and raised questions about whether concerns brought to the attention of some school authorities and parents received an adequate response. The case has prompted calls for stronger safeguarding measures and more effective systems for reporting suspected abuse in schools. The proposed channels are intended to allow complaints to reach education authorities directly, particularly where school-level officials may be implicated or fail to act. Dr Apaak did not provide a timeline for the introduction of the new reporting options

https://www.myjoyonline.com/ministry-of-.body_zh: 教育部正在建立直接举报渠道，包括设立热线电话，让学生、家长、教师和社区成员可以直接举报校园性侵，而无需经过可能涉案的校长或其他地方 authorities。2026年10月22日，教育部副部长克莱门特·阿帕克博士在 JoyNews 的《夜间新闻》节目中透露了此事。他说，涉及奥布亚西高级技术学校（SHTS）校长的指控暴露了现有举报机制的薄弱之处。他说：“在这一事件发生后，我们意识到，就GES而言，举报机制存在一个问题。”阿帕克博士表示，拟议中的渠道将为投诉直接传达至教育部提供另一条途径，使有关部门能够更迅速地回应指控。他说：“我们认为，如果设置一条旁路举报渠道，让受害者、受害者的家长、发生这些卑劣事件的学校的教职员工，甚至社区成员和社区领袖，都能更方便地向教育部反映投诉，我们就可以坚决采取行动。”阿帕克博士强调，热线电话只是目前正在考虑的多种举报方式之一，并承认学校通常不允许学生携带手机。他说：“热线电话只是众多选项中的一个。”他以奥布亚西SHTS案件为例，说明当知情者无法通过现有渠道获得有效回应时，投诉可能长期得不到解决。他说：“从纪录片中，我们看到了一些证据，表明其他教师、一名宿舍女管理员，甚至一些家长早已知情，但由于现有机制无法让他们获得所需的行动回应，这件事便一直拖着。”副部长表示，拖延可能为涉嫌的虐待行为继续发生并影响其他学生创造了机会。他说：“这样一来，可能就给了被指控者机会，让他们继续实施这种行为，对其他女学生犯下罪行。”拟议中的直接举报渠道是在奥布亚西SHTS被停职校长扎卡里亚·阿卜杜拉伊涉嫌性侵学生的指控之后提出的。记者曼纳塞·阿祖尔·阿武尼制作的一部调查纪录片审查了涉及多名学生的指控，并质疑向部分学校管理人员和家长反映的情况是否得到了充分回应。此案引发了加强保护措施和完善校园疑似虐待行为举报制度的呼声。拟议中的举报渠道旨在让投诉直接传达给教育主管部门，尤其是在学校层面官员可能涉案或未能采取行动的情况下。阿帕克博士没有就推出这些新举报方式的时间表作出说明

Chinese OSINT accounts are circulating selectively edited footage from the July 25, 2026 LAC face-off near Maja in Arunachal Pradesh to push a narrative of calm border management.

The edit keeps a PLA commander speaking in Mandarin about "sincerity" and negotiating a 20-man headcount, followed by PLA troops filming from a ridge while reminding each other to take photos and record video.

Selective video splicing remains a standard tool in modern border information operations. 🇮🇳

https://x.com/unveiled_chinax/status/211.title: ITBP Director General Shatrujeet Kapur confirmed on October 22 what New Delhi has downplayed for months: Indian and Chinese troops are locke
https://x.com/unveiled_chinax/status/211.snippet:
ITBP Director General Shatrujeet Kapur confirmed on October 22 what New Delhi has downplayed for months: Indian and Chinese troops are locked in ongoing face-offs at multiple points in Arunachal Pradesh.

He said: “In the past few days, a situation arose where face-off happened at several locations in Arunachal and it still continues.” Kapur called China India’s “biggest adversary.”

The friction began in late July near Maja in Upper Subansiri. Patrols briefly confronted each other and withdrew. Government sources say Chinese troops later returned in larger numbers and pitched tents roughly 6–7 km inside India’s perception of the Line of Actual Control. India reinforced the area. No violence or casualties reported.

India’s Foreign Ministry responded the next day with a familiar line: the border gets “disturbed from time to time when Chinese forces deviate from established patrolling patterns.” Diplomatic and military channels continue.

The face-offs persisted through August boundary talks in Beijing, a first-ever eastern sector Corps Commander meeting on September 6, and the BRICS summit Xi attended in New Delhi. Months of engagement, and troops remain face-to-face.

Kapur used the moment to call for drones, anti-drone systems, underground shelters, and new training to avoid Galwan-style clashes. Opposition leader Mallikarjun Kharge called the confirmation “deeply alarming” and demanded the prime minister “come clean.”

Talks and summits have not moved the troops. India’s own border force now says the confrontation continues.

https://x.com/unveiled_chinax/status/211.title_zh: 印藏边境警察部队总局长沙特鲁吉特·卡普尔10月22日证实了新德里几个月来一直淡化的事实：印度和中国军队处于对峙状态
https://x.com/unveiled_chinax/status/211.snippet_zh:
印度边境部队总监沙特鲁吉特·卡普尔10月22日证实了新德里几个月来一直淡化的事实：印度和中国军队在阿鲁纳恰尔邦多处地点陷入持续对峙。

他说：“过去几天，在阿鲁纳恰尔邦几个地点出现了对峙局面，而且目前仍在继续。”卡普尔称中国是印度“最大的对手”。

摩擦始于7月底上苏班西里区马贾附近。双方巡逻队短暂对峙后撤离。政府消息人士称，中国军队后来以更大规模返回，并在印度认定的实际控制线以内约6至7公里处搭设帐篷。印度对该地区进行了增援。没有暴力或伤亡报告。

印度外交部次日以熟悉的口径回应称，边境“在解放军偏离既定巡逻模式时不时出现扰动”。外交和军事渠道仍在继续沟通。

对峙在8月北京边界谈判期间持续，在9月6日首次东部战区军长级会晤期间持续，在习近平出席的新德里金砖峰会期间也持续。数月接触后，双方部队仍面对面对峙。

卡普尔借此机会呼吁配备无人机、反无人机系统、地下掩体以及新的训练，以避免加勒万式冲突。反对党领袖马利卡琼·哈尔格称这一证实“令人深感震惊”，并要求总理“说清楚”。

谈判和峰会未能让部队撤离。印度自己的边境部队现在表示，对峙仍在继续。

CHINA DEMANDS A MASSIVE PRICE FROM PUTIN FOR HELPING END THE WAR IN UKRAINE — BEIJING WANTS ALMOST UNLIMITED ACCESS TO RUSSIA’S NATURAL RESOURCES IN EXCHANGE FOR GUARANTEES OF A PEACE DEAL WITH TRUMP.

According to alleged Kremlin insiders, Xi Jinping is prepared to become the main international guarantor of a future peace agreement on Ukraine. However, Chinese leaders have reportedly presented Moscow with a series of economic demands.

Beijing wants to turn its participation in the peace negotiations into long-term advantages for Chinese businesses. The Kremlin is reportedly discussing just how many concessions it will have to make to secure Xi’s support in negotiations with Trump.

China is primarily interested in deposits of rare-earth metals, copper, gold, and other natural resources in Siberia and the Russian Far East.

Beijing is reportedly demanding priority access for Chinese companies to major extraction projects, long-term contracts for raw materials at preferential prices, and special privileges for Chinese investors. Expanding Chinese involvement in Russia’s forestry and energy industries is also reportedly under discussion.

China wants these agreements finalized before any official announcement ending Russia’s war against Ukraine.

Beijing fears that once American sanctions are potentially lifted, Russia could resume extensive cooperation with Western companies, threatening the privileged position Chinese investors have gained in recent years.

Xi therefore wants binding guarantees that would remain in force regardless of any future rapprochement between Moscow and Washington.

For Putin, this creates a serious dilemma.

On one hand, China's participation could significantly increase the chances of reaching an agreement with Trump to end the fighting and gradually lift sanctions.

On the other hand, accepting Beijing’s demands could mean that a substantial share of Russia’s future natural-resource revenues would effectively be tied to Chinese interests for decades.

In other words, Putin may have to mortgage Russia’s natural wealth to China in exchange for a way out of the war he started.

https://x.com/olenarohoza/status/2113920.snippet_zh:
中国就普京协助结束乌克兰战争提出巨额代价——北京希望以几乎不受限制地获取俄罗斯自然资源为交换，换取与特朗普达成和平协议的保证。

据所谓克里姆林宫内部人士透露，习近平准备成为未来乌克兰和平协议的主要国际担保人。不过，据报道，中国领导层向莫斯科提出了一系列经济要求。

北京希望把参与和平谈判转化为中国企业的长期优势。据报道，克里姆林宫正在讨论，为确保习近平支持与特朗普谈判，必须作出多少让步。

中国主要看重西伯利亚和俄罗斯远东地区蕴藏的稀土、铜、黄金及其他自然资源。

据报道，北京要求中国企业优先参与大型开采项目，签订以优惠价格供应原材料的长期合同，并给予中国投资者特殊特权。据报道，扩大中国对俄罗斯林业和能源行业的参与也在讨论之中。

中国希望在任何正式宣布结束俄罗斯对乌克兰战争之前敲定这些协议。

北京担心，一旦美国有可能解除制裁，俄罗斯就可能恢复与西方企业的广泛合作，从而威胁近年来中国投资者所取得的优势地位。

因此，习近平希望获得具有约束力的保证，无论未来莫斯科与华盛顿关系如何改善，这些保证都继续有效。

对普京而言，这造成了一个严峻的难题。

一方面，中国参与谈判可能显著增加与特朗普达成协议、结束战斗并逐步解除制裁的可能性。

另一方面，接受北京的要求，可能意味着俄罗斯未来相当大一部分自然资源收入将在未来数十年里实际上与中国利益绑定。

换言之，普京可能不得不把俄罗斯的自然财富抵押给中国，以换取摆脱他亲手发动的战争的一条出路。

https://x.com/ehimenpaul/status/21137638.snippet:
How Can Armed Groups Move So Freely While Communities Remain Under Threat?

Reports that heavily armed men arrived in convoys at a wedding ceremony in Zamfara State, allegedly linked to a wanted bandit kingpin, have once again raised serious questions about Nigeria’s security system.

Eyewitnesses reportedly said some of the men wore military-style uniforms, while others carried sophisticated weapons. The incident has reignited public concerns over how armed groups continue to operate openly in communities already struggling with insecurity.

Where is the government’s security strategy, and why do residents continue to live in fear? Nigerians deserve answers, not just repeated assurances. When heavily armed groups can reportedly move in convoys without fear, citizens are justified in demanding stronger intelligence, effective security operations, and accountability from those entrusted with protecting lives and property.

For the people of Zamfara, security is not a political slogan. It is the difference between living in peace and going to bed wondering what tomorrow may bring.

How much longer must ordinary Nigerians wait for the safety they deserve?💯😔😈🇳🇬📌

KATSINA STATE MINISTRY OF INTERNAL SECURITY AND HOME AFFAIRS

PRESS RELEASE
23 - 10 - 2026

Bandits Suffer Heavy Casualties as Hunters Repel Attack in Bakori

The Katsina State Government wishes to inform the public of a foiled kidnap operation in Gidan Wawo village, Kakumi Ward, Bakori Local Government Area.

On 23rd October 2026, at about 0128hrs, intelligence revealed the movement of 26 armed bandits on 13 motorcycles, led by one Isiya Kwashen Garwa, towards Dawan Laila forest in Bakori LGA.

Based on the intelligence, all security assets in Bakori LGA were immediately placed on alert to prevent a planned mass kidnap in neighbouring communities.

At about 1331hrs on the same date, reports were received of an attack in which the bandits burnt a private vehicle belonging to one Jamilu Lawal, aged 50, conveying three others travelling to Illela market in Sokoto State from Kakumi ward.

In swift response, hunters from Gidan Wawo were mobilised and engaged the criminals in a gun duel. The operation led to the neutralization of fourteen (14) bandits.

Regrettably, we lost one gallant community hunter, Mohammed Ibrahim Jidda, aged 29, who paid the supreme price in defence of the community. One other hunter, Usman Sunday, aged 25, sustained minor gunshot injuries and is receiving treatment. One victim, Jamilu Lawal, was burnt to death in the vehicle during the rescue operation, while three other victims were successfully rescued.

Intelligence has revealed plans for a possible reprisal attack by the bandits following the heavy casualties suffered. The state government, in collaboration with all security agencies, has put in place appropriate countermeasures to neutralize any further threats in the area.

The government commends the courage and sacrifice of our security operatives and community hunters and assures citizens that we remain resolute in protecting lives and property across the state.

We call on the public to remain calm and continue to provide timely and credible information to security agencies.

Dr. Nasir Mu'azu
Commissioner for Internal Security and Home Affairs, Katsina State

23 October, 2026

Intelligence has revealed plans for a possible reprisal attack by the bandits following the heavy casualties suffered. The state government, in collaboration with all security agencies, has put in place appropriate countermeasures to neutralize any further threats in the area.

The government commends the courage and sacrifice of our security operatives and community hunters and assures citizens that we remain resolute in protecting lives and property across the state.

We call on the public to remain calm and continue to provide timely and credible information to security agencies.

Dr. Nasir Mu'azu
Commissioner for Internal Security and Home Affairs, Katsina State

州政府赞扬安全行动人员及社区猎人的勇气和牺牲精神，并保证继续坚决保护全州居民的生命与财产。

我们呼吁公众保持冷静，继续及时向安全机构提供可靠信息。

https://x.com/ntanewsnow/status/21137126.title: NIGERIA CUSTOMS, TMPL TEST CUTTING-EDGE CARGO SCANNERS IN CHINA AHEAD OF DEPLOYMENT The Nigeria Customs Service and Trade Modernisation Proj
https://x.com/ntanewsnow/status/21137126.snippet:
NIGERIA CUSTOMS, TMPL TEST CUTTING-EDGE CARGO SCANNERS IN CHINA AHEAD OF DEPLOYMENT

The Nigeria Customs Service and Trade Modernisation Project Limited have completed factory acceptance tests for newly acquired non-intrusive inspection equipment and an electronic cargo tracking system in China.

The two-week exercise, led by Deputy Comptroller-General Oluyomi Adebakin, took place at the facility of Nuctech Company Limited.

The team conducted technical verification of the high-tech scanners and tracking system designed to enhance cargo examination and enable real-time monitoring from ports to destinations.

Deputy Comptroller-General Adebakin reaffirmed the commitment of Comptroller-General Adewale Adeniyi to leveraging technology for trade facilitation, revenue optimisation and national security.

She described the tests as a crucial quality assurance process to ensure the systems meet global operational standards before shipment to Nigeria.

She added that deploying the scanners would reduce physical examinations, curb cargo diversion, minimise human contact and improve operational efficiency across Customs formations.

https://x.com/ntanewsnow/status/21137126.snippet_zh:
尼日利亚海关与Trade Modernisation Project Limited在中国对最新采购的非侵入式检查设备及电子货物追踪系统完成工厂验收测试

尼日利亚海关与贸易现代化项目有限公司已在中国对最新采购的非侵入式检查设备及电子货物追踪系统完成工厂验收测试。

为期两周的测试由副税务总监Oluyomi Adebakin牵头，在Nuctech Company Limited的设施内进行。

测试团队对高科技扫描设备和追踪系统进行了技术验证。这些设备和系统旨在加强货物查验，并实现从港口至目的地之间的实时监控。

副税务总监Adebakin重申，税务总监Adewale Adeniyi致力于利用技术促进贸易、优化税收收入并维护国家安全。

她表示，此次测试是一项关键的质量保证流程，旨在确保相关系统符合全球运营标准，然后才能运往尼日利亚。

她补充说，部署这些扫描设备将减少人工开箱查验、遏制货物转移、尽量减少人员接触，并提高海关各机构的运营效率。

副税务总监Adebakin重申，税务总监Adewale Adeniyi致力于利用技术促进贸易、优化税收收入并维护国家安全。

她表示，此次测试是一项关键的质量保证流程，旨在确保相关系统符合全球运营标准，然后才能运往尼日利亚。

她补充说，部署这些扫描设备将减少人工开箱查验、遏制货物转移、尽量减少人员接触，并提高海关各机构的运营效率。

https://x.com/thecindyyy_/status/2113608.snippet:
When Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger left ECOWAS last year, many of us felt the ripple in markets and border posts. Last week in Dakar the two sides sat down properly and agreed to build a practical cooperation framework — not a return to membership, but rules that could ease trade, movement and security cooperation.
Ordinary people have been paying the price of the split in higher costs and delays. If these working groups deliver clear, fair rules, that is what actually matters on the ground. The question is whether we keep the focus on livelihoods or let process swallow the purpose.
This is Society & Diplomacy. Where Global Issues Meet Everyday Life.

Is it a coincidence that the areas with rare earth in Myanmar are also conflict zones?

In northern Myanmar’s Kachin State, near the Chinese border, rare earth deposits overlap with areas controlled by armed groups like the KIO.

After the KIO took control of the Chipwi–Pangwa area, China initially closed the border for rare earth-related imports and exports.

Rare earth mining in Myanmar has become closely tied to local conflicts. Armed groups use mining revenues to fund their operations, while China seeks stable access to these critical minerals. The result is a pattern where resource-rich border regions are also hotspots of fighting.
Source: @CrisisGroup by Richard Horsey, Thomas Kean, Carolin Graf and David Muchiri Kimotho
Visualisations and imagery by Claire Boccon-Gibod, Paul Franz, Ysé Angerer and Jorge Gutiérrez Lucena

https://x.com/world_data_a/status/211357.title_zh: 缅甸富含稀土的地区同时也是冲突地区，这只是巧合吗？
https://x.com/world_data_a/status/211357.snippet_zh:
缅甸盛产稀土的地区同时也是冲突地区，这是巧合吗？

在缅甸北部的克钦邦，靠近中国边境，稀土矿藏与KIO等武装团体控制的区域重叠。

KIO控制Chipwi–Pangwa地区后，中国一度关闭边境，禁止与稀土有关的进出口贸易。

缅甸的稀土开采已与当地冲突 closely 交织在一起。武装团体利用采矿收入资助其行动，而中国则寻求稳定获得这些关键矿产。结果形成了一种局面：资源丰富的边境地区同时也是战斗热点。

来源：@CrisisGroup，作者Richard Horsey、Thomas Kean、Carolin Graf和David Muchiri Kimotho

可视化与图像由Claire Boccon-Gibod、Paul Franz、Ysé Angerer和Jorge Gutiérrez Lucena制作

Bandit Infighting Claims Over 40 Lives in Zamfara, Brother of Ado Allero Reportedly Killed

By: Zagazola Makama

A violent internal clash among rival factions of armed bandits in the eastern Mada axis of Zamfara State has reportedly left more than 40 fighters dead, including a younger brother of notorious bandit kingpin Ado Allero, identified as “Senator”.

Security sources and local accounts said the deadly confrontation occurred amid escalating tensions within the armed groups operating in the area, although the exact circumstances that triggered the infighting remain unclear.

Among those reportedly killed was Senator, said to be a younger brother of Ado Allero, one of the notorious bandit leaders operating in the North-West.

The reported death of Senator, if confirmed, could represent a significant development within the network associated with the bandit kingpin, particularly if it deepens existing divisions among armed groups operating across Zamfara and neighbouring states.

Preliminary accounts indicated that the confrontation involved armed elements from within the bandit networks, with casualties reportedly exceeding 40 fighters.

Zagazola report that the disputes over territorial control, disagreements over leadership and competition for resources have contributed to tensions among criminal groups operating in parts of the North-West. 

Further updates will follow as more credible information becomes available.

作者：Zagazola Makama

据报道，赞法拉州东部Mada地区多个 rival 武装 bandit 派系发生暴力内部冲突，造成40多名武装人员死亡，其中包括臭名昭著的 bandit 头目Ado Allero的弟弟“Senator”。

据报遇死者包括Senator，据称他是Ado Allero的弟弟。Ado Allero是活跃于西北地区的臭名昭著的 bandit 头目之一。

初步消息称，冲突涉及bandit网络内部的武装人员，死亡人数据称超过40名武装人员。

Zagazola报道称，围绕地盘控制的争夺、领导权分歧以及对资源的竞争，加剧了西北部分地区犯罪团体之间的紧张关系。

https://x.com/vijaita/status/21134443555.snippet:
China and India in a standoff at multiple locations along Arunachal border since July, India hosted Xi Jinping from Sep 11-13 for the BRICS summit. 
“In the past few-days, a situation arose where face-off happened at several locations in Arunachal and it still continues,” ITBP D-G Shatrujeet Kapur said on Thursday.
This is the first official confirmation of the scale of the continuing tensions on the north-eastern border since July this year.
Government sources told The Hindu that since late July, India and China have been engaged in a stand-off at Asaphila near Taksing in Arunachal Pradesh. The Chinese People’s Liberation Army (PLA) is said to have pitched tents at an elevation, within 6-7 kilometres of India’s perception of the Line of Actual Control (LAC) near Maja company operating base in Taksing circle of Upper Subansiri district, sources said. https://x.com/adeyusuf_ia/status/2113399.snippet:
How a Village Self-Defence Group Turned Into Nigeria’s New Cross-Border Terror Bridge

In 2017, border villages in Sokoto invited an armed herding militia, Lakurawa to shield them from bandits.

By 2026, that former vigilante force had evolved into one of Nigeria’s fastest-spreading terror threats:
• Taxed Kebbi and Sokoto communities ₦50m ($36,000) in March 2026 just to let clerics preach Ramadan tafsir
• Killed 162 civilians in Woro and Nuku, Kwara State after villages rejected its rule
• Built an active corridor linking Sahelian jihadists (ISGS/JNIM) toward northern Benin and central Nigeria

History’s hardest internal security lesson repeats: when the state leaves a vacuum, outsourced community defence rarely stays defensive for long.

一个村庄自卫组织如何变成尼日利亚新的跨境恐怖主义通道

2017年，索科托州边境村庄邀请武装牧民民兵组织Lakurawa保护他们免受匪徒侵害。

到2026年，这支昔日的地方武装力量已经发展成尼日利亚扩张速度最快的恐怖主义威胁之一：
• 2026年3月，向凯比和索科托社区征收5000万奈拉（36,000美元），只因教职人员要宣讲斋月古兰经注释
• 在村庄拒绝其统治后，于夸拉州沃罗和努库杀害162名平民
• 修建了一条活跃通道，连接萨赫勒圣战组织（ISGS/JNIM）与贝宁北部及尼日利亚中部

历史上最惨痛的内政安全教训反复出现：国家一旦留下权力真空，外包出去的社区防务很少能够长期保持防御性质。

https://x.com/saheliens/status/211338556.snippet_zh:
